Gpi19 は GPI-GlcNAc 転移酵素の必須のサブユニットで、Gpi2: Gpi19 is an essential subunit of GPI-GlcNAc transferase and co-precipitates with Gpi2. Conditional mutants lack enzyme activity (16278447)
Gpi8 と Gaa1 の可溶性ドメインはほかのサブユニットなしに特異的に結合す: The soluble domains of Gpi8 and Gaa1 bind specifically without the other subunits (28893510)
Gpn2 と Rba50 は互いに結合する（29661922）: Gpn2 and Rba50 bind each other (29661922)
Gpn2 は Gpn3 と Npa3/Gpn1 の両方に結合する（2326705: Gpn2 binds both Gpn3 and Npa3/Gpn1 (23267056)
Grh1 が Bug1 と複合体を作る（17261844）: Grh1 forms a complex with Bug1 (17261844)
Grh1 は coiled-coil タンパク質 Bug1（Ydl099w）と複: Grh1 forms a complex with the coiled-coil protein Bug1 (Ydl099w). It also binds Sec23/24 (17261844)
Grr1 と結合する She3 を SCF-Grr1 の新しい基質として見つけた: She3, which binds Grr1, was identified as a new SCF-Grr1 substrate. A non-degradable She3 mutant does not affect mRNA transport but grows more slowly in co-culture; Grr1-mediated degradation of She3 is required for good growth (23144720)
Grr1 による Ubp3 の分解が eS7A の一ユビキチン化を保ち、HAC1: Grr1-mediated degradation of Ubp3 maintains monoubiquitination of eS7A and promotes translation of Hac1 from HAC1i. Grr1 also promotes splicing of HAC1u (40038285)
Grr1 は Rtg2 にも Bmh1/2 にも結合していない Mks1 をポリ: Grr1 polyubiquitinates Mks1 that is bound to neither Rtg2 nor Bmh1/2, targeting it for degradation, and regulates the RTG pathway by changing Mks1 levels (16093347)
Grs1 は Hrt3 と two-hybrid で結合し、Hrt3 にユビキチ: Grs1 binds Hrt3 in two-hybrid assays and is a substrate ubiquitinated by Hrt3 (26297823)
Grx3 と Grx4 はどちらも Slt2 と物理的に結合する。両方の欠損で酸: Grx3 and Grx4 both physically bind Slt2. Loss of both severely impairs survival under oxidative stress, Slt2 activation, and Rlm1 transcription. Grx4 regulates Slt2 phosphorylation under oxidative conditions (28007574)
Grx3 と Grx4 は鉄による Aft1 の抑制に必須で、両方を欠くと鉄調節: Grx3 and Grx4 are essential for iron-mediated inhibition of Aft1; without both, iron-regulated genes are constitutively expressed. They bind Aft1 (16648636). Grx3/Grx4 control the nuclear localization of Aft1 and bind Aft1 in vivo and in vitro. In the double deletion, Aft1 target genes are constitutively activated (17074835)
Grx4 の過剰発現は野生型 Aft1 の活性を弱める。Grx3・Grx4 両欠: Overexpression of Grx4 weakens the activity of wild-type Aft1. In the Grx3/Grx4 double deletion, iron-regulated genes are constitutively expressed (16648636). Negative regulation of Aft1 activity by Grx3 and Grx4. The Grx domain is important for the relocation of Aft1 to the cytoplasm (17074835)
Grx4 は Bud32 の生体内の基質で、Bud32 は Grx4 が体内で十: Grx4 is an in vivo substrate of Bud32, and Bud32 contributes to full in vivo function of Grx4. Phosphorylation of Bud32 S258 by Sch9 enhances its binding to and phosphorylation of Grx4 (19021767). Bud32 binds Grx4 directly and phosphorylates S134 in vitro (14519092)
Gsy2 とのツーハイブリッドで PIG1 を単離。pig1 gac1 でグリコ: PIG1 was isolated in a two-hybrid screen with Gsy2. Glycogen deficiency is stronger in pig1 gac1 (9046081)
Gsy2 と結合するタンパク質の two-hybrid スクリーンで PIG1・: PIG1 and PIG2 were identified in a two-hybrid screen for Gsy2-binding proteins (9046081)
Gtb1 は小胞体内腔で Gls2（Rot2）と複合体を作り、最後のグルコースの: Gtb1 forms a complex with Gls2 (Rot2) in the ER lumen and is essential for removal of the last glucose (16373354)
Gtr1 のヌクレオチドの結合状態は保存された GEF の Vam6 で調節され: The nucleotide-bound state of Gtr1 is regulated by the conserved GEF Vam6. Vam6 activates Gtr1 of the EGO complex and controls TORC1 function (19748353)
Gtr1・Gtr2 を含む GSE 複合体は後期エンドソームから細胞膜への Ga: The GSE complex containing Gtr1 and Gtr2 is required for sorting of Gap1 from late endosomes to the plasma membrane (16732272)
Gts1 の結合相手として Ssa1・Ssa2 を同定。SSA1 か SSA2: Ssa1 and Ssa2 were identified as binding partners of Gts1. Co-expression of SSA1 or SSA2 suppresses nuclear import of Gts1 (21307595)
Gua1 の活性を下げる gua1-G388D 変異でグアニンヌクレオチドが減り: The gua1-G388D mutation, which lowers Gua1 activity, reduces guanine nucleotides and derepresses translation of GCN4 mRNA (20980241)
Gyp1p の GAP 活性は SNARE の Snc1p と FM4-64 の: The GAP activity of Gyp1p is required for recycling of the SNARE Snc1p and FM4-64. The recycling defect of gyp1Δ is partly rescued by lowering Ypt1p activity, and expression of GTP-locked Ypt1p-Q67L causes GFP-Snc1p to accumulate intracellularly. The title states that Gyp1p acts in recycling by inactivating Ypt1p (15082776)
Gyp5 と Gyp8 は Ypt1 を効率のよい基質とする GAP で、Ypt: Gyp5 and Gyp8 are GAPs for which Ypt1 is an efficient substrate, and they stimulate GTP hydrolysis by Ypt1 (in vitro). The growth defect of Ypt1(Q67L) cells is suppressed by high expression of Gyp1, Gyp5, or Gyp8, and combination with GAP deletions causes cold-sensitive growth defects and autophagy-like morphology (12189143). Consistent with the GO direction
Gzf3 は Gat1 を核内で捕らえ、GAT1 自身のプロモーターで競合して: Gzf3 sequesters Gat1 in the nucleus and competes at the GAT1 promoter itself to block Gat1 (19380492)
Gβγ と結合できない Far1 変異体の細胞は交配相手へ向かって伸びられない（: Cells with a Far1 mutant that cannot bind Gβγ cannot grow toward a mating partner (9822386). For Far1 to act as an activator of Cdc24 in vivo, binding to Cdc24 and Gβγ is required (14988725)
Gβγ（Ste4 と Ste18 の複合体）の膜への強い結合は Ste18 の: The strong membrane binding of Gβγ (the Ste4–Ste18 complex) depends on palmitoylation of Ste18 Cys106 and prenylation of Cys107 (10523659)
H2A の C 末端の PIKK 部位は DNA 損傷でのリン酸化が Mec1: Phosphorylation of the C-terminal PIKK site of H2A upon DNA damage depends on Mec1 and is required for double-strand break repair (NHEJ) (11140636). H2A is phosphorylated by Tel1 and Mec1 over 50 kb around the break (16299494)
H2B のユビキチン化を担う Rad6/Bre1 が Swd2 の修飾にも直接関: Rad6/Bre1, responsible for H2B ubiquitination, is also directly involved in modification of Swd2. Mutation of Swd2 K68/K69 greatly reduces H3K4me3 (18849979)
H2O2 で MMT1（MMT2 ではない）が誘導され、その誘導に転写因子 Ya: H2O2 induces MMT1 (but not MMT2), and the transcription factor Yap1 is involved in this induction (31896574)
H2O2 で Med13 が分解されサイクリン C が細胞質に放たれる。Med1: H2O2 causes degradation of Med13, releasing cyclin C into the cytoplasm. The intrinsically disordered region of Med13 (742-844) serves as both the cyclin C-Cdk8 binding site and the SCF-Grr1 degron. Main text: the cyclin C-Cdk8 kinase is required for Med13 degradation, and in cdk8Δ Med13 phosphorylation disappears even under normal growth. Cdk8 is also required for Med13 degradation by active Slt2 (BCK1-20) (29212878). BioGRID's 33933450 is phosphorylation within the CKM in vitro
H2O2 で Yap1 は酸化されて活性化し、Yap1 が誘導するチオレドキシン: With H2O2, Yap1 is oxidized and activated, and is inactivated by reduction by thioredoxin, which Yap1 induces (11013218). Thioredoxin reduces both Gpx3 and Yap1 to shut off the pathway (12437921). Trx1 and Trx2 are not distinguished, so confidence is medium
H2O2 でのサイクリン C の核から細胞質への移動には Slt2・Kdx1・A: Relocation of cyclin C from the nucleus to the cytoplasm under H2O2 requires Slt2, Kdx1, and Ask10. Slt2 binds cyclin C and directly phosphorylates Ser-266; removing or mimicking this site suppresses or enhances relocation and degradation, respectively (24554767)
H2O2 処理で Lsm12 が Polη の UBZ に結合し Ubp3 経由: Upon H2O2 treatment, Lsm12 binds the UBZ of Polη and promotes Ubp3-mediated deubiquitination and recruitment (30366994)
H3 K4 の脱メチル化酵素 Jhd2 のタンパク質量は E3 の Not4 に: Protein levels of the H3 K4 demethylase Jhd2 are regulated by polyubiquitination by the E3 Not4 and proteasomal degradation, and this degradation determines the level of H3 K4 trimethylation and gene expression in vivo (19346402)
H3 S10 キナーゼ複合体の触媒サブユニットは Snf1。Snf1 と Gcn: The catalytic subunit of the H3 S10 kinase complex is Snf1. Snf1 and Gcn5 modify H3 S10 and K14 in a defined order to increase INO1 transcription (11498592)
H3 S10 キナーゼ複合体を酵母から精製し、触媒サブユニットが Snf1 と分: The H3 S10 kinase complex was purified from yeast, and its catalytic subunit was found to be Snf1. Snf1 and Gcn5 modify H3 S10 and K14 in a defined order to increase INO1 transcription (11498592). At HIS3, S10 is not involved (16287868)
H3K79 メチル化の欠けた変異株で、COS12 など少数のテロメア近くの遺伝子: In mutants lacking H3K79 methylation, only a few telomere-proximal genes such as COS12 undergo H3K79 methylation-dependent natural silencing. Main text: COS12 is derepressed in the dot1 deletion (21474073)
H3T11 のリン酸化（H3pT11）は栄養ストレスと老化の印で、Sch9 と: H3T11 phosphorylation (H3pT11) is a mark of nutrient stress and aging, and Sch9 and CK2 cooperate to regulate H3pT11 under nutrient stress. Mutants lacking H3pT11 have extended chronological lifespan (29938647). Main text: after shift to YPglycerol, H3pT11 is greatly reduced in cka1Δ but unchanged in cka2Δ, ckb1Δ, and ckb2Δ
H4 S1 のリン酸化は MMS・フレオマイシンによる DNA 二本鎖切断の近く: H4 S1 phosphorylation increases 20-25-fold near DNA double-strand breaks caused by MMS or phleomycin. CK2 phosphorylates H4 S1 in vitro, and in CK2 deletion or temperature-sensitive mutants, H4 S1 phosphorylation is not induced by DNA damage. H4 S1 phosphorylation and CK2 act in NHEJ (15823538). CK2 phosphorylates H4 and binds the Rpd3 complex. S1 phosphorylation blocks NuA4-mediated H4 acetylation and occurs at the chromatin restoration/deacetylation stage at the end of repair (16135807)
H4 S1 は胞子形成の中期からリン酸化され、胞子形成に特有の Ste20 族キ: H4 S1 is phosphorylated from mid-sporulation, and loss of the sporulation-specific Ste20-family kinase Sps1 nearly abolishes this H4 S1ph. With H4 S1A, spore formation is abnormal, and in sps1Δ or S1A the DNA volume of spore nuclei increases (16980586)
H4 のアセチル化、特に K16 のアセチル化が Dot1 をアロステリックに活: Acetylation of H4, especially at K16, allosterically activates Dot1 and, together with H2Bub, supports H3K79 di- and trimethylation in vitro and in vivo (33479126)
H4・H3・H2A（K7）・H2B（K11・K16）のアセチル化部位に特異的な抗: Using a set of antibodies specific to acetylation sites on H4, H3, H2A (K7), and H2B (K11, K16), at the INO1 promoter RPD3 strongly deacetylates sites other than H4 K16, ESA1 acetylates H2A, H2B, and H4 sites other than H4 K16, and GCN5 acetylates H2B and H3 sites other than H3 K14 (11545749)
HAM1 の過剰発現による 5-FU 耐性は YJL055W（LOG1）に一部依: 5-FU resistance from HAM1 overexpression partly depends on YJL055W (LOG1) (24124444)
HAP 複合体の Hap2・Hap3 が ASN1 の十分な発現に必要で、Hap: Hap2 and Hap3 of the HAP complex are required for full ASN1 expression; the contribution of Hap4 is small (8951815)
HAP 遺伝子はもともと CYC1 の調節因子として見つかり、この発現の比較でも: HAP genes were originally found as regulators of CYC1, and in this expression comparison CYC1 is also higher in wild type (hap2/wt 0.25, hap4/wt 0.51, Table 1) (18629096)
HAT と HDAC の遺伝的相互作用の解析から、Htz1 の K14 の脱アセ: Analysis of HAT–HDAC genetic interactions showed that Hda1 is responsible for deacetylation of Htz1 K14 (18676811). Acetylation of Htz1 K8, K10, and K14 is all added by Esa1 and removed by Hda1, and Hda1 deacetylates in response to benomyl (20952395)
HCR1 は rpg1-1 の多コピー抑圧遺伝子。共免疫沈降で Hcr1 と R: HCR1 is a multicopy suppressor of rpg1-1. Co-immunoprecipitation showed binding of Hcr1 and Rpg1 (10488093)
HDA1 は HDA2-HDA3 亜複合体と結合し、この結合が触媒活性に必要（試: HDA1 binds the HDA2-HDA3 subcomplex, and this binding is required for catalytic activity (in vitro and in vivo) (11287668)
HDA2・HDA3 は HDA1 と相互作用し、その活性に必須。どの成分の変異で: HDA2 and HDA3 interact with HDA1 and are essential for its activity. Mutation of any component abolishes activity in vitro and in vivo (11287668)
HDAC の阻害・欠失は Mec1 の活性化、DSB の削り込み、ssDNA-R: HDAC inhibition or deletion specifically impairs Mec1 activation, DSB resection, and ssDNA-RFA formation. Hda1, Rpd3, and the HAT Gcn5 are key. In the main text, Rad53 phosphorylation after DSB is strongly impaired in rpd3 and hda1 rpd3 (21368826 abstract and main text)
HDAC を阻害すると Sae2 はアセチル化され分解される。本文では HO に: When HDACs are inhibited, Sae2 is acetylated and degraded. In the main text, after an HO-induced DSB, Sae2 does not accumulate to wild-type levels in G2-phase hda1 rpd3 cells, and the checkpoint/resection defects and Sae2 destabilization seen with VPA are reproduced in rpd3 hda1 (21368826 abstract and main text)
HEATR5 タンパク質 Laa1 は Laa2 か Lft1（Yml037c）: The HEATR5 protein Laa1 forms two complexes bound to either Laa2 or Lft1 (Yml037c), both acting in intra-Golgi recycling (37662263)
HEM13 の主な抑制は 3 つの Mot3 結合配列と 1 つの Rox1 結: The main repression of HEM13 goes through three Mot3-binding sequences and one Rox1-binding sequence. Mot3 helps recruit Ssn6/Tup1 and strengthens Rox1 repression (15821125)
HEM3 の発現に HAP2 と HAP3 が関わり、HAP2-3-4 結合配列: HAP2 and HAP3 are involved in HEM3 expression, and a region resembling the HAP2-3-4 binding sequence is required (1508149)
HEM3 の発現に HAP2 と HAP3 が関わる（1508149）: HAP2 and HAP3 are involved in HEM3 expression (1508149)
HIS4 の基底の転写は BAS1 と BAS2(PHO2) に制御され、BAS: Basal transcription of HIS4 is controlled by BAS1 and BAS2 (PHO2), and BAS2 protein binds the HIS4 and PHO5 promoters (3303332)
HIS5 プロモーター-PHO5 はアミノ酸飢餓で Gcn4 の働きにより脱抑制: HIS5 promoter-PHO5 is derepressed by amino acid starvation through Gcn4 (7616963)
HMF の解毒に働く ARI1 などの発現は YAP1 と関連のレギュロンが制御: Expression of ARI1 and other genes acting in HMF detoxification is controlled by YAP1 and related regulons (21106074)
HMF の解毒に働く ARI1・ADH6・ADH7・OYE3 の発現は YAP1: Expression of ARI1, ADH6, ADH7, and OYE3, which act in HMF detoxification, is controlled by YAP1 and its close regulators (21106074)
HMO1 のプロモーターの活性は TOR を止めると下がり、その抑制には HMO: HMO1 promoter activity decreases when TOR is inhibited, and this repression requires HMO1 and Fhl1 (21924331)
HMX1 は鉄欠乏で転写され、鉄に応じる主な転写因子 Aft1 の制御下にある（: HMX1 is transcribed under iron deficiency and is under the control of Aft1, the main iron-responsive transcription factor (12840010)
HMX1 欠失で鉄の蓄積が損なわれヘムが増え、Aft1 が活性化される。細菌のヘ: Deletion of HMX1 impairs iron accumulation, increases heme, and activates Aft1. Bacterial heme oxygenase restores this (12840010)
HO による DSB の近くへの Ddc1 の結合は Rad24 に依存し、Me: Binding of Ddc1 near an HO-induced DSB depends on Rad24 but not on Mec1 or Rad9 (11679674). Ddc1 localization depends on Rad17, Mec3, and Rad24 (11691833). In vitro, RFC-Rad24 loads the Rad17-Mec3-Ddc1 clamp onto partially double-stranded DNA in an ATP-dependent manner (12604797)
HO による DSB への Srs2 の効率的な呼び込みは Nej1 に依存する: Efficient recruitment of Srs2 to HO-induced DSBs depends on Nej1 (19571008)
HO の CCB 配列と SWI4・SWI6 が細胞周期に依存した HO の発現: The HO CCB sequence and SWI4/SWI6 are required for cell cycle-dependent HO expression, and SWI4 is contained in the CCBF-DNA complex (2689885). The only SWI genes required for expression from CCB are SWI4 and SWI6 (2649246)
HO エンドヌクレアーゼの mRNA は Puf4 と Mpt5 の 2 つの: HO endonuclease mRNA is controlled by two PUF proteins, Puf4 and Mpt5. Both are required for full repression and deadenylation in vivo, and removing them greatly stabilizes the mRNA. Repression by Puf4 depends on deadenylation (17389596)
HOG 経路の活性化で Kss1 と Ste7 はリン酸化されるが、HOG の信: HOG pathway activation phosphorylates Kss1 and Ste7, but filamentous growth transcription does not occur because the HOG signal blocks Tec1 activation. The mechanism is inhibition of DNA binding, not Tec1 degradation, and the inhibition by Hog1 appears indirect (19218425)
HOG1 の変異で Mnn1 の内腔領域がゴルジ体に留まらず分泌され、完全長の: In HOG1 mutants, the luminal domain of Mnn1 is not retained in the Golgi and is secreted, and full-length Mnn1 also shifts from the early to the late Golgi (9817752)
HOM2・HOM3・THR1 のメチオニンによる転写の促進は GCN4 の産物が: Methionine-induced transcriptional activation of HOM2, HOM3, and THR1 is mediated by the GCN4 product (1789001)
HOP1 プロモーターの UASH に結合する因子を精製すると Abf1 で、U: The factor binding UASH of the HOP1 promoter was purified and is Abf1; UASH mutations abolish binding in vitro and transcriptional activation in vivo (8649386)
HOPS はサブユニット Vps16・Vps18 を介して Vam7 と結合し、: HOPS binds Vam7 via the subunits Vps16 and Vps18, and HOPS recognizes the SNARE complex to promote fusion (21613544)
HRR25 の変異で Haa1 のリン酸化が減り、Haa1 の標的遺伝子（TPO: HRR25 mutation reduces Haa1 phosphorylation and increases expression of Haa1 target genes (TPO2, YRO2). Hrr25 binds Haa1 (28432100)
HSP31 は酸化ストレスで YAP1 に依存して誘導される。ジオーキシックシフ: HSP31 is induced by oxidative stress in a YAP1-dependent manner. Induction after the diauxic shift is YAP1-independent (17395014)
HTA1-HTB1 の主な活性化因子は Spt10。UAS1/2 が HTA1、: The main activator of HTA1-HTB1 is Spt10. UAS1/2 drive HTA1 expression and UAS3/4 drive HTB1 expression (21115727)
HUG1 の発現は MEC1 に依存し、HU 処理で Rnr3 より遅れて誘導さ: HUG1 expression depends on MEC1, and it is induced later than Rnr3 upon HU treatment (24012676)
HUT1 は ERO1 と遺伝学的に相互作用し、hut1 欠失は DTT に感受: HUT1 interacts genetically with ERO1, and the hut1 deletion is sensitive to DTT. It acts in folding of secretory proteins in the ER (11284010)
HXT11・HXT9 は Pdr1・Pdr3 に転写制御される（9271421）: HXT11 and HXT9 are transcriptionally regulated by Pdr1 and Pdr3 (9271421)
HXT5 プロモーターに Hap2/3/4/5 複合体の結合配列が 2 つあり、: The HXT5 promoter has two binding sequences for the Hap2/3/4/5 complex, which appear to be required for expression on non-fermentable carbon sources (15282798)
HXT6 は Mig1 より Mig2 に強く抑制される数少ない遺伝子（1908: HXT6 is one of the few genes more strongly repressed by Mig2 than by Mig1 (19087243)
Haa1 の主な標的は YGR138c と YRO2 で、誘導は直接とみられる（: The main targets of Haa1 are YGR138c and YRO2, and the induction appears direct (11504737)
Haa1 は乳酸ストレスで 5 分以内に細胞質から核に移り、標的遺伝子が誘導され: Under lactic acid stress, Haa1 moves from the cytoplasm to the nucleus within 5 minutes, target genes are induced, and its phosphorylation decreases. Disruption of msn5 causes Haa1 to accumulate in the nucleus even without lactic acid (24682296)
Hac1 と Gcn4 は互いの mRNA の量に影響する（23794510）。: Hac1 and Gcn4 affect each other's mRNA levels (23794510). Main text: without GCN4, HAC1 mRNA levels decrease under amino acid starvation and ER stress
Hac1 は Gcn4 応答配列の誘導に要り、Hac1 と Gcn4 は互いの: Hac1 is required for induction of Gcn4 response elements, and Hac1 and Gcn4 affect each other's mRNA levels (23794510). Main text: without HAC1, GCN4 mRNA decreases under amino acid starvation
Hal8・Hal9 の破壊で塩耐性と ENA1 の発現が下がり、生理的条件で E: Disruption of Hal8/Hal9 lowers salt tolerance and ENA1 expression; they can be considered transcriptional activators of ENA1 under physiological conditions (9559673)
Hap1 と Hap2/3/4/5 複合体は DLD1 の転写の活性化に相加的に: Hap1 and the Hap2/3/4/5 complex act additively in activating DLD1 transcription, and the binding sites of both were determined by gel shift (10628845)
Hap1p が CYB2 の転写の主な活性化因子で、プロモーターの 2 か所の結: Hap1p is the main transcriptional activator of CYB2, acting at two binding sites in the promoter (10972830). CYP1 (HAP1) binds UAS1-B2 of CYB2 (2046677)
Hap2/3/4/5 複合体は非発酵性炭素源への移行での DLD1 の脱抑制に必: The Hap2/3/4/5 complex is required for derepression of DLD1 upon shift to non-fermentable carbon sources (10628845)
Hap2・Hap3 が ASN1 の十分な発現に必要（8951815）: Hap2 and Hap3 are required for full ASN1 expression (8951815)
Hat1-Hat2 は遊離ヒストン H4 の K12 をアセチル化し、H3 尾部: Hat1-Hat2 acetylates K12 of free histone H4; combined with H3 tail mutations, telomeric silencing is impaired, and this function is mediated solely through H4 K12 (10982821). Hat1 is recruited to chromatin near double-strand breaks, and H4 K12 acetylation after the break depends on Hat1 (16612003). BioGRID's 24835250 is structural, and 25473596 and 41417648 do not address H4 function. The effect is visible only in an H3 mutant background, so confidence is medium
