Hcm1 の N 末端のリン酸化は分解を進め、C 末端のリン酸化は活性に必要（C: N-terminal phosphorylation of Hcm1 promotes its degradation, and C-terminal phosphorylation is required for its activity (Cdk1 both activates and inhibits a single transcription factor). Cdk1 promotes gene expression by activating transcriptional activators and inactivating repressors (24714560)
Hcs77（Slg1/Wsc1）を欠くと高温で溶菌し、弱い熱ショックでの Mpk: Without Hcs77 (Slg1/Wsc1), cells lyse at high temperature, and signaling to Mpk1 under mild heat shock is impaired. Mid2 and Hcs77 are redundantly essential for cell wall signaling during vegetative growth (10330137). Multicopy WSC1 increases Mpk1 phosphorylation (12399379)
Hct1（Cdh1）は基質受容体として Clb2 などを認識し APC に運んで: Hct1 (Cdh1) acts as a substrate receptor, recognizing Clb2 and others and delivering them to the APC for ubiquitination and degradation. Clb2 that cannot bind Hct1 is stabilized (11566880). Cdh1 activates APC/C throughout G1 and causes degradation of Clb2 and others (19713762)
Hda1p は MEF1 のプロモーターに結合して発現を負に調節し、Bdf1p: Hda1p binds the MEF1 promoter and negatively regulates its expression, and Bdf1p positively regulates HDA1 transcription (25035869)
Hed1 は Mek1 の直接の基質で、T40 のリン酸化は Hed1 タンパク: Hed1 is a direct substrate of Mek1, and T40 phosphorylation stabilizes Hed1 protein and helps inhibit Rad51 in dmc1Δ. Without Hed1 phosphorylation, Rad51-mediated recombination occurs and non-crossover chromosomes increase (27483004)
Hek2 は一部の NPC の mRNA に結合して翻訳を抑える。核膜孔の完全性: Hek2 binds some NPC mRNAs and represses their translation. Mutations or physiological changes that impair nuclear pore integrity reduce Ulp1, and SUMOylated Hek2, which cannot bind NPC mRNAs, accumulates. Main text: inactivating Ubc9 abolishes modified Hek2 (29695777)
Hel1・Hel2・Pep5・Snt2 は E2 の Ubc4 と共免疫沈降し、: Hel1, Hel2, Pep5, and Snt2 co-immunoprecipitate with the E2 Ubc4 and act in ubiquitination and degradation of excess histones (22570702)
Hel2 による RQC の活性化は Gcn2 の活性化を抑え、一方の経路を不活: RQC activation by Hel2 suppresses Gcn2 activation, and inactivating one pathway causes excessive activation of the other (33338396). UniProt also states that Gcn2 suppresses RQC activation
Hel2 による RQC の活性化は Gcn2 の活性化を抑える。両者はリボソー: RQC activation by Hel2 suppresses Gcn2 activation. Both are activated by the same drugs that cause ribosome stalling, and inactivating one causes excessive activation of the other (33338396). Loss of Hel2 triggers the ISR via eIF2α phosphorylation (32615089). Consistent with the GO direction
Hfd1 は Tom70 と共精製される。本文では Tom70-TAP の引き下: Hfd1 co-purifies with Tom70. In the main text, Hfd1-HA efficiently co-precipitates in Tom70-TAP pull-downs (weakly with Tom22). The amount of Hfd1 determines the strength of inhibition of mitochondrial import by t-2-hexadecenal (40445107, eLife)
Hho1 と Ume6 は減数分裂初期の遺伝子のプロモーターで結合がよく重なり、: Hho1 and Ume6 binding overlaps substantially at early meiotic gene promoters, and Ume6 promotes Hho1 binding to those promoters (22586276)
Hif1 の TPR2 の酸性領域が Hat1/Hat2 複合体・Asf1・H3: The acidic region of Hif1 TPR2 is essential for physical binding to the Hat1/Hat2 complex, Asf1, and H3/H4 (29661843)
Hip1（ヒスチジン透過酵素）・Gap1 の COPII 小胞への積み込みに S: Shr3 is required for loading Hip1 (histidine permease) and Gap1 into COPII vesicles. Shr3 itself does not enter the vesicles (8909535)
Hir1 と Hir2 は酵母の抽出液から共免疫沈降する（9001207）: Hir1 and Hir2 co-immunoprecipitate from yeast extracts (9001207)
Hir1・Hir2・Hir3・Hpc2 が HIR 複合体を作り、Asf1 と共: Hir1, Hir2, Hir3, and Hpc2 form the HIR complex, which co-purifies with Asf1. HIR and Asf1 together carry out replication-independent histone deposition (16303565)
Hit1 は Rsa1 と結合する C/D snoRNP の形成因子で、Rsa1: Hit1 is a C/D snoRNP assembly factor that binds Rsa1 and is required to maintain steady-state levels of Rsa1. NMR structure of the Rsa1-Hit1 complex (25170085)
Hmg2 は Hrd1 のユビキチンリガーゼによる調節された ERAD で分解さ: Hmg2 is degraded by regulated ERAD through the Hrd1 ubiquitin ligase. Hrd1 is rate-limiting for retrotranslocation
Hmt1 が U1 snRNP の Snp1 をメチル化する。HMT1 がないと: Hmt1 methylates Snp1 of the U1 snRNP. Without HMT1, the Snp1–Npl3 association increases (20823272)
Hmt1 による Rpc31 のメチル化は通常時は tRNA 転写を促し、ストレ: Methylation of Rpc31 by Hmt1 promotes tRNA transcription normally and strengthens repression under stress through binding to Maf1 (31160378)
Hmt1 の集合と活性化は Dbf2 が促し Pph22 が打ち消す。飢餓とラパ: Assembly and activation of Hmt1 are promoted by Dbf2 and counteracted by Pph22. Starvation and rapamycin activate Pph22 (23706744)
Hmt1 は Npl3 と Hrp1 をメチル化し、Hmt1 を欠くと両者は核か: Hmt1 methylates Npl3 and Hrp1, and without Hmt1 neither can exit the nucleus (9499403). Arginine methylation is required for nuclear export of Npl3, Hrp1, and Nab2, but does not affect localization of nucleolar proteins (Gar1, Nop1, Nsr1) (12756332)
Hmt1 またはその触媒活性を欠く変異体では、テロメアの境界領域への Rpd3: In mutants lacking Hmt1 or its catalytic activity, Rpd3 recruitment to telomeric boundary regions increases and H4K5ac changes (22953000)
Hmt1 を欠くと Npl3 と Hrp1 が核から出られず、Hmt1 の過剰発: Without Hmt1, Npl3 and Hrp1 cannot exit the nucleus, and Hmt1 overexpression increases nuclear export of Npl3 (9499403). Npl3 with all RGG Arg changed to Lys exits the nucleus without Hmt1, so methylation acts directly on Npl3 transport (15998636). Hmt1 methylates the Npl3 RGG to promote transcription elongation and suppress termination at cryptic terminators. Methylation-mimicking substitutions alleviate the hmt1Δ defects (20053728)
Hof1 の N 末端の半分は芽の首と極性成長の部位に局在する。芽の首への局在は: The N-terminal half of Hof1 localizes to the bud neck and sites of polarized growth. Bud neck localization is mainly due to the interaction of the second N-terminal coiled-coil with the septin Cdc10 (sites of polarized growth are due to the F-BAR domain)
Hof1 は F-BAR ドメインで Chs4 の Sel1 様繰り返しに結合し: Hof1 binds the Sel1-like repeats of Chs4 through its F-BAR domain and suppresses Chs3-mediated chitin synthesis during cytokinesis. Hof1 is also required for rapid accumulation of Chs4 at the division site and its efficient removal. A mechanism timing activation of chitin synthase III
Hof1 は極性成長のあいだフォルミン Bnr1 の活性を直接制御する。試験管内: Hof1 directly controls the activity of the formin Bnr1 during polarized growth. In vitro, Hof1 suppresses Bnr1 nucleation and elongation, and mutants lacking the C-terminal half of Hof1 have disordered cable orientation and shape and impaired secretory vesicle transport (24719456). The Hof1 F-BAR binds the Bnr1 FH2 to stop nucleation, and without the F-BAR cables are disordered and secretion is defective (30076201)
Hog1 が Pbs2 の S248 を直接リン酸化する。題名どおり正のフィード: Hog1 directly phosphorylates Pbs2 S248. As the title states, positive feedback (switching Hog1 phosphorylation from distributive to processive)
Hog1 が Sho1 の Ser166 をリン酸化してオリゴマーを単量体にし、: Hog1 phosphorylates Sho1 Ser166, converting oligomers to monomers, and a phosphomimetic mutation weakens Hog1 activation (negative feedback)
Hog1 による Rgc1・Rgc2 のリン酸化で両者が Fps1 から外れ、チ: Phosphorylation of Rgc1 and Rgc2 by Hog1 releases both from Fps1, closing the channel (26024902)
Hog1 の標的のうち DAK1 プロモーターは Sko1 だけに完全に依存する: Among Hog1 targets, the DAK1 promoter depends completely on Sko1 alone (32804965)
Hog1 は Aft1 と結合し S210・S224 を直接リン酸化する。この部: Hog1 binds Aft1 and directly phosphorylates S210 and S224. Phosphomimetic forms at these sites export Aft1 from the nucleus and abolish iron accumulation in isc1Δ. In isc1Δ, Hog1–Aft1 binding decreases, and Aft1 is dephosphorylated and activated (29032057). The effect of Hog1 loss itself is not described in the abstract and is a "likely" inference, so confidence is medium
Hog1 は Rpd3 と結合し、ストレスで Rpd3 を浸透圧応答遺伝子へ運ぶ: Hog1 binds Rpd3 and, under stress, brings Rpd3 to osmoresponsive genes. This is required for gene induction (14737171)
Hog1 は Sic1 の C 末端の 1 残基をリン酸化し、サイクリン発現の低: Hog1 phosphorylates a single C-terminal residue of Sic1, and together with reduced cyclin expression stabilizes Sic1 and arrests the cell cycle in G1. With site-mutant Sic1, G1 arrest does not occur and cells are osmosensitive (PMID 15448699). BioGRID's 21698101 and 24643376 are inhibitor papers and do not describe the action on Sic1
Hog1 は Smp1 と結合し、浸透圧ストレスで Smp1 は Hog1 に依: Hog1 binds Smp1, and under osmotic stress Smp1 is phosphorylated in a Hog1-dependent manner. Hog1 phosphorylates the C-terminus of Smp1 in vitro. Mutants that cannot be phosphorylated by the MAPK have impaired stress responses, and phosphorylation is essential for Smp1 function (12482976)
Hog1 は Whi5 と共調節因子 Msa1 に結合してリン酸化し、それが G: Hog1 binds and phosphorylates Whi5 and the co-regulator Msa1, which is essential for repression of G1 cyclin expression (25733686)
Hog1 は伸長因子 Spt4 の T42・S43 をリン酸化し、このリン酸化は: Hog1 phosphorylates T42 and S43 of the elongation factor Spt4, and this phosphorylation is essential for the overall transcriptional response to osmotic stress. Spt4 phosphorylation increases Pol II elongation at stress-responsive genes and is important for survival under hyperosmolarity (29155810)
Hog1 は核膜孔の Nup1・Nup2・Nup60 を直接リン酸化し、浸透圧ス: Hog1 directly phosphorylates the nuclear pore proteins Nup1, Nup2, and Nup60, and under osmotic stress these bind stress-responsive gene promoters in a Hog1-dependent manner (23645671)
Hog1 は核膜孔の Nup1・Nup2・Nup60 を直接リン酸化する。Nup: Hog1 directly phosphorylates the nuclear pore proteins Nup1, Nup2, and Nup60. Non-phosphorylatable Nup1 or Nup2 mutants have reduced expression of stress-responsive genes. Deletion has a larger effect, so phosphorylation accounts for part of it (23645671)
Hog1 は自分を活性化する Ssk2 を複数の部位でリン酸化する。リン酸化され: Hog1 phosphorylates Ssk2, its own activator, at multiple sites. In non-phosphorylatable Ssk2 mutants, feedback restraint and control of Hog1 basal activity are partly impaired
Hoi1 は Fmp27/Hob1 と Hob2 を ER-PM 接触部位へ向け: Hoi1 is an adaptor that targets Fmp27/Hob1 and Hob2 to ER-PM contact sites. Loss of binding disrupts sterol homeostasis (41746219)
Hoi1 is an adaptor that targets Fmp27/Hob1 and Hob2 to ER-PM contact sites (41746219)
Hom6 の基質 ASA が蓄積すると、Pho85 と Cdk8 を介して Gc: When ASA, the substrate of Hom6, accumulates, Gcn4 degradation is accelerated via Pho85 and Cdk8, weakening the GAAC response (25079372)
Hop1 のリン酸化 T318 が Mek1 を呼び込み基礎的な活性化を、リン酸: Phosphorylated T318 of Hop1 recruits Mek1 for basal activation, and phosphorylated S298 supports stable Hop1–Mek1 binding and the hyperactivation of Mek1 required for the checkpoint in dmc1 (26225562)
Hos1 が Smc3 の脱アセチル化を担う。コヒーシンは染色体に結合している間: Hos1 is responsible for deacetylation of Smc3. Cohesin is protected while bound to chromosomes and is deacetylated when released at anaphase onset (20832720)
Hot1 は Hog1 を標的プロモーターに運び、Hot1 依存プロモーターでの: Hot1 brings Hog1 to target promoters, and assembly of the transcription machinery at Hot1-dependent promoters requires active Hog1. Hot1 phosphorylation is not required for this
Hot13 は Mia40 と結合し、Erv1 による Mia40 の酸化を体内: Hot13 binds Mia40 and enhances Erv1-mediated oxidation of Mia40 in vivo and in vitro. Without Hot13, import of Mia40 substrates drops (18787558)
Hpc2 の NHRD が Hir2 の WD40 ドメインに結合。結晶構造と界: The NHRD of Hpc2 binds the WD40 domain of Hir2. Confirmed by crystal structure and interface mutations (40449483)
Hph1 と Hph2 はツーハイブリッドで互いに結合し、小胞体に共局在する。高: Hph1 and Hph2 bind each other in two-hybrid assays and co-localize to the ER. They act redundantly in growth under high salt, alkaline, and cell wall stress (15189990)
Hph1・Hph2 は分割ユビキチン法で Sec63/Sec62 複合体の Se: In the split-ubiquitin assay, Hph1/Hph2 bind Sec71 of the Sec63/Sec62 complex, and also bind Sec72, Sec62, and Sec63 (21097665)
Hpm1p はリボソームに結合した Rpl3p をメチル化する（遊離の Rpl3: Hpm1p methylates ribosome-bound Rpl3p (but not free Rpl3p). Rpl3p methylation depends on Hpm1p (24865971)
Hrp1 の NLS は Kap104 と結合し KAP104 依存で取り込まれ: The Hrp1 NLS binds Kap104 and is imported in a KAP104-dependent manner (10506153). The Hrp1 PY-NLS is required for import, receptor binding, and function (18343812)
Hrq1 ヘリカーゼは自らの触媒活性に依存して Pso2 ヌクレアーゼを促し、I: The Hrq1 helicase stimulates the Pso2 nuclease dependent on its own catalytic activity, and also stimulates nuclease activity past an ICL in vitro. Genetically it also acts in ICL repair via the Pso2 pathway (32371399). Consistent with the GO direction. The stimulation was measured in vitro, so confidence is medium
Hrr25 は Pin4 と結合し、Pin4 のリン酸化に必要（39858641: Hrr25 binds Pin4 and is required for Pin4 phosphorylation (39858641)
Hrr25 は Puf3 を直接リン酸化し、ミトコンドリアのタンパク質の mRN: Hrr25 directly phosphorylates Puf3 and suppresses the Puf3 function of reducing mRNAs of mitochondrial proteins. hrr25 mutation reduces Puf3 phosphorylation in vivo and lowers expression of reporters carrying the 3′UTRs of Puf3 targets (32317286)
Hrr25 は Rps3 と Enp1 をリン酸化し、リン酸化された Rps3・: Hrr25 phosphorylates Rps3 and Enp1, and phosphorylated Rps3/Enp1 dissociate more readily from pre-40S (16738661)
Hrr25 は Tif6 を試験管内・生体内で S174 にリン酸化し、60S: Hrr25 phosphorylates Tif6 at S174 in vitro and in vivo, which is important for 60S subunit formation (18256024)
Hrr25 はエンドサイトーシス部位に最も早く現れるタンパク質の一つ。Ede1: Hrr25 is one of the earliest proteins to appear at endocytic sites. Ede1 is a target of Hrr25 and is required to recruit Hrr25 to the sites. Phosphorylation of Ede1 by Hrr25 is required for their binding and makes site initiation efficient (25625208)
Hrr25 はカーゴ受容体 Atg19 をリン酸化して活性化し、カーゴを足場 A: Hrr25 phosphorylates and activates the cargo receptor Atg19, linking cargo to the scaffold Atg11 and promoting selective autophagy (24968893). Hrr25 phosphorylation strengthens binding of Atg19/Atg36 to Atg11 (25287303). BioGRID's 40930532 is a paper on Hrr25 autophosphorylation
Hrr25 はペキソファジー受容体 Atg36 と Cvt 受容体 Atg19: Hrr25 phosphorylates the pexophagy receptor Atg36 and the Cvt receptor Atg19, strengthening their binding to Atg11 (25287303). Pex3 promotes Hrr25-mediated phosphorylation of Atg36, and phosphorylation increases Atg36–Atg11 binding to initiate pexophagy (32958557). 35404228 is a paper showing that Pex1/6 suppress this phosphorylation
Hse1 の SH3 ドメインが脱ユビキチン化酵素 Ubp7 に結合する（170: The SH3 domain of Hse1 binds the deubiquitinating enzyme Ubp7 (17079730)
Hse1 は PY 配列で直接、また新規タンパク質 Hua1 を介して Rsp5: Hse1 connects to Rsp5 directly via a PY motif and also via the novel protein Hua1. Hua1 recruits a complex of Rsp5, Rup1, and Ubp2 (17079730)
Hse1 は新規タンパク質 Hua1 を介しても Rsp5 とつながる（1707: Hse1 also connects to Rsp5 via the novel protein Hua1 (17079730)
Hsf1 の C 末端の塩基性領域を欠く・変えると、非典型の HSE を持つ C: Deleting or altering the C-terminal basic region of Hsf1 weakens the heat shock response of CUP1 and HSP26, which have non-canonical HSEs (11453649). Altering the perfect HSE of HSP26 slows the heat shock response and weakens HSF binding (8463277)
Hsl1 と Hsl7 は Cdc5 を芽の首に正しく局在させ、Cdc5 による: Hsl1 and Hsl7 are required for correct localization of Cdc5 to the bud neck and for Cdc5-mediated phosphorylation of Swe1 (15920482)
Hsl1 の活性化は、セプチンに結合したキナーゼ Elm1 が促す T273 の: Hsl1 activation is due to T273 phosphorylation promoted by the septin-bound kinase Elm1. In elm1 mutants Swe1 degradation does not occur, and phosphomimetic T273E makes Elm1 dispensable (18768748)
Hsl1 は D ボックスと KEN ボックスを持ち、APC-Cdc20 でも: Hsl1 has a D box and a KEN box, is degraded by both APC-Cdc20 and APC-Cdh1, and binds Cdh1 through the KEN box (11562348). APC-Cdh1 degrades Hsl1 in G1, and expressing non-degradable Hsl1 causes caffeine sensitivity and failure to activate the Slt2 pathway (19713762). BioGRID's 18519589, 21460798, and others are Acm1 papers that used Hsl1 as an in vitro substrate
Hsl1 は Pah1 の S748・S773 をリン酸化し、リン酸化型は PA: Hsl1 phosphorylates Pah1 S748 and S773, and the phosphorylated form has one-fifth the catalytic efficiency as a PA phosphatase. Analysis of cells expressing S748A/S773A shows that phosphorylation by Hsl1 promotes membrane phospholipid synthesis at the expense of TAG (39009344). Consistent with the GO direction
Hsl1 は芽の形態形成チェックポイントで Swe1 キナーゼを抑えるキナーゼと: Hsl1 is introduced as a kinase that inhibits the Swe1 kinase in the bud morphogenesis checkpoint (introductory statement, 11562348)
Hsl7 は免疫複合体のキナーゼ測定で Hsl1 にリン酸化され、試験管内で H: Hsl7 is phosphorylated by Hsl1 in immune complex kinase assays and binds Hsl1 and Swe1 in vitro. Hsl7 that has lost binding to Hsl1 cannot localize to the bud neck and cannot inhibit Swe1. Hsl1–Hsl7 binding at the bud neck is required to relieve the Swe1-mediated G2/M delay (11408575)
Hsl7 は転写が抑えられた状態で生体内の H4 R3 の対称ジメチル化を担い、: Hsl7 is responsible for symmetric dimethylation of H4 R3 in vivo under transcriptionally repressed conditions, and binds Rpd3 to repress transcription (30660775)
Hsm3 は Rpt2 の AAA ドメインに直接結合し、Rpt1-Rpt2-R: Hsm3 binds directly to the AAA domain of Rpt2 and is essential as a mediator of Rpt1-Rpt2-Rpn1 assembly (22460800)
Hsp110（Sse1・Sse2）は Hsp104 による脱凝集に必須で、ないと: Hsp110 (Sse1/Sse2) is essential for Hsp104-mediated disaggregation; without it, Hsp104 relocation to aggregates is impaired (28289075)
Hsp70 の Ssb は翻訳後に Sch9 と結合し、TORC1 による Sc: The Hsp70 Ssb binds Sch9 post-translationally and is required for phosphorylation of Sch9 T737 by TORC1. Sch9 not phosphorylated at T737 has greatly reduced kinase activity (29038496)
The Hsp70 Ssb binds Sch9 post-translationally and is required for phosphorylation of Sch9 T737 by TORC1 (29038496)
Hsp70（Ssa1）の S151 のリン酸化は通常の増殖時に Cdk1 によっ: Phosphorylation of Hsp70 (Ssa1) S151 is promoted by Cdk1 during normal growth. The phosphomimetic S151D strongly lowers the heat shock response, does not bind Ydj1 or Sis1, and does not assist refolding of denatured proteins (32205407). This is inferred from phosphomimetic mutations, so confidence is medium
Hsp78 は熱ストレスで凝集した Ssc1 を再可溶化し、不安定化 Ssc1: Hsp78 resolubilizes Ssc1 aggregated by heat stress and rescues the import defect of destabilized Ssc1 mutants (16460754)
Hsp90 と補因子 Tah1 が Pih1 を安定にし、R2TP の働き（bo: Hsp90 and the cofactor Tah1 stabilize Pih1 and maintain R2TP function (accumulation of box C/D snoRNPs) (18268103)
Hsp90 の発現を下げる・阻害剤・変異体の解析から、Hsp90 はヘムによる: Analyses with reduced Hsp90 expression, inhibitors, and mutants show that Hsp90 is indispensable for heme-mediated activation of Hap1 (11751848). Loss of Hsp90 function lowers Hap1 activity at high heme concentrations (15102838)
Hsp90 は体内で Cyr1 と結合し、hsc82-W296A 変異で Cyr: Hsp90 binds Cyr1 in vivo, and the hsc82-W296A mutation reduces Cyr1 levels
Hst1 が BNA2 プロモーターの主な脱アセチル化酵素で、hst1Δ で H: Hst1 is the main deacetylase at the BNA2 promoter, and H4K5/H4K12 acetylation increases in hst1Δ (36007612)
Hst3 の体内での不安定さは SCF(Cdc4) に依存し、Cdk1 部位 T: In vivo instability of Hst3 depends on SCF(Cdc4), and a doubly phosphorylated degron at the Cdk1 sites T380/T384 is required for polyubiquitination by SCF(Cdc4). Degron mutations do not fully stabilize Hst3 but cause a strong growth reduction upon MMS treatment (24648511)
Hst3 は Cdk1 部位 T380・T384 でリン酸化され、二重リン酸化デ: Hst3 is phosphorylated at the Cdk1 sites T380/T384, and the doubly phosphorylated degron is required for polyubiquitination by SCF-Cdc4. Mutation does not fully stabilize Hst3 but reduces fitness (24648511)
Hst3 は試験管内で NAD 依存の脱アセチル化活性をもち、生体内で H3 K: Hst3 has NAD-dependent deacetylase activity in vitro and deacetylates H3 K56 in vivo. Upon DNA damage it is degraded through Mec1-dependent phosphorylation (17977840). Hst3/Hst4 negatively regulate H3 K56 acetylation and are regulated by the cell cycle and the damage checkpoint (16818235)
Hst3/Hst4 は H3 K56 のアセチル化を負に調節し、DNA 損傷では: Hst3/Hst4 negatively regulate H3 K56 acetylation and decrease upon DNA damage in a checkpoint-dependent manner (16818235)
Hsv2 は Atg2 と相互作用し、Atg2 をエンドソームへ呼ぶ。自食作用の: Hsv2 interacts with Atg2 and recruits Atg2 to endosomes. Upon autophagy induction, Atg2 recruits Hsv2 to the PAS (34368840)
Htl1p の RSC への結合は直接で、RSC の中心構成要素 Rsc8p が: Binding of Htl1p to RSC is direct and is mediated by the core RSC component Rsc8p (17400406). Rsc8p physically interacts with Htl1p (12684875)
Htm1-Pdi1 複合体が ERAD の糖鎖シグナルを作り、Htm1 の働きは: The Htm1-Pdi1 complex generates the ERAD glycan signal, and Htm1 function depends on binding to Pdi1 (27053108)
Hub1 は生体内で Sph1・Hbt1 に結合する。hub1 欠失で Hbt1: Hub1 binds Sph1 and Hbt1 in vivo. hub1 deletion disrupts Hbt1/Sph1 localization (11923536)
Hug1 は Rnr2 に直接結合し、その結合に依存して RNR 活性を抑える（: Hug1 binds Rnr2 directly and suppresses RNR activity dependent on this binding (25378334)
Hul5 のプロテアソームへの会合は Ubp6 で強く安定化される。両者はユビキ: Association of Hul5 with the proteasome is strongly stabilized by Ubp6. The two modify ubiquitin chains in opposite directions (17190603)
Hul5 は熱ショック・通常条件で Pin3 などの溶けにくい細胞質タンパク質の: Hul5 is required for ubiquitination of poorly soluble cytoplasmic proteins such as Pin3 under heat shock and normal conditions (21983566)
Hxk2 は α インポーチン Kap60 と β インポーチン Kap95 の: Hxk2 is a cargo of the α-importin Kap60 and the β-importin Kap95. Import and binding to Kap60 depend on glucose and on the NLS at K6–K12. Kap95 helps Kap60 recognize the NLS, and both are indispensable for Hxk2 import (22157003)
Hxk2 は細胞質で解糖、核で Mig1 の標的遺伝子の転写調節に働く。Hxk2: Hxk2 functions in glycolysis in the cytoplasm and in transcriptional regulation of Mig1 target genes in the nucleus. Hxk2 is an export cargo of Crm1 and binds Crm1 through two NESs. S14 phosphorylation promotes binding to Crm1 and drives export (19525230)
Hxt3 の分解には Ras2 と PKA の不活性化が、Hxt7 の分解には: Degradation of Hxt3 requires inactivation of Ras2 and PKA, and degradation of Hxt7 requires inactivation of TORC1 and Ras2. Rim15 is the downstream effector of both degradations (23227176)
Hxt7 の分解には TORC1 と Ras2 の不活性化が要る。tor1-1: Degradation of Hxt7 requires inactivation of TORC1 and Ras2. tor1-1 blocks rapamycin-induced internalization and degradation of Hxt7 (23227176)
Hym1 の局在は Kic1 と Sog2 に依存し、Sog2 と Kic1 は: Hym1 localization depends on Kic1 and Sog2, and Sog2 and Kic1 are required for each other's localization (12972564)
IA3 は酵母の proteinase A を nM 以下で阻害し、ほかのアスパ: IA3 inhibits yeast proteinase A at sub-nM concentrations and does not inhibit other aspartic proteases. It binds the active site in the crystal structure (11042188)
IBD2 は BUB2 の上流に働く BUB2 エピスタシス群（12072457: IBD2 is in the BUB2 epistasis group acting upstream of BUB2 (12072457)
ICRE を持つ遺伝子（ERG20 を含む）は Ino2/Ino4 で活性化され: ICRE-containing genes (including ERG20) are activated by Ino2/Ino4 and repressed by Opi1. Ino2/Ino4 bind the promoter in vitro (16034810)
ICRE を持つ遺伝子（YEL073C を含む）はリン脂質前駆体で調節され、それ: ICRE-containing genes (including YEL073C) are regulated by phospholipid precursors through the activator Ino2/Ino4 and the repressor Opi1. In vitro binding of Ino2/Ino4 is also shown (16034810)
ICS3 の発現は酸性 pH で上がり、CCC2 と同じく pH レギュロンの: ICS3 expression increases at acidic pH and, like CCC2, is controlled by Rim101 of the pH regulon (26127016)
IDH1 と IDH2 の相互作用を two-hybrid で検出し、ヘテロ二量: The IDH1–IDH2 interaction was detected by two-hybrid; the heterodimer is the basic unit, and each subunit contributes to the binding site of its partner (11042198)
IF1・STF1 は生理的な濃度で ATP 加水分解を完全に抑えられるが、ATP: IF1 and STF1 can fully inhibit ATP hydrolysis at physiological concentrations, but ATP synthase has lower affinity for STF1 than for IF1 (12809520)
ILV1 はアミノ酸合成の一般制御で調節され、GCN4 による脱抑制の大きさは基: ILV1 is regulated by general amino acid control, and the magnitude of derepression by GCN4 does not depend on the basal element ILV1BAS (1448083)
IME1 mRNA の翻訳に Rpl22A と Rpl22B が必要で、rpl2: Translation of IME1 mRNA requires Rpl22A and Rpl22B; in rpl22 mutants Ime1 protein decreases and cells cannot enter meiosis (27478489)
IME1 プロモーターの UASru は、グルコースの信号で cAMP/PKA: The UASru of the IME1 promoter is repressed by glucose signaling, with the cAMP/PKA pathway targeting the transcription factors Com2 and Sko1 (24236068)
IMPDH は Ctk1 が CTD の Ser2 をリン酸化したときだけ伸長中: IMPDH is recruited to elongating Pol II only when Ctk1 phosphorylates CTD Ser2. Imd2 interacts genetically with Ctk1 (20097157)
INH1 の欠失は mtDNA を失った yme1 株の増殖欠損を一部抑える。Y: Deletion of INH1 partly suppresses the growth defect of yme1 strains that have lost mtDNA. It is proposed that Yme1 catalyzes degradation of the F1F0-ATPase inhibitor protein (12524335)
INO1・CHO1・CHO2・OPI3 などのリン脂質合成遺伝子は、イノシトール: Phospholipid synthesis genes such as INO1, CHO1, CHO2, and OPI3 require INO2 and INO4 for derepression under inositol deficiency (8614637)
INO1・CHO1・CHO2・OPI3 のイノシトール添加での抑制に OPI1: OPI1 is required for repression of INO1, CHO1, CHO2, and OPI3 upon inositol addition (8614637)
INO1・CHO1・CHO2・OPI3 のリン脂質合成遺伝子は、イノシトール欠乏: The phospholipid synthesis genes INO1, CHO1, CHO2, and OPI3 require INO2 and INO4 for derepression under inositol deficiency (8614637)
INO80 複合体の Ies3 はテロメラーゼの Est1 の TPR ドメイン: Ies3 of the INO80 complex interacts with the TPR domain of the telomerase component Est1 (17562861)
INO80 複合体は γ-H2AX との特異的な結合で HO による二本鎖切断に: The INO80 complex is recruited to HO-induced double-strand breaks through specific binding to γ-H2AX, and this binding requires Nhp10. Without Nhp10, recruitment decreases (15607974)
IPT1 の転写は Pdr1・Pdr3 の活性に応じて変わり、IPT1 プロモー: IPT1 transcription changes with Pdr1/Pdr3 activity and requires the PDRE in the IPT1 promoter. Pdr3 activity correlates with lipid composition (11323424)
IPT1 transcription changes with Pdr1/Pdr3 activity and requires the PDRE in the IPT1 promoter. This is thought to activate sphingolipid synthesis (11323424)
IRA1・IRA2 は RAS-GTP の量を下げる（ira 変異株で RAS1: IRA1/IRA2 lower the level of RAS-GTP (in ira mutants, RAS1 and RAS2 accumulate in the GTP-bound form)
ISC が損なわれると DNA 損傷応答が起き、Sml1 の減少と Rnr2・R: Impaired ISC triggers the DNA damage response, increasing RNR through Sml1 reduction and relocation of Rnr2/Rnr4 to the cytoplasm. In cells lacking Grx5, Dun1 is activated independently of Mec1 and Rad53 (26567217)
ISU1・ISU2 は活性型 Aft1 の株で誘導される（10588895）: ISU1/ISU2 are induced in strains with active Aft1 (10588895)
ITR1 mRNA の脱抑制レベルには INO2 と INO4 が必要（8294: INO2 and INO4 are required for the derepressed level of ITR1 mRNA (8294482). Disruption of INO2 (DIE1) abolishes ITR1 expression (7565092). Main text: ITR1 is always reduced in ino2Δ, ino4Δ, and the double deletion (24456840)
ITT1 と RPS1A は URE2 mRNA の発現に翻訳の段階で影響する（: ITT1 and RPS1A affect URE2 mRNA expression at the translational level (30231023)
IZH 遺伝子群（YLR023c=IZH3 を含む）は亜鉛耐性と Zap1 の活: IZH genes (including YLR023c = IZH3) affect zinc tolerance and Zap1 activity. The direction is not stated in the abstract (15060275)
IZH1 の過剰発現で INO1 の発現が上がり、scs3 欠損株のイノシトール: IZH1 overexpression increases INO1 expression and partly restores growth of scs3 deletion strains under inositol deficiency (41191547)
Ibd2 は Bfa1 と結合し、BUB2 経路で BUB2・BFA1 の上流に: Ibd2 binds Bfa1 and acts upstream of BUB2 and BFA1 in the BUB2 pathway (12072457)
Ice2 は Pah1（リピン）に拮抗して小胞体膜の生合成を促す。Ice2 は: Ice2 antagonizes Pah1 (lipin) to promote ER membrane biogenesis. Ice2 inhibits the Nem1-Spo7 complex, suppressing Pah1 dephosphorylation and activation (34617598)
Icp55 はミトコンドリア処理ペプチダーゼ（MPP）の切断後に Nfs1 の: Icp55 removes three amino acids from the N-terminus of Nfs1 after cleavage by mitochondrial processing peptidase (MPP) (19720832)
Ies2 は Arp5-Ies6 が INO80 の触媒部分と結合するのに要り、: Ies2 is required for Arp5-Ies6 to bind the catalytic part of INO80, and IES2 deletion releases Arp5-Ies6 from chromatin (26306040)
Ifh1 の N 末端のアセチル化は Gcn5 に依存し、Sir2・Hst1 で: N-terminal acetylation of Ifh1 depends on Gcn5 and is removed by Sir2 and Hst1. Acetylation limits the transcriptional activation capacity of Ifh1 (23973296). At the "suggest" stage, so confidence is medium
Ifh1 の RP 遺伝子プロモーターへの結合は、TOR を止めたときや栄養を除: Ifh1 binding to RP gene promoters decreases when TOR is inhibited or nutrients are removed, and recovers upon return from starvation (15616569)
Ifh1 は Fhl1 の FHA ドメインを介して RP 遺伝子のプロモーター: Ifh1 is recruited to RP gene promoters via the FHA domain of Fhl1, and the amount bound determines the level of transcription
Ifh1 は Fhl1 の FHA ドメインを介してプロモーターに呼び込まれ、結: Ifh1 is recruited to promoters via the FHA domain of Fhl1, and the amount of bound Ifh1 determines the transcription level of RP genes. Under stress, only Ifh1 binding decreases (15616568)
Ime1 の体内での活性は cAMP/PKA 経路により Rim11 を介して抑: Ime1 activity in vivo is suppressed by the cAMP/PKA pathway via Rim11
Ime2 と Cdk1 は重なる基質群をリン酸化し、APC(Cdh1) と複製起: Ime2 and Cdk1 phosphorylate overlapping sets of substrates and overlap functionally in inhibition of APC(Cdh1) and of origin licensing. Ime2 sites are poorly dephosphorylated by Cdc14 (17349956). Ectopic expression of IME2 in G1 cells phosphorylates Cdh1 and stops degradation of APC substrates such as mitotic cyclins (11917129). The latter is an ectopic expression experiment, so confidence is medium
Ime2 は体内で Ime1 と結合し、試験管内で Ime1 をリン酸化する。I: Ime2 binds Ime1 in vivo and phosphorylates Ime1 in vitro. In diploids lacking IME2, Ime1 increases, and in haploids overexpressing IME2, Ime1 becomes unstable. Ime1 levels depend on Ime2 kinase activity, and Ime1 is degraded by the 26S proteasome (11884593)
Ime2 依存の Rfa2 のリン酸化は減数分裂の初期に起こり、S27 が生体内: Ime2-dependent phosphorylation of Rfa2 occurs early in meiosis, and S27 is required for phosphorylation in vivo and in vitro. Ime2 phosphorylates an S27-containing peptide (16294044)
Iml1 は Npr2・Npr3 と複合体をつくり Gtr1 の GAP として: Iml1 forms a complex with Npr2 and Npr3 and acts as a GAP for Gtr1. Upon amino acid removal, Iml1 transiently binds Gtr1 at the vacuolar membrane, promotes GTP hydrolysis, and lowers TORC1 activity (23716719). Npr2-Npr3-dependent GTP hydrolysis by Gtr1 is involved in TORC1 inactivation and autophagy induction (25046117)
Iml1（Npr2・Npr3 との複合体 SEACIT）は Gtr1 の GAP: Iml1 (SEACIT, the complex with Npr2/Npr3) is a GAP for Gtr1 and, upon amino acid deprivation, promotes GTP hydrolysis by Gtr1 and lowers TORC1
Imp1 と Som1 は物理的に結合する。som1 欠失で Imp1 の基質: Imp1 and Som1 bind physically. In som1 deletion, the Imp1 substrates Cox2 and Mcr1 are not processed (10821182)
Imp2'（YIL154C）はグルコース脱抑制で Leloir 経路の遺伝子と活: Imp2' (YIL154C) promotes expression of Leloir pathway genes and the activator GAL4 upon glucose derepression (14558142)
Ina22 と Ina17 は INA 複合体の構成要素で、F1 部分と周辺軸に: Ina22 and Ina17 are components of the INA complex and bind the F1 part and the peripheral stalk (24942160)
Inn1 は Cdk1 と Cdc14 の直接の基質。Cdk1 による Inn1: Inn1 is a direct substrate of Cdk1 and Cdc14. Phosphorylation of Inn1 by Cdk1 partly blocks binding to Cyk3 and reduces Cyk3 at the division site. Cdc14 co-localizes with Inn1 at the division site, counteracts Cdk1 phosphorylation, and promotes Inn1-Cyk3 complex formation (22454527). The action of Cdc14 itself is stated as a proposal, so confidence is medium
Inn1 は M-Cdk1 と Cdc14 の直接の基質。Cdk1 による In: Inn1 is a direct substrate of M-Cdk1 and Cdc14. Phosphorylation of Inn1 by Cdk1 partly blocks binding of Inn1 to Cyk3 and reduces Cyk3 at the division site. Cdc14 counteracts this, promoting Inn1-Cyk3 complex formation and cytokinesis (22454527). The effect is partial, so confidence is medium
Ino2 と Ino4 はそれぞれ独立に Apl2 に結合し、両方あるとより強く: Ino2 and Ino4 each bind Apl2 independently and bind more strongly when both are present (17090927)
Ino2 の RID は Opi1 の結合に必要十分で、RID の変異体は Op: The RID of Ino2 is necessary and sufficient for Opi1 binding; RID mutants are not repressed even by Opi1 overexpression and constitutively express ICRE genes. Mutations in the Opi1 AID abolish repressor function (15819625). In the presence of inositol and choline, activation by Ino2 is suppressed by Opi1 bound to Ino2 (18542964)
Ino2 の活性化ドメインは試験管内で Taf1・Taf4・Taf6・Taf10: The Ino2 activation domain binds Taf1, Taf4, Taf6, Taf10, and Taf12 in vitro (28994223)
Ino2・Ino4・Apl2 は三者複合体をつくり、Ino2 と Ino4 は: Ino2, Ino4, and Apl2 form a ternary complex, and Ino2 and Ino4 bind the same region of Apl2 (17090927)
Inp1 は N 末端で PI(4,5)P2 に、C 末端で Pex3 に結合し: Inp1 binds PI(4,5)P2 via its N-terminus and Pex3 via its C-terminus, tethering the peroxisomal membrane to the plasma membrane (32970792)
Ipa1 の変異で Ysh1 が減り、転写中の遺伝子への C/P 複合体の呼び込: Ipa1 mutation reduces Ysh1 and impairs recruitment of the C/P complex to transcribed genes. Ysh1 overexpression corrects the termination defect of ipa1 mutants (30759400). The ipa1-1 mutation does not reduce other C/P subunits but greatly reduces only Ysh1. YSH1 mRNA is unchanged, and blocking the proteasome prevents the decrease (32009536)
Ipi3 は M→G1 期の Cdc6・Cdt1・MCM のクロマチンへの載せ込: Ipi3 is required for loading Cdc6, Cdt1, and MCM onto chromatin in M→G1 and for maintaining the pre-RC in G1 (22421151)
Ipi3 は ORC・Noc3 依存で ARS のクロマチンに結合し、M→G1: Ipi3 binds ARS chromatin in an ORC- and Noc3-dependent manner and is required for loading Cdc6, Cdt1, and MCM onto chromatin in M→G1 and for maintaining the pre-RC in G1 (22421151)
Ipk1 による IP6 の産生は Gle1 による mRNA の運び出しに要り: IP6 production by Ipk1 is required for Gle1-mediated mRNA export, and IP6 production in the cytoplasm is sufficient (15459192). A synthetic lethal screen with gle1 mutants found Plc1 and two inositol polyphosphate kinases, and mutation of any of them impairs IP6 synthesis and mRNA export (10390371). InsP6 greatly increases Dbp5 ATPase activity dependent on Gle1 (in vitro, 16783363)
Ipl1 による She1 のリン酸化は、後期後半に She1 が微小管の脱重合: Phosphorylation of She1 by Ipl1 helps She1 act in microtubule depolymerization and shortening of the spindle halves in late anaphase (25213170). Ipl1 directly phosphorylates She1, and this modification appears to enhance She1 diffusion on microtubules and its ability to inhibit dynein (23142046)
Ipl1 による Sli15 のリン酸化は体内・試験管内で Sli15 の微小管: Phosphorylation of Sli15 by Ipl1 suppresses Sli15 binding to microtubules in vivo and in vitro; mimicking phosphorylation delocalizes the CPC in metaphase and interferes with the tension checkpoint (24558497). Sli15 phosphorylation is required for Ipl1 activation (23814063)
Ipl1 の部位を Ala にした dam1-3A では動原体と微小管の付着が生: In dam1-3A, with Ipl1 sites changed to Ala, kinetochore–microtubule attachment is stabilized in vivo, bipolar attachment after nocodazole is delayed, and chromosomes missegregate (28928489). The high affinity of the Dam1 complex for microtubules is lowered by phosphorylation of the Ipl1 target S20, making it detach more easily (18364702). 12408861 also identifies Dam1 as the main Ipl1 target regulating attachment
Ipl1 は Mad3 の残基をリン酸化し、2 か所のリン酸化を防ぐと動原体の張: Ipl1 phosphorylates residues of Mad3, and preventing phosphorylation at two sites greatly impairs the response to lack of tension at kinetochores (17504936)
Ipl1 は試験管内で Ndc10 をリン酸化し、それを通して動原体を調節すると: Ipl1 phosphorylates Ndc10 in vitro, and it is proposed to regulate the kinetochore through this (10072382)
Ipl1/Aurora B は対合複合体の解体の主な調節因子。Ipl1 またはそ: Ipl1/Aurora B is the main regulator of synaptonemal complex disassembly. Without Ipl1 or its activity, the synaptonemal complex assembles normally, but the central element Zip1 and SUMO cannot be removed from chromosomes in a timely manner (19759266)
Ipp1 は核と細胞質にあり、核では不安定。核への標的化でユビキチン化と Ubp: Ipp1 is in the nucleus and cytoplasm and is unstable in the nucleus. Nuclear targeting increases ubiquitination and binding to Ubp3 (30826332)
Iqg1 の CHD を挟む 4 つの Cdk 部位をリン酸化できない iqg1: iqg1-4A, which cannot be phosphorylated at the four Cdk sites flanking the Iqg1 CHD, forms the actin ring before anaphase. Cdc14 overexpression causes early actin ring formation, and inactivating Cdc14 prevents it. Cdc14 binds Iqg1 and dephosphorylates these sites in vitro, and iqg1-4A rescues the actin ring defect of cdc14-1 (26085509)
Ira2 は Ras2 の GTPase を活性化する GAP（Ras2 に特異: Ira2 is a GAP that activates the GTPase of Ras2 (specific to Ras2)
Irc10 の前胞子膜の先端への局在は SSP1 に依存し、ADY3 には依存し: Localization of Irc10 to the leading edge of the prospore membrane depends on SSP1 but not ADY3 (24390141)
Irc5 はコヒーシンの Scc1 と結合し、コヒーシンのクロマチンへの結合に寄: Irc5 binds the cohesin subunit Scc1 and contributes to cohesin binding to chromatin (28383696)
Ire1 は HAC1 mRNA の 2 か所のスプライス部位を切る部位特異的エ: Ire1 is a site-specific endoribonuclease that cleaves the two splice sites of HAC1 mRNA (9323131). Splicing replaces the C-terminus of Hac1, making it less prone to degradation (8898193)
Isa1 と Isa2 は複合体を作り、アコニターゼ・ホモアコニターゼなどミトコ: Isa1 and Isa2 form a complex and are required for maturation of mitochondrial [4Fe-4S] proteins such as aconitase and homoaconitase. Iba57 interacts specifically with Isa1 and Isa2 (21987576)
Isa1・Isa2 と特異的に相互作用する Iba57 を減らすと Isa タン: Depleting Iba57, which interacts specifically with Isa1 and Isa2, causes iron to accumulate on Isa proteins. Isa1, Isa2, and Iba57 form a late-acting system of mitochondrial [4Fe-4S] maturation (21987576)
Isa2（と Isa1）の欠乏で Bio2 の Fe/S クラスターは作られるが: In Isa2 (and Isa1) deficiency, the Fe/S cluster of Bio2 is formed, but catalytic activity in vivo is lost (17259550)
Isc1 による加水分解の産物が Pgc1 の活性を一部抑える（36377885: The products of Isc1-mediated hydrolysis partly inhibit Pgc1 activity (36377885)
Isc10 は APC/C-Ama1 と減数分裂特異的 MAPK Smk1 をつ: Isc10 is an inhibitor linking APC/C-Ama1 and the meiosis-specific MAPK Smk1. In meiosis I it forms an inhibited complex with Smk1, and after meiosis II it is ubiquitinated and degraded in an Ama1-dependent manner, allowing Ssp2 to activate Smk1 (32423992). Consistent with the GO direction
Isd11 は Nfs1 と安定な複合体をつくり、Isd11 がないと Nfs1: Isd11 forms a stable complex with Nfs1, and without Isd11, Nfs1 tends to aggregate (16341090). Required for Fe/S cluster formation on Isu (16341089)
Ist1 の N 末端ドメインは ESCRT-III の Did2 に特異的に結: The N-terminal domain of Ist1 binds specifically to the ESCRT-III protein Did2, and a co-crystal revealed the mode of binding to the C-terminal MIM1 of Did2 (19477918)
Ist1 は Did2 を介して Vps4 の呼び込みを正に制御し、Ist1-V: Ist1 positively controls Vps4 recruitment via Did2 and negatively controls Vps4 by forming an Ist1–Vps4 heterodimer (18032582)
Ist2 が C 末端の結合部位で Osh6・Osh7 を ER-PM 接触部位: Ist2 directly recruits Osh6/Osh7 to ER-PM contact sites through its C-terminal binding site, and this binding is required for PS transport and PE synthesis (34259806)
Isw1 の SANT・SLIDE ドメインは Isw1b 複合体（Isw1・I: The SANT and SLIDE domains of Isw1 are required for formation of the Isw1b complex (Isw1, Ioc2, Ioc4) (19273607)
Isw1 の SUMO 化が補因子 Ioc3 との結合を促し・安定させ、Isw1: SUMOylation of Isw1 promotes and stabilizes binding to the cofactor Ioc3 and recruits the Isw1-Ioc3 complex to chromatin (28899943)
Isw1b 複合体は Isw1・Ioc2・Ioc4 からなる。ISW1b はヌク: The Isw1b complex consists of Isw1, Ioc2, and Ioc4. ISW1b is mainly responsible for nucleosome spacing and resolving dinucleosomes (19273607, 33602956)
Isw2p-Itc1p 複合体は通常 INO1 の発現を抑える（11489850: The Isw2p-Itc1p complex normally represses INO1 expression (11489850)
Ivy1 の働きには Ypt7 との結合が要る（29674454）。Ypt7 の: Ivy1 function requires binding to Ypt7 (29674454). The Ypt7-binding site is required for Ivy1 localization (37259913)
Ivy1 は Fab1 複合体を阻害し PI(3,5)P2 の量に直接影響する。: Ivy1 inhibits the Fab1 complex and directly affects PI(3,5)P2 levels. Overexpression stops Fab1 activity and vacuole fragmentation during osmotic shock (29674454)
Izh2 の過剰で鉄に応じた Fet3 の誘導が起こらない。この働きには PKA: Excess Izh2 prevents iron-responsive induction of Fet3. This effect requires PKA and the AMP-dependent kinase (17553578)
JEN1 は Mig1p と Mig2p に負に調節され、非発酵性の増殖での脱抑: JEN1 is negatively regulated by Mig1p and Mig2p, and Cat8p is required for its derepression during non-fermentative growth (10628872)
Jac1 の過剰発現は体内で Isu を分解から守る（26842892）: Jac1 overexpression protects Isu from degradation in vivo (26842892)
Jhd2（KDM5）は試験管内で H3K4me1/2/3 を脱メチル化し、欠失で: Jhd2 (KDM5) demethylates H3K4me1/2/3 in vitro; in the deletion, K4 methylation increases during GAL1 activation and the decrease of K4me3 upon repression is delayed (17875926). The decrease of H3K4me3 in H3 HAT mutants is reversed by JHD2 deletion, and H3K14ac inhibits Jhd2 (23091032)
Jjj1 がないと Arx1・Alb1 が pre-60S に結合したまま細胞質: Without Jjj1, Arx1 and Alb1 remain bound to pre-60S and accumulate in the cytoplasm. Jjj1 is mainly required for release of Arx1 and Alb1 (17652132)
KAP120 欠失で Rpl11b-GFP が核にたまる（60S の核外輸送の目: KAP120 deletion causes Rpl11b-GFP to accumulate in the nucleus (a marker of 60S nuclear export) (11071906)
KDX1 の過剰発現で RCK1 の発現が大きく上がる（マイクロアレイ・ノーザン: KDX1 overexpression greatly increases RCK1 expression (microarray, Northern). Mutation of the Rlm1-binding site suppresses the induction (23660188)
KNH1 の転写は炭素源と kre9 欠失に依存するが SKN7 には依存しない: KNH1 transcription depends on the carbon source and kre9 deletion but not on SKN7 (8810042) (PMID: 8810042)
KNR4 の過剰発現で CHS1・CHS2・CHS3 の mRNA が減り、α: KNR4 overexpression reduces CHS1, CHS2, and CHS3 mRNA and also suppresses α-factor induction of CHS1 (10206705)
Kap104 を除くと Nab2 がすぐ細胞質に移る（8849456）。Nab2: Removing Kap104 causes Nab2 to move rapidly to the cytoplasm (8849456). The rg-NLS of Nab2 binds Kap104 and is imported in a KAP104-dependent manner (10506153)
Kap114 は SUMO 化され、SUMO 化は Kap114 による核内輸送: Kap114 is SUMOylated, and SUMOylation is required for Kap114-mediated nuclear import. Of the four SUMO E3s, Mms21 mainly SUMOylates Kap114. The K909R mutant stays in the nucleus and is defective in transport (22562154)
Kap120 は Rpf1 の核への取り込み受容体。試験管内で直接結合し Ran: Kap120 is the nuclear import receptor for Rpf1. It binds directly in vitro and is released by Ran-GTP (16581791)
Kap120・Kap114・Nmd5 を欠く株で Rpf1 の核への取り込みが損: Nuclear import of Rpf1 is impaired in strains lacking Kap120, Kap114, and Nmd5 (16581791)
Kap121（Pse1）は Dam1 と Duo1 に結合し、生体内での Dam: Kap121 (Pse1) binds Dam1 and Duo1, and the in vivo stability of the Dam1 complex depends on this binding (26947076)
Kap123 が Nbp1 の両親媒性ヘリックスの隣の NLS に結合し、膜への: Kap123 binds the NLS next to the amphipathic helix of Nbp1, preventing nonspecific binding to membranes. Nbp1 imported into the nucleus binds the inner membrane (21785410)
Kap95 が Slt2 と Rlm1 の核への取り込みを担う（19930464: Kap95 mediates nuclear import of Slt2 and Rlm1 (19930464)
Kap95 の働きを下げるとホスファチジルコリン合成がほぼ失われる（Pct1 が: Reducing Kap95 function nearly abolishes phosphatidylcholine synthesis (even when Pct1 is outside the nucleus) (19141610)
Kap95 は Kap60 による Hxk2 の NLS の認識を助け、両方のイ: Kap95 helps Kap60 recognize the Hxk2 NLS, and both importins are indispensable for nuclear import of Hxk2 (22157003)
Kap95 を失うと Mbp1 は主に細胞質に見える。Mbp1 に Kap95: When Kap95 is lost, Mbp1 appears mainly cytoplasmic. Mbp1 has two redundant NLSs dependent on Kap95 and Srp1. Nuclear accumulation is not completely abolished even in kap95 mutants (20587033)
Kap95 を欠く細胞で RPA サブユニット（Rfa1・Rfa2・Rfa3）が: In cells lacking Kap95, the RPA subunits (Rfa1, Rfa2, Rfa3) remain mainly in the cytoplasm. Kap95 is the main nuclear import factor for RPA (21332387)
Kar2 の ATPase 活性は Sil1 と Lhs1 の 2 つのヌクレオ: The ATPase activity of Kar2 is enhanced by two nucleotide exchange factors, Sil1 and Lhs1, which bind by different mechanisms (20430899)
Kar3 が S 期と中期に微小管のプラス端を追うには Cik1 が必要。後期で: Cik1 is required for Kar3 to track microtubule plus ends in S phase and metaphase. It is not required in anaphase (37305999)
Kar5 の SPB 局在に要るドメインがあり、その局在は Mps3 に依存（2: Kar5 has a domain required for SPB localization, and this localization depends on Mps3 (25467943)
Kar5 は SPB のそばに局在し、Prm3 を SPB のそばに呼び込む。K: Kar5 localizes near the SPB and recruits Prm3 near the SPB. SPB localization of Kar5 depends on Mps3 (25467943)
Kar9 は動原体微小管で STUbL の Slx5-Slx8 によりプロテアソ: Kar9 on kinetochore microtubules is targeted for proteasomal degradation by the STUbL Slx5-Slx8; when it cannot be degraded, chromosome segregation and spindle positioning are defective (26906737)
Kcc4 と Gin4 はどちらも試験管内で Swe1 と結合する（127738: Kcc4 and Gin4 both bind Swe1 in vitro (12773812)
Kcc4 は試験管内・生体内でセプチンと結合し（2 ハイブリッド・GST プルダ: Kcc4 binds septins in vitro and in vivo (two-hybrid, GST pull-down, immunoprecipitation, purified proteins), and its main partner is Cdc11 (11165249)
Kch1・Kch2 は HACS の活性化に必要で、過剰発現すると細胞外 K+: Kch1/Kch2 are required for HACS activation, and when overexpressed they activate HACS in an extracellular K+-dependent manner (23204190). Kch1 increases under ER stress and is required for HACS activation (24142703)
Kdx1 の過剰発現で RCK1 が誘導され、それには Rlm1 と RCK1: Kdx1 overexpression induces RCK1, which requires Rlm1 and the Rlm1-binding site in the RCK1 5'UTR. Kdx1 binds Rlm1 (23660188)
Kdx1 は Rlm1 と物理的に結合し、Rlm1 の RCK1 5'UTR へ: Kdx1 physically binds Rlm1 and influences Rlm1 binding to the RCK1 5'UTR. Kdx1 increases RCK1 expression via Rlm1 (23660188)
Kei1 と Aur1 は生体内で複合体をつくり、Kei1 のない Aur1 に: Kei1 and Aur1 form a complex in vivo, and Aur1 without Kei1 has almost no IPC synthase activity. Kei1 is essential for activity and Golgi localization (19726565)
Kei1 はゴルジ中層に局在し、後期ゴルジのエンドペプチダーゼ Kex2 に切断: Kei1 localizes to the medial Golgi and is cleaved by the late-Golgi endopeptidase Kex2 (19726565)
Kel1 と Kel2 は Lte1・Tem1 の両方と複合体にあり、分裂期から: Kel1 and Kel2 are in complexes with both Lte1 and Tem1 and negatively regulate mitotic exit (12234925)
Kel1 はフェロモン経路の雑音を抑え、Ste5 と Far1 の膜への動員を抑: Kel1 suppresses noise in the pheromone pathway and suppresses membrane recruitment of Ste5 and Far1. Only hypophosphorylated Kel1 suppresses signaling, and the MAPK Fus3 contributes to Kel1 phosphorylation (34965431)
Kel1・Kel2 は Bud14 と 520 kDa の安定な複合体（Bud1: Kel1 and Kel2 form a stable 520 kDa complex with Bud14 (Bud14/Kel1/Kel2 = 2:2:1) (24828508)
Kel1・Kel2 は Bud14 と同じ経路で Bnr1 によるアクチンケーブ: Kel1/Kel2 regulate Bnr1-mediated actin cable formation in the same pathway as Bud14; without them, cables become long and stable (24828508)
Kel1・Kel2 は細胞抽出液中で Bud14 と 520 kDa の安定な複: Kel1 and Kel2 form a stable 520 kDa complex (2:2:1 Bud14/Kel1/Kel2) with Bud14 in cell extracts (24828508)
Kes1 は Pik1 が作るゴルジ体の PI-4P の働きを抑えてゴルジ由来の: Kes1 suppresses the function of Golgi PI-4P made by Pik1 and regulates Golgi-derived vesicular transport (17881569)
Kes1/Osh4 は Sec14 依存の膜輸送を抑える。G1/S の抑制では: Kes1/Osh4 suppresses Sec14-dependent membrane trafficking. In G1/S repression, Sec14 antagonizes it (29396115)
Kex1 はゴルジで MNN1 依存に段階的に N-糖鎖修飾される（146904: Kex1 undergoes stepwise MNN1-dependent N-glycan modification in the Golgi (1469044)
Kha1p による K+ のトランスゴルジ網への取り込みが Fet3p への銅の: K+ uptake into the trans-Golgi network by Kha1p promotes copper binding to Fet3p (title and abstract, 26966178)
Khd1 は ASH1 mRNA の制御を介して FLO11 の転写を間接に抑え: Khd1 indirectly represses FLO11 transcription through control of ASH1 mRNA, and also represses FLO11 by a post-transcriptional mechanism independent of ASH1. Khd1 binds directly to repeat sequences in FLO11 mRNA, and this binding represses translation (20382833)
Khd1 は ASH1 mRNA の局在要素 E1 と eIF4G1 に結合して: Khd1 binds the ASH1 mRNA localization element E1 and eIF4G1 and represses translation. The casein kinase Yck1 phosphorylates Khd1 at the plasma membrane, dissociating the Khd1-RNA complex and relieving translational repression (17588515)
Khd1 は ASH1 mRNA の局在配列 E1 と eIF4G1 の C 末: Khd1 binds the ASH1 mRNA localization element E1 and the C-terminus of eIF4G1, lowering translation initiation of ASH1 mRNA and reducing leakage of Ash1 into the mother cell nucleus. When Yck1 phosphorylates Khd1 at the plasma membrane, the complex breaks down and translational repression is relieved (17588515)
Khd1 は Ash1 を翻訳の抑制で負に、Mtl1 を mRNA の安定化で正: Khd1 negatively controls Ash1 through translational repression and positively controls Mtl1 through mRNA stabilization. The reduction of MTL1 mRNA in khd1Δ is restored by DCP1, DCP2, or XRN1 mutations (20953064)
Kic1 は Cbk1 の HM 部位をリン酸化し、MO25 類縁の Hym1: Kic1 phosphorylates the HM site of Cbk1 and is allosterically activated by the MO25-related Hym1. Kic1–Hym1 binding is cell cycle-regulated and coincides with the peak of Cbk1 HM-site phosphorylation (24205201)
Kic1 は Cbk1 の HM 部位を直接リン酸化し、Kic1 は MO25: Kic1 directly phosphorylates the HM site of Cbk1, and Kic1 is allosterically activated by the MO25-related Hym1. HM-site phosphorylation is required for full Cbk1 activation. After mitotic exit, Hym1 binds and activates Kic1, strongly phosphorylating the Cbk1 HM site and promoting transcription of cell separation genes (24205201)
Kin1/Kin2 は HAC1 mRNA のプロセシングに寄与し、Pal2 の: Kin1/Kin2 contribute to HAC1 mRNA processing via Pal2 phosphorylation (34035143). In kin1Δ kin2Δ, HAC1 splicing and translation decrease, and high expression of Kin1 or Kin2 complements the UPR defect of 3′BE mutants (25348718)
Kin1・Kin2 は t-SNARE Sec9 と結合し、体内で Sec9 の: Kin1 and Kin2 bind the t-SNARE Sec9 and cause Sec9 phosphorylation in vivo, promoting its release from the plasma membrane (15563607)
Kin28 が精製系で Med4 をリン酸化し、生体内のリン酸化にも一部関わる。: Kin28 phosphorylates Med4 in a purified system and is partly involved in its phosphorylation in vivo. The site is Thr237 (15126497)
Kin28 と Hnt1 は物理的に結合し、hnt1 と kin28-ts は遺: Kin28 and Hnt1 bind physically, and hnt1 and kin28-ts interact genetically (10958787). The AMP phosphoramidase activity of Hnt1 supports the function of Kin28, Ccl1, and Tfb3 (11805111)
Kin28 は Bur1 の呼び込みを促して Spt5 のリン酸化を高める（22: Kin28 promotes Bur1 recruitment and increases Spt5 phosphorylation (22796944)
Kin28 は CTD をリン酸化し、体内で mRNA の転写を正に調節する（7: Kin28 phosphorylates the CTD and positively regulates mRNA transcription in vivo (7760796). The capping enzyme is recruited to Ser5-phosphorylated CTD, and only Kin28 of TFIIH is required for this recruitment (10594013). In 9702190, unlike Srb10, Kin28 phosphorylates the CTD after the initiation complex forms and acts positively
Kin3(scNek2) はヒトと酵母の Hec1 に結合する（12386167: Kin3 (scNek2) binds human and yeast Hec1 (12386167)
Kin4 と、より小さく Frk1 がペルオキシソームの輸送を調節し、母細胞で: Kin4 and, to a lesser extent, Frk1 regulate peroxisome transport and protect Inp2 from degradation in the mother cell (37509134)
Kip1 と Cin8 は Clb2/Cdc28 の試験管内の標的で、Kip1: Kip1 and Cin8 are in vitro targets of Clb2/Cdc28, and mutation of the Kip1 CDK sites blocks spindle pole separation without changing localization or levels. Two sites in the Kip1 tail are phosphorylated in vivo (20463882)
Kip2 と Bim1 の結合は Mck1 によるリン酸化で負に調節され、Mck: Kip2–Bim1 binding is negatively regulated by Mck1 phosphorylation, and Mck1-dependent phosphorylation also lowers Kip2 affinity for microtubules. When Kip2 phosphorylation decreases, astral microtubules are stabilized and Kip2, dynein, and Kar9 accumulate at microtubule plus ends (26395399). Mck1 phosphorylates Kip2 in vivo and in vitro, and S63A reduces phosphorylation (main text)
Kip3 の微小管不安定化の働きが Stu2/XMAP215 による重合に拮抗し: The microtubule-destabilizing activity of Kip3 antagonizes Stu2/XMAP215-mediated polymerization, stopping spindle elongation at the appropriate length (24616221)
Knr4 は Slt2 と物理的に結合する。knr4 欠失では Slt2 に依存: Knr4 binds Slt2 physically. In knr4 deletion, Slt2-dependent activation of Rlm1 is greatly reduced and Rlm1 transcriptional activity decreases, whereas phosphorylated Slt2 is higher than in wild type (12823808)
Knr4 は TYS1 のチロシル tRNA 合成酵素とツーハイブリッドと GS: Knr4 binds strongly to the tyrosyl-tRNA synthetase TYS1 in two-hybrid and GST pull-down assays (11410349)
Kre2 と Ktr1 のゴルジ局在は Svp26 に依存し、試験管内の COP: Golgi localization of Kre2 and Ktr1 depends on Svp26, and in in vitro COPII budding experiments Svp26 helps ER export of Kre2/Ktr1 (24585773)
Kre28–Spc105 の相互作用は Spc105 のタンパク質の回転に重要で: The Kre28–Spc105 interaction is important for Spc105 protein turnover and is essential for their mutual assembly at kinetochores (35042402)
Kre33 は 18S rRNA と tRNA のシトシンをアセチル化し、tRN: Kre33 acetylates cytosines of 18S rRNA and tRNA, and tRNA acetylation requires Tan1 (25653167)
Krh1 は触媒サブユニットを介して PKA に直接結合し、Krh1/2 は体内: Krh1 binds PKA directly via the catalytic subunit, and Krh1/2 strengthen binding of catalytic and regulatory subunits in vivo. Strong suppression of PKA targets by Krh1/2 is independent of Gpa2 and depends on both catalytic and regulatory subunits (16924114). Deletion of gpb1 gpb2 increases invasive growth even in cells with only one of Tpk1-3 and increases phosphorylation of Sfl1 and Msn2 (independently of cAMP) (16278446)
Kri1 と Krr1 は共免疫沈降し、krr1 変異タンパク質は Kri1 と: Kri1 and Krr1 co-immunoprecipitate, and the krr1 mutant protein binds Kri1 weakly. Both are required for 18S rRNA synthesis (11027267)
Krr1 と Faf1 の結合を特異的に壊すと 18S rRNA の初期のプロセ: Specifically disrupting Krr1–Faf1 binding impairs early 18S rRNA processing and is lethal, but does not prevent incorporation of either into pre-ribosomes (24990943)
Kss1 の活性化は Tec1 の SUMO 化を減らし、Tec1 の転写活性を: Kss1 activation reduces Tec1 SUMOylation and increases Tec1 transcriptional activity (19826484). During invasive growth, Kss1 controls Tec1 function mainly through TEC1 expression and, unlike Fus3, does not send Tec1 for degradation (15558284)
Kti12 は Elongator に直接結合し、ATP 加水分解が tRNA: Kti12 binds Elongator directly, and ATP hydrolysis is required for tRNA anticodon modification. Main text: the binding partner is Elp1 (30916349)
Kti13(Ats1) は Elongator の相手 Kti11 と共精製され: Kti13 (Ats1) co-purifies with the Elongator partner Kti11, and this binding requires the Kti13 C-terminus (18466297)
Ku による末端の保護がないと MRX の要求は迂回され、削り込みは Exo1: Without end protection by Ku, the requirement for MRX is bypassed and resection is carried out by Exo1 (20729809). In resection experiments with purified proteins, Ku and MRX regulate Exo1 nuclease activity in opposite directions (20834227)
L40 の欠乏で 60S の成熟が妨げられ、その欠陥は細胞質の pre-60S: L40 depletion blocks 60S maturation, and the defect is thought to be due to reduced release of Nmd3 and Rlp24 from cytoplasmic pre-60S and their return to the nucleus (22995916)
L469K 変異は Bdp1 の TFIIIB-TFIIIC-DNA 複合体への: The L469K mutation also reduces incorporation of Bdp1 into the TFIIIB-TFIIIC-DNA complex and Bdp1–Tfc4 binding (12930823)
LEU3 は LEU2 に加え LEU1・LEU4・ILV2 のプロモーターに試: LEU3 binds the promoters of LEU1, LEU4, and ILV2 in addition to LEU2 in vitro, and by inference also ILV5 (3043190)
LEU4 の転写産物の量は LEU3 に影響される（2823102）。LEU4: LEU4 transcript levels are affected by LEU3 (2823102). A test promoter carrying the LEU4 binding sequence is activated by Leu3 (3043190)
LIC/Dyn3 はダイニンの働きに必須で、HC/Dyn1 の細胞表層の点への局: LIC/Dyn3 is essential for dynein function, and localization of HC/Dyn1 to cortical foci depends on both IC and LIC (15642746)
LIP2 と LIP5 は Lat1・Kgd2・Gcv3 の 3 つのリポイル化: LIP2 and LIP5 are required for lipoylation of all three of Lat1, Kgd2, and Gcv3 (19570983)
LIP3 は Lat1 と Kgd2 のリポイル化に必要で、Lip3 の酵素活性: LIP3 is required for lipoylation of Lat1 and Kgd2, and Lip3 enzyme activity is indispensable (19570983)
LMA1（チオレドキシンと I(B)2）は液胞への結合に Sec18 を要する（: LMA1 (thioredoxin and I(B)2) requires Sec18 for binding to vacuoles (9657146)
LSM5・LSM6・LSM7 の欠失で LHP1 が増殖に必須になる。Lhp1: Deletion of LSM5, LSM6, or LSM7 makes LHP1 essential for growth. Lhp1 stabilizes U6 snRNA redundantly with the Lsm2-8 complex (11333229)
LSO1 のプロモーターに Aft1/2 の結合配列が 3 つあり、LSO1-l: The LSO1 promoter has three Aft1/2-binding sequences, and LSO1-lacZ is strongly induced under low iron in an Aft1-dependent manner (26450372)
LST8 は TOR2 の C 末端キナーゼ領域に結合し、TORC2 の構造の保: LST8 binds the C-terminal kinase region of TOR2 and regulates maintenance of TORC2 structure and kinase activity (16002396)
LYS 経路の酵素は LYS14 産物を介して誘導され、LYS1 などの mRN: LYS pathway enzymes are induced via the LYS14 product, and measurements of LYS1 and other mRNAs show this induction acts at the transcriptional level (3123231)
LYS14 の産物が 2-アミノアジピン酸セミアルデヒド存在下でリシン合成系の酵: The LYS14 product induces lysine biosynthetic enzymes in the presence of 2-aminoadipate semialdehyde, and without induction LYS9 expression is low (3123231)
La と Rex1 は RNA の 3' 末端を奪い合い、Lhp1p の過剰発現: La and Rex1 compete for the RNA 3' end, and Lhp1p overexpression reduces trimming of pre-tRNA by Rex1p (18456844)
Laa2 は Laa1 と AP-1 の両方に結合し、その γ-ear 結合モチ: Laa2 binds both Laa1 and AP-1, and its γ-ear-binding motif is essential for Laa1–AP-1 binding (30523155)
Lag2 は NEDD 化されていない Cdc53 に直接結合し、体内でも試験管: Lag2 binds directly to non-neddylated Cdc53 and blocks its neddylation in vivo and in vitro. Overexpression of Lag2 in strains defective in Skp1 or neddylation suppresses Cdc53 function (19942853)
Lam2 と Lam4 がないと Dgr2 は小胞体-細胞膜接触部位にとどまらな: Without Lam2 and Lam4, Dgr2 is not retained at ER-plasma membrane contact sites. Lam2/Lam4 bind Laf1 and Dgr2 in vitro (33255682)
Without Lam2 and Lam4, Dgr2 is not retained at ER-plasma membrane contact sites (33255682)
Lam2・Lam4 がないと Laf1 は ER-PM 接触部位に留まらない。L: Without Lam2/Lam4, Laf1 is not retained at ER-PM contact sites. Lam2/Lam4 bind Laf1 in vitro (33255682)
Las1 に依存して Grc3 の一本鎖 RNA へのキナーゼ活性が上がる（28: Grc3 kinase activity toward single-stranded RNA increases in a Las1-dependent manner (28652339)
Las1 エンドリボヌクレアーゼの C2 部位での特異的な切断には結合相手のキナ: Specific cleavage at the C2 site by the Las1 endoribonuclease requires its binding partner, the kinase Grc3 (in vitro and in vivo) (28652339)
Las17 に結合する SH3 タンパク質 Sla1 と Bbc1 は、精製して: The Las17-binding SH3 proteins Sla1 and Bbc1, when purified, cooperatively suppress Las17 activity (12814545)
Las17 は Sla1 と安定な複合体（SLAC）を作り、Sla1 は Las: Las17 forms a stable complex (SLAC) with Sla1, and Sla1 suppresses Las17 activity. In in vitro polymerization assays, suppression by Sla1 depends on the class I/II polyproline sequences of Las17 and is due to competition with monomeric actin. In living cells, this binding is also important for Las17 recruitment, suppression during the first 20 seconds, and efficient endocytosis (22973053)
Ldb16 は Fld1 と ER-脂肪滴の接点で複合体をつくり、Fld1 が無: Ldb16 forms a complex with Fld1 at ER–lipid droplet contacts and is degraded by ERAD without Fld1 (24434579)
Ldb18 はダイナクチンの構成要素。ldb18Δ で Nip100 と Jnm: Ldb18 is a component of dynactin. In ldb18Δ, Nip100–Jnm1 binding is lost while Jnm1–Arp1 binding is retained (18245366)
Ldb19/Art1・Rod1・Rog3 が Ste2 の脱感作と取り込みに働き: Ldb19/Art1, Rod1, and Rog3 act in Ste2 desensitization and internalization, and Ldb19 and Rod1 recruit Rsp5 to Ste2 (24820415)
Ldb19・Rod1・Rog3 の 3 つの α-アレスチンが Ste2 の脱感: Three α-arrestins, Ldb19, Rod1, and Rog3, act in Ste2 desensitization and internalization (24820415). Efficient pheromone-induced internalization of Ste2 requires binding to Rod1, and Rod1 recruits Rsp5 to ubiquitinate the receptor tail (26920760)
Ldm1 は Myo2 の球状尾部と脂肪滴表面の Ldo16 に結合し、アクチン: Ldm1 binds the globular tail of Myo2 and Ldo16 on the lipid droplet surface, enabling actin-dependent lipid droplet movement (41201089)
Ldo16/45 は Vac8 とつなぎ留めの複合体を作り、液胞と脂肪滴の接触部: Ldo16/45 form a tethering complex with Vac8, creating vacuole–lipid droplet contact sites (38367622)
Lds 遺伝子の欠失で細胞壁ストレスセンサー Wsc1 が細胞膜から液胞へ誤選別: Deletion of Lds genes causes the cell wall stress sensor Wsc1 to be missorted from the plasma membrane to the vacuole (27216456)
Lds1・Lds2・Rrt8 は増殖中の細胞で脂肪滴に局在し、Lds 遺伝子の欠: Lds1, Lds2, and Rrt8 localize to lipid droplets in growing cells, and deletion of Lds genes causes Wsc1 to be mistransported from the plasma membrane to the vacuole (27216456)
Lea1 は Yib9（Msl1）と直接結合し、Lea1 の U2 snRNA: Lea1 binds Yib9 (Msl1) directly, and Lea1 binding to U2 snRNA requires Yib9 (9799242)
Lem3-Dnf1 は細胞膜のアミノリン脂質トランスロカーゼ複合体で、Dnf1: Lem3-Dnf1 is a plasma membrane aminophospholipid translocase complex, and Lem3 is required for Dnf1 localization to the plasma membrane (16600184)
Leo1 は Paf1C の RNA への結合に必要で、leo1 欠失で Paf: Leo1 is required for Paf1C binding to RNA, and leo1 deletion reduces Paf1C association with transcribed regions (20732871)
Leu1 の安定な結合には CIA 標的化複合体全体が要るが、Rad3 の認識は: Stable binding of Leu1 requires the entire CIA targeting complex, whereas recognition of Rad3 needs only the Met18-Cia2 subcomplex (28539047)
Leu3 は LEU1・LEU4・ILV2 のプロモーターの CCGGNNCCG: Leu3 binds CCGGNNCCGG in the LEU1, LEU4, and ILV2 promoters in vitro, and test promoters carrying this sequence are activated by Leu3 (3043190)
Leu3 は UGA4 と UGA1 の発現を負に制御する（21708130）。: Leu3 negatively controls expression of UGA4 and UGA1 (21708130). This repression is mediated by Dal80, and in the absence of GATA factors Leu3 acts as an activator (29058647)
Leu4 と Leu9 は生体内でヘテロ二量体を作り（BiFC）、精製した異種二: Leu4 and Leu9 form heterodimers in vivo (BiFC), and the purified heterodimer shows distinct leucine sensitivity (25841022)
Lge1 は Rad6・Bre1 と複合体にあり、Lge1 を欠くと Bre1: Lge1 is in a complex with Rad6 and Bre1; without Lge1, Bre1 recruitment weakens and Ubp8 recruitment increases. H2B K123 ubiquitination is lost (19923226)
Lge1 を欠く細胞では Ubp8 の呼び込みが進む（19923226）: In cells lacking Lge1, Ubp8 recruitment increases (19923226)
Lic4 は生体内でリン酸化タンパク質で、試験管内でカルシニューリンの基質。野生: Lic4 is a phosphoprotein in vivo and a calcineurin substrate in vitro. In wild type it is nuclear, and without calcineurin it is mainly cytoplasmic (10102375)
Lif1 の SUMO 化は Siz の SUMO リガーゼを要し、K301R: Lif1 SUMOylation requires the Siz SUMO ligases; K301R abolishes SUMOylation and increases NHEJ (23571759). Main text: in the siz1Δ siz2Δ double deletion, Lif1 SUMOylation is lost, and Siz1 and Siz2 act redundantly
Lif1 の SUMO 化は細胞周期を通じて起こり Siz の SUMO リガー: Lif1 SUMOylation occurs throughout the cell cycle and requires the Siz SUMO ligases. K301R completely abolishes SUMOylation both in vivo and in vitro, and NHEJ increases in lif1-K301R cells. SUMOylation is thought to suppress Lif1 self-association and single-stranded DNA binding (23571759). Main text: siz1Δ or siz2Δ alone has little effect, and the double deletion abolishes Lif1 SUMOylation (Siz1 and Siz2 are redundant)
Lif1 の T417 などの変異は Xrs2-Lif1 の結合を失わせ、Xrs: Mutations of Lif1 such as T417 abolish Xrs2–Lif1 binding and impair NHEJ in the same pathway as Xrs2 FHA mutations. Disrupting both Yku80–Dnl4 and Xrs2–Lif1 binding abolishes NHEJ and ligase IV assembly (18832348)
Lnp1 と Sey1 は Rtn1・Yop1・Pom33・Per33 と物理的: Lnp1 and Sey1 bind physically to Rtn1, Yop1, Pom33, and Per33 (26041935)
Lnp1 と Sey1 は、核膜孔に役割をもつ ER の構成要素（Rtn1・Yo: Lnp1 and Sey1 bind physically to ER components with roles at nuclear pores (Rtn1, Yop1, Pom33, Per33) (26041935)
Loc1 は単独で RPL43 mRNA に結合し、mRNA の安定性と翻訳を下: Loc1 alone binds RPL43 mRNA and lowers mRNA stability and translation (34661244)
Lpx1 のペルオキシソームへの取り込みは PTS1 受容体 Pex5 に依存し: Import of Lpx1 into peroxisomes depends on the PTS1 receptor Pex5 and occurs by piggyback transport (18199283)
Lre1 は Cbk1-Mob2 の触媒活性の直接の阻害因子で、後期の終わりに分: Lre1 is a direct inhibitor of the catalytic activity of Cbk1-Mob2; it concentrates at the division site at the end of anaphase and binds Mob2 and Cbk1 in vivo and in vitro. This binding is weakened by mitotic Cdk1 activity and strengthened by Cdc14 at the end of mitosis. Inhibition by Lre1 is required for survival of cells lacking the actomyosin ring pathway (23954433). Consistent with the GO direction
Lre1 は Cbk1-Mob2 の触媒活性を直接抑える。Lre1 と Cbk1: Lre1 directly inhibits the catalytic activity of Cbk1-Mob2. Lre1–Cbk1-Mob2 binding is weakened by mitotic Cdk1 and strengthened by Cdc14 at the end of mitosis (23954433)
Lre1 は NDR キナーゼ Cbk1-Mob2 を直接抑える。Lre1 が: Lre1 directly inhibits the NDR kinase Cbk1-Mob2. The ability of Lre1 to bind Cbk1-Mob2 is weakened by mitotic Cdk1 activity and strengthened by Cdc14 at the end of mitosis (23954433). BioGRID's 14574415 is a high-throughput screen
Lre1 は NDR キナーゼ Cbk1-Mob2 を直接阻害する。Lre1 が: Lre1 directly inhibits the NDR kinase Cbk1-Mob2. The ability of Lre1 to bind Cbk1-Mob2 is weakened by mitotic Cdk1 activity and strengthened by Cdc14 at the end of mitosis. Inhibition of Cbk1 by Lre1 is required for survival of cells without the actomyosin ring (23954433)
Lrg1 の GAP ドメインは試験管内で Rho1 の GTP 加水分解を強く: The Lrg1 GAP domain strongly and specifically promotes GTP hydrolysis by Rho1 in vitro, and β-1,3-glucan deposition increases in lrg1Δ (15514049). lrg1 mutations restore the glucan synthesis defect of fks1 and rho1 mutants, and Lrg1 binds active Rho1. Of the eight Rho GAPs, only Lrg1 negatively regulates glucan synthase (11447600). Consistent with the GO and UniProt direction
Lsb1・Lsb2 は試験管内で Las17 によるアクチン重合を抑え、Lsb1: Lsb1/Lsb2 suppress Las17-mediated actin polymerization in vitro, Lsb1 more strongly (23577202)
Lsb5 の Sla1（HD1 ドメイン）・Las17 との結合部位を決めた（1: The binding sites of Lsb5 for Sla1 (HD1 domain) and Las17 were determined (15651983)
Lsb5 は活性型 Arf3 とユビキチンに結合し、Lsb5 の正しい表層への局: Lsb5 binds active Arf3 and ubiquitin, and correct cortical localization of Lsb5 requires Arf3 expression (15651983)
Lsm1〜Lsm7 の変異で mRNA の脱キャップが妨げられ、Lsm1-7 は: Mutations in Lsm1–Lsm7 block mRNA decapping, and Lsm1-7 co-precipitates with the decapping enzyme (Dcp1) and Pat1 (10761922). Deletion of LSM1, 6, 7, or PAT1 extends reporter mRNA half-life, and the accumulating mRNA remains capped, stalled at the decapping step (10747033)
Lsm2-8 環の結晶構造で並びは Lsm3-2-8-4-7-5-6（24240: In the crystal structure of the Lsm2-8 ring, the order is Lsm3-2-8-4-7-5-6 (24240276). Lsm2 and Lsm4 are thought to contact Lsm8 (11333229)
Lsm2・Lsm3 が Pat1C と Lsm1-7 複合体の結合をつなぐ。結晶: Lsm2/Lsm3 bridge binding of Pat1C to the Lsm1-7 complex. The crystal structure and structure-based mutations show this is important for activating decapping in vivo (24247251)
Lsm3 の八量体は酵母の抽出液から Lsm6・Lsm2・Lsm5 を直接引き寄: The Lsm3 octamer directly pulls down Lsm6, Lsm2, and Lsm5 from yeast extracts (18329667)
Lsm7 の相分離した凝集体が足場となり Pab1 の分離とストレス顆粒の形成を: Phase-separated Lsm7 condensates serve as a scaffold promoting Pab1 demixing and stress granule formation. lsm7 deletion reduces granule formation (35764627)
Lst4-Lst7 複合体は Gtr2 の GAP として働き、アミノ酸飢餓の細: The Lst4-Lst7 complex acts as a GAP for Gtr2 and concentrates at the vacuolar membrane in amino acid-starved cells. Upon amino acid re-addition, Lst4-Lst7 transiently binds and acts on Gtr2, activating TORC1. The Rag form that promotes TORC1 is GTP-bound Gtr1 with GDP-bound Gtr2 (26387955)
Ltc1 はミトコンドリアの Tom70/71 を介して ER-ミトコンドリア接: Ltc1 localizes to ER–mitochondria contact sites via mitochondrial Tom70/71 (25987606)
Ltc1 は液胞の Vac8 を介して ER-液胞接触部位に局在（2598760: Ltc1 localizes to ER–vacuole contact sites via vacuolar Vac8 (25987606)
Lte1 に Tem1 の GEF 活性は見られず、代わりに Lte1 は SP: No GEF activity of Lte1 toward Tem1 is seen; instead, Lte1 determines Bfa1 localization on the SPB. Under conditions where Lte1 is essential, Lte1 causes loss of Bfa1 from the mother SPB, and placing Lte1 in the mother cell of cells with misoriented spindles removes Bfa1 from one SPB and bypasses the checkpoint (19948498)
Lte1 の皮質への定着はアクチンに依らず、START での Cdc28/Cln: Cortical anchoring of Lte1 is actin-independent and requires Cdc28/Cln activation at START and Cdc42 (12432084)
Lte1 は Kin4 と結合してキナーゼ活性を抑え、Kin4 の過剰リン酸化を: Lte1 binds Kin4 and suppresses its kinase activity, promoting Kin4 hyperphosphorylation so that it binds only the mother SPB (21670215). Bud-localized Lte1 prevents Kin4 that leaks into the bud from binding the daughter SPB (21709215). Lte1 inhibits the small amount of Kin4 in the bud through its central region (27798238)
Ltn1 と Rqc1 は Cdc48 を 60S 粒子へ呼び込むのに必須（23: Ltn1 and Rqc1 are essential for recruiting Cdc48 to 60S particles (23479637)
Lto1 の欠乏で Rli1 の Fe-S 成熟が損なわれる。Lto1 は CI: Lto1 depletion impairs Fe-S maturation of Rli1. Lto1 binds the CIA targeting complex, and Yae1 binds Rli1 (26182403)
Ltp1 が Fpr3 を脱リン酸化し、生体内の Fpr3 のリン酸化部位は T: Ltp1 dephosphorylates Fpr3, and the in vivo phosphorylation site of Fpr3 is Tyr184 (15358193)
Luv1（VPS54）は Rbl2 を含む複合体として単離される（9914379: Luv1 (VPS54) is isolated as a complex containing Rbl2 (9914379)
Lys20 は DNA 損傷部位に呼ばれ、過剰発現で INO80 複合体の損傷部: Lys20 is recruited to DNA damage sites, and its overexpression increases INO80 complex assembly at damage sites and restores histone eviction (25628362)
Lys5 が CoA を使って Lys2 の Ser880 をホスホパンテテイン: Lys5 uses CoA to phosphopantetheinylate Lys2 Ser880, making it catalytically competent (10320345)
MAC1 活性型で FRE7 が恒常的に発現し、mac1-1 では発現しない。M: In active MAC1, FRE7 is constitutively expressed, and in mac1-1 it is not expressed. Mac1 is the decisive transcriptional activator of FRE7 (9726978). Mac1 activates six genes including FRE7 (10922376)
MAP キナーゼによる Ste7 のフィードバックのリン酸化は Kss1 の活性: Feedback phosphorylation of Ste7 by MAP kinases weakens Kss1 activation but not Fus3 activation (22875986). In BioGRID's 8455599, Fus3 is required for Ste7 hyperphosphorylation, but this is stated not to be decisive for the activation outcome. The output to Fus3 is unchanged, so confidence is medium
MAS1 と MAS2 が MPP の 2 つのサブユニットをコードする（306: MAS1 and MAS2 encode the two subunits of MPP (3061808). The purified enzyme consists of two non-identical subunits and loses activity when they are separated (2905264)
MCK1 過剰発現が cbf2 の温度感受性を抑圧し、精製 Mck1 が試験管内: MCK1 overexpression suppresses the temperature sensitivity of cbf2, and purified Mck1 phosphorylates Cbf2 in vitro (7854321)
MDG1 は bem1 変異の多コピー抑圧因子としても単離された。欠損は Gβ: MDG1 was also isolated as a multicopy suppressor of bem1 mutations. Its loss causes sterility in cells with partially defective Gβ (8914522)
MECA の調節は減数分裂の転写因子 Ndt80 に支配され、Ndt80 は I: MECA regulation is governed by the meiotic transcription factor Ndt80, which promotes Ime2 activation (30538140)
MED7・MED10（NUT2）の高コピーが med21-ts を抑圧し、Med: High copy MED7 and MED10 (NUT2) suppress med21-ts, and Med21–Med10 binding was confirmed by co-immunoprecipitation (16758199)
MEN のキナーゼ Cdc15 はまず足場 Nud1 をリン酸化してリン酸化ドッ: The MEN kinase Cdc15 first phosphorylates the scaffold Nud1 to create a phospho-docking site, to which Dbf2-Mob1 binds and is activated by Cdc15 (23579499)
MEP2 の高い転写には Gln3 か Nil1(Gat1) の少なくとも一方が: High MEP2 transcription requires at least one of Gln3 or Nil1 (Gat1) (9234685)
MET1 はウロポルフィリノーゲン III メチル基転移酵素、MET8 は脱水素: MET1 is uroporphyrinogen III methyltransferase, and MET8 is a dehydrogenase and chelatase; together they carry out siroheme synthesis (10051442)
MET3・MET28 の上流では Met4 は Met28 と Met31 また: Upstream of MET3 and MET28, Met4 binds the AAACTGTG sequence as a complex with Met28 and Met31 or Met32 (9799240)
Upstream of MET3 and MET28, Met4 binds as a complex with Met28 and Met31 or Met32 (9799240)
MET4 は MET10 ほか硫酸同化遺伝子の転写活性化因子（8787893）: MET4 is a transcriptional activator of MET10 and other sulfate assimilation genes (8787893)
MET4 は硫酸の同化の誘導に必要な転写活性化因子で、その leucine zi: MET4 is a transcriptional activator required for induction of sulfate assimilation, and its leucine zipper is required for recognition of the MET25 (MET17) promoter. Regulation of MET25 by AdoMet depends on MET4 and CBF1 (1549123)
MEU1 の多コピーで UAS2 依存の発現が上がり、MEU1 の破壊で ADH: Multicopy MEU1 increases UAS2-dependent expression, and disruption of MEU1 reduces ADH2 expression to about half (8807288)
MFG1 の産物は形態形成の転写因子 Flo8 と Mss11 に結合し、糸状成: The MFG1 product binds the morphogenetic transcription factors Flo8 and Mss11 and is essential for transcriptional regulation of filamentous growth (22984072)
MFα2 の Asn-5,Arg-7 ペプチドは MFα1 の α 因子と同じ増: The Asn-5,Arg-7 peptide of MFα2 has the same growth arrest and morphological change activity as the α-factor of MFα1, and does not cause growth arrest in MATa ste2(Ts) mutants. Both pheromones act on the receptor in the same way (3536883)
MG で GPD1・GLO1・GRE3 の発現が誘導され、その応答は Msn2/: MG induces expression of GPD1, GLO1, and GRE3, and the response partly depends on Msn2/Msn4 (15773992)
MHF1 と MHF2 はヒストン様の折りたたみをとりヘテロ四量体を作る。四量体: MHF1 and MHF2 adopt histone-like folds and form a heterotetramer. Tetramer formation is essential for DNA repair (22325783)
MICOS は Mic27/Mic10/Mic12 と Mic60/Mic19: MICOS consists of two subcomplexes, Mic27/Mic10/Mic12 and Mic60/Mic19 (25918844)
MIG1 は GAL4 に加えて GAL1 のプロモーターにも結合し、GAL 遺: MIG1 binds the GAL1 promoter in addition to GAL4, doubly repressing GAL genes (1915298)
MIT1 を含む 37 遺伝子が FLO11 の誘導を通じてバイオフィルムを制御: 37 genes including MIT1 control biofilm formation through induction of FLO11 (confirmed by Northern) (25009170)
MKC7 は kex2 変異の多コピー抑圧因子で、Mkc7・Yap3 は Kex: MKC7 is a multicopy suppressor of kex2 mutations, and Mkc7/Yap3 are processing enzymes with functions overlapping Kex2 (7479877)
MKT1 の 89G 対立遺伝子が Puf3 の標的 COX17・MRS1・RD: The MKT1 89G allele stabilizes the mRNAs of the Puf3 targets COX17, MRS1, and RDL2 in an allele- and stress-specific manner (37990816)
MKT1 の欠失は HO の mRNA 量をあまり変えずタンパク質量を下げ、HO: MKT1 deletion lowers HO protein levels without much change in HO mRNA levels, dependent on the HO 3′ UTR. PBP1 deletion likewise lowers HO expression at a post-transcriptional step. Mkt1 and Pbp1 co-sediment with polysomes (15082763)
MMT1・MMT2 は低鉄で誘導され Aft1 が必要。MMT1 プロモーターの: MMT1/MMT2 are induced under low iron and require Aft1. The Aft1-binding site in the MMT1 promoter is sufficient for transcriptional induction (31896574)
MMT1・MMT2 は低鉄で誘導され、その誘導に Aft1 が必要（318965: MMT1/MMT2 are induced under low iron, and the induction requires Aft1 (31896574)
MNN6 はマンノシルリン酸転移酵素、MNN4 はその推定上の正の調節因子で、M: MNN6 is a mannosylphosphate transferase, and MNN4 is its putative positive regulator; the amount of Mnn4 is rate-limiting for mannosylphosphorylation (9459307)
MPC3 の発現は NaCl ストレスと発酵から呼吸への移行で強く上がり、どちら: MPC3 expression rises strongly under NaCl stress and upon the shift from fermentation to respiration, both dependent on Hog1 (24244496)
MRP51 の変異は COX2・COX3 の 5'-UTL の変異の翻訳の欠陥を: MRP51 mutations suppress the translational defects of mutations in the 5'-UTLs of COX2 and COX3, and deletion stops mitochondrial gene expression (9528754)
MRPL36 の量を増やすと COX2 mRNA の翻訳欠陥が抑えられる。抑圧に: Increasing MRPL36 levels suppresses the COX2 mRNA translation defect. Suppression does not require the L31 domain; the new N- and C-terminal sequences suffice (15166137)
MRX は Dna2 ヌクレアーゼを DSB 末端に呼び込む（20834227）: MRX recruits the Dna2 nuclease to DSB ends (20834227)
MRX は Exo1 の DSB への集まりを促し、Ku の過剰な結合に拮抗する: MRX promotes Exo1 association with DSBs and antagonizes excessive Ku binding (20834227)
MRX 複合体は分裂期に特異的に Cdc28/Cdk1 に依存してリン酸化され、: The MRX complex is phosphorylated specifically in mitosis in a Cdc28/Cdk1-dependent manner, and loss of Xrs2/Mre11 phosphorylation strongly biases repair toward NHEJ (24553123)
MSC6 は QRS1/HER2 の変異の多コピー抑圧因子。過剰発現しても異常な: MSC6 is a multicopy suppressor of QRS1/HER2 mutations. Overexpression does not eliminate aberrant Cox2 translation (26780366)
MSE に結合する負の調節因子 Sum1 は体細胞分裂の増殖中に mORC1 と: The MSE-binding negative regulator Sum1 represses mORC1 and SMA2 during mitotic growth (27362276)
MSN2・MSN4 は STRE を介した CTT1・DDR2・HSP12 の活: MSN2/MSN4 are required for STRE-mediated activation of CTT1, DDR2, and HSP12 and bind specifically to STREs
MSN5 はフェロモンで促される Ste5 の核外輸送の受容体で、msn5 欠損: MSN5 is the receptor for pheromone-promoted nuclear export of Ste5, and the mating defect of msn5 deletion is suppressed by yrb1ts (11238397). Ste5 that cannot pass through the nucleus cannot localize to the plasma membrane and cannot activate the pathway (10481914, Msn5 not named)
MSS18 は ミトコンドリア cox1 転写産物の イントロン aI5β のス: MSS18 is involved in splicing of intron aI5β of the mitochondrial cox1 transcript. mss18 mutations stop cleavage at the 5' junction (2842150)
MTD1 の発現は Bas1・Bas2 を要し、両者は MTD1 のプロモーター: MTD1 expression requires Bas1 and Bas2, and both bind the MTD1 promoter in vitro (9749667)
MTL1 は高温での細胞壁の信号で MID2 と部分的に重複して働く（10330: MTL1 acts partly redundantly with MID2 in cell wall signaling at high temperature (10330137). Multicopy MTL1 increases Mpk1 phosphorylation (12399379). Mtl1 is a cell wall sensor for oxidative stress, and diamide activates Slt2 (15637049)
MTT1（ECM32）の過剰発現によるナンセンス抑圧は、HSP104 の同時過剰: Nonsense suppression by MTT1 (ECM32) overexpression is weakened by simultaneous HSP104 overexpression (it is not due to induction of [PSI+]) (10836794)
MTU1（SLM3）の破壊で mt tRNA の 2-チオ修飾がなくなる。MTO: Disruption of MTU1 (SLM3) abolishes 2-thio modification of mt tRNAs. Disrupting it together with MTO1 or MSS1 lowers mitochondrial activity much more strongly (15509579)
MVB 選別の活性化は Vps27 の FYVE と PI3P の結合で決まる（: Activation of MVB sorting is determined by binding of the Vps27 FYVE domain to PI3P (12900393). After TORC1 inactivation, PI3KCII is required for recruitment of Vps27 to the vacuolar membrane and formation of ESCRT-0 (34798133)
MXR2 の欠失で未成熟の Ape1・Atg19 が不安定になり、Ape1 の活: MXR2 deletion destabilizes immature Ape1 and Atg19 and lowers Ape1 activity. Mxr2 binds Ape1 in a Met17-dependent manner (38246354)
Mac1 は CTR1・CTR3・FRE1・FRE7・YFR055w・YJL21: Mac1 activates expression of six genes: CTR1, CTR3, FRE1, FRE7, YFR055w, and YJL217w (10922376)
Mac1p の転写活性化領域は銅で抑えられ、CTR1 の発現の銅による抑制と同じ: The transcriptional activation domain of Mac1p is repressed by copper, showing the same concentration dependence as copper repression of CTR1 expression. In MAC1(up1), FRE1 and CTR1 expression does not decrease even with copper (9159110)
Mad1 の NES・Xpo1・RanGTP が、チェックポイントが働いた細胞で: The Mad1 NES, Xpo1, and RanGTP are required for recruitment of Mad1 to kinetochores in cells with an active checkpoint (19139260)
Mad1 のキネトコアへの結合は、Mps1 による Bub1 の一領域のリン酸化: Mad1 binding to kinetochores is mediated by Mps1 phosphorylation of a region of Bub1. Tethering this Bub1 region to kinetochores makes Mps1 dispensable for assembly of upstream checkpoint factors. Mad1–Bub1 binding can be reconstituted with Mps1 and Mad2 (24402315)
Mad2 を Cdc20 に人工的につなぐと、他のチェックポイント因子なしに中期: Artificially tethering Mad2 to Cdc20 causes metaphase arrest without other checkpoint factors. Mad3 is required for stable binding of Mad2 to Cdc20 (22209528). Mad2/Mad3 bind and inhibit Cdc20, and destabilization of Cdc20 upon checkpoint activation requires Cdc20–Mad2 binding (15198982). Checkpoint-resistant Cdc20 mutants do not bind Mad proteins (9461437)
Mad3 は KEN ボックスと D ボックスで Cdc20 に結合し、APC: Mad3 binds Cdc20 through its KEN box and D box and competes with the APC substrate Hsl1 for binding to Cdc20. Checkpoint activation increases Cdc20–Mad3 binding. Mad3 is a pseudosubstrate inhibitor of APC-Cdc20 (17369399). Mad2/Mad3 bind and inhibit Cdc20 (15198982)
Mak11 と Rlp24 は試験管内で直接結合し、Mak11 を失活させると: Mak11 and Rlp24 bind directly in vitro, and inactivating Mak11 destabilizes Rlp24. RLP24 overexpression suppresses the temperature sensitivity of mak11 (17308036)
Mar26（Fmp10）は Rip1 を含む組み立て中間体を MICOS に結び: Mar26 (Fmp10) links assembly intermediates containing Rip1 to MICOS and keeps Rip1 assembly-competent (39623166)
Mbf1 は衝突リボソームと相互作用して Gcn2 の活性化を仲立ちし、ストレス: Mbf1 interacts with collided ribosomes to mediate Gcn2 activation and is required for eIF2α phosphorylation and derepression of GCN4 translation under stress. It is not a Gcn4 coactivator (39566505)
Mbp1 に Kap95 と Srp1 に依存する重複した NLS が 2 つあ: Mbp1 has two redundant NLSs dependent on Kap95 and Srp1 (20587033). Localization in srp1 mutants is not in the abstract, so medium
Mck1 による Rcn1 のリン酸化は SCF-Cdc4 による分解を引き起こ: Phosphorylation of Rcn1 by Mck1 triggers its degradation by SCF-Cdc4, and degradation relieves inhibition of calcineurin. Degradation is counteracted by dephosphorylation of Rcn1 by Ca2+-activated calcineurin (17954914). BioGRID's paper 14701880 shows phosphorylation of Rcn1 by Mck1, but dephosphorylation by calcineurin is not described in its abstract
Mck1 によるリン酸化で Rcn1 は SCF-Cdc4 で分解され、カルシニ: Phosphorylation by Mck1 causes Rcn1 to be degraded by SCF-Cdc4, relieving inhibition of calcineurin. This degradation is counteracted by dephosphorylation of Rcn1 by Ca2+-stimulated calcineurin (17954914)
Mck1 は Dun1 と協力して dNTP 量を調節する。Dun1 と Mck: Mck1 cooperates with Dun1 to regulate dNTP levels. Dun1 and Mck1 phosphorylate Crt1 at different sites and at different rates, relieving its repressive function and increasing RNR2/3/4 transcription. Dun1 phosphorylates a Crt1 fragment in vitro (31381575, main text)
Mck1 は Rad53 の下流で、Crt1 をリン酸化して RNR2-4・HU: Mck1 acts downstream of Rad53 and phosphorylates Crt1, removing it from the promoters of DNA damage-inducible genes such as RNR2-4 and HUG1 (31381575)
Mck1 はピルビン酸キナーゼ（Pyk1 = Cdc19）とツーハイブリッドで結: Mck1 binds pyruvate kinase (Pyk1 = Cdc19) in two-hybrid assays and phosphorylates Ser in vitro. Pyruvate kinase activity increases in mck1Δ, and simultaneous MCK1 overexpression suppresses all phenotypes of PYK1 overexpression (9209064). Whether the inhibition is via direct phosphorylation is unresolved, so confidence is medium
