Mmm1/Mdm10/Mdm12/Mdm34 の複合体が ER とミトコンドリア: The Mmm1/Mdm10/Mdm12/Mdm34 complex is a tethering apparatus connecting the ER and mitochondria (19556461)
Mmr1 のユビキチン化と分解には Ste20・Cla4 によるリン酸化（S41: Ubiquitination and degradation of Mmr1 require phosphorylation (S414) by Ste20/Cla4 (35422486)
Mmr1 は Dma1・Dma2 によるユビキチン化でプロテアソームに分解され、: Mmr1 is ubiquitinated by Dma1/Dma2 and degraded by the proteasome, and this ubiquitination requires phosphorylation (S414) by Ste20/Cla4. Main text: removing Cla4 in ste20Δ delays Mmr1 degradation, and in vitro ubiquitination depends on pretreatment with Ste20 or Cla4 (35422486)
Mnd1/Hop2 は Dmc1 による相同染色体間の安定な鎖侵入を確かにする: Mnd1/Hop2 are required for the DNA–DNA interactions that ensure stable interhomolog strand invasion by Dmc1 (16581767)
Mnn9 は Anp1・Hoc1・Mnn10・Mnn11 と A 複合体を作る（: Mnn9 forms the A complex with Anp1, Hoc1, Mnn10, and Mnn11 (10635561)
Mnn9 は Van1 と V 複合体をつくり、Van1 と Mnn9 の内腔ド: Mnn9 forms the V complex with Van1, and the interaction between the luminal domains of Van1 and Mnn9 was detected by two-hybrid (10635561)
Mnn9 は Van1 との V 複合体と、Anp1・Hoc1・Mnn10・Mn: Mnn9 is contained in the V complex with Van1 and the A complex with Anp1, Hoc1, Mnn10, and Mnn11 (10635561)
Mns1 の ER 局在は Rer1 が関わるゴルジからの回収に依存し、spli: ER localization of Mns1 depends on Rer1-mediated retrieval from the Golgi, and the two interact in split-ubiquitin assays (11792827)
Mob1 は two-hybrid で Mps1 と結合し、体内でリン酸化タンパ: Mob1 binds Mps1 in two-hybrid assays, is a phosphoprotein in vivo, and is an Mps1 substrate in vitro. mob1 mutants arrest in late mitosis (9436989)
Mob2-Cbk1 の娘細胞核への局在とキナーゼ活性は、ほかの RAM タンパク: Localization of Mob2-Cbk1 to the daughter cell nucleus and its kinase activity depend on all the other RAM proteins (including Sog2) (12972564)
Mon1-Ccz1 は Atg8 に直接結合し、Ccz1 の C 末端の LIR: Mon1-Ccz1 binds Atg8 directly, requiring the LIR at the Ccz1 C-terminus. Only the wild type promotes Atg8-dependent activation of Ypt7 (29446751)
Mon1-Ccz1 複合体（単独のどちらでもない）は体内で GAP の作用に対抗: The Mon1-Ccz1 complex (but neither alone) counteracts GAP action in vivo, restores fusion of vacuoles carrying Ypt7-GDP in vitro, and promotes nucleotide exchange on Ypt7 independently of HOPS. It activates Ypt7 on late endosomes to drive maturation (20797862). GEF activity requires the longin domain surfaces of Mon1 and Ccz1 and is strongly stimulated on PI3P-containing membranes (24413168). Consistent with the GO direction
Mon2 は Dop1 と複合体をつくり、mon2 欠失で Dop1 がゴルジ体: Mon2 forms a complex with Dop1, and mon2 deletion releases Dop1 from the Golgi (16301316)
Mot1 は ATP 依存的に TBP を TATA 配列から外す（112787: Mot1 removes TBP from TATA sequences in an ATP-dependent manner (11278722). MOT1 mutations derepress basal transcription (7958867)
Mot1 は DNA なしで Spt15（TBP）と結合し、N 末端 1-800: Mot1 binds Spt15 (TBP) without DNA, and the N-terminal residues 1-800 are necessary and sufficient for binding (11278722)
Mot3 が ERG2・ERG6・ERG9 の転写を好気・低酸素の両方で抑え、C: Mot3 represses transcription of ERG2, ERG6, and ERG9 under both aerobic and hypoxic conditions, and ChIP suggests direct repression (12145211)
Mot3 と Rox1 は Hog1 とともに浸透圧ショックで ERG2 の転写: Mot3 and Rox1, together with Hog1, shut off ERG2 transcription upon osmotic shock, and Mot3 binding to the ERG2 promoter increases with osmotic stress (21299653)
Mot3 は DAN/TIR 遺伝子（TIR4 を含む）のヘムで誘導される抑制因: Mot3 is a heme-induced repressor of DAN/TIR genes (including TIR4) (11292809)
Mot3 はヘムで誘導される DAN/TIR 遺伝子の抑制因子（11292809: Mot3 is a heme-induced repressor of DAN/TIR genes (11292809)
Mox4 はヘムで抑えられる DAN/TIR 遺伝子の活性化因子、Mot3 はヘ: Mox4 is a heme-repressed activator of DAN/TIR genes, and Mot3 is a heme-induced repressor (11292809)
Mox4 はヘムで阻害される活性化因子、Mot3 はヘムで誘導される DAN/T: Mox4 is a heme-inhibited activator, and Mot3 is a heme-induced repressor of DAN/TIR genes (11292809)
Mox4/Upc2 は DAN/TIR 遺伝子すべての発現に必要。好気で異所的に: Mox4/Upc2 is required for expression of all DAN/TIR genes. Ectopic expression under aerobic conditions causes partial constitutive expression of DAN1 (11238402)
Mox4（Upc2）はヘムで阻害される DAN/TIR 遺伝子の活性化因子。TI: Mox4 (Upc2) is a heme-inhibited activator of DAN/TIR genes. TIR2 is expressed under anaerobic conditions (11292809)
Mpc1 は Psd2 が作るホスファチジルエタノールアミンを優先して使うと考え: Mpc1 is thought to preferentially use the phosphatidylethanolamine made by Psd2 (genetics, 12441642)
Mpd1p は Cne1p と結合してそのシャペロン活性を抑え、Cne1p は: Mpd1p binds Cne1p and suppresses its chaperone activity, and Cne1p enhances the reductase activity of Mpd1p (16002399)
Mph1 は Mgm101 と MutSα（Msh2-Msh6）と物理的・機能的: Mph1 interacts physically and functionally with Mgm101 and MutSα (Msh2-Msh6) (22912599)
Mph1-Mgm101-MutSα は鎖間架橋で誘導される Exo1 のクロマチ: Mph1-Mgm101-MutSα directs interstrand crosslink-induced recruitment of Exo1 to chromatin (22912599)
Mpk1–Swi4 の二量体が Swi4 認識配列に結合し、Swi6 も要る。Y: The Mpk1–Swi4 dimer binds the Swi4 recognition sequence, and Swi6 is also required. YLR042c is also induced by cell wall stress by the same mechanism (20641022)
Mpk1（SLT2）が Rom2 を制御するフィードバックが、Pkc1–MAPK: Feedback in which Mpk1 (SLT2) controls Rom2 terminates Rho1 action on the Pkc1–MAPK pathway
Mpk1（SLT2）は Rlm1 を in vitro でリン酸化し、Rlm1: Mpk1 (SLT2) phosphorylates Rlm1 in vitro, and transcriptional activation by Rlm1 is controlled by the Mpk1 pathway
Mpk1（SLT2）は Swi6 の Ser238 をリン酸化して核への移行を抑: Mpk1 (SLT2) phosphorylates Swi6 Ser238, suppressing its nuclear translocation. Meanwhile, the Mpk1–Swi4 complex recruits Swi6 to the nucleus and activates FKS2 transcription (biphasic)
Mpp10 と結合するタンパク質として 2 ハイブリッドで Imp3 と Imp: Imp3 and Imp4 were identified by two-hybrid as Mpp10-binding proteins. Both associate with Mpp10 in vivo (10409734)
Mpp10 は N 末端の 2 つの保存されたモチーフで Utp3/Sas10: Mpp10 binds Utp3/Sas10 through two conserved N-terminal motifs (28813493)
Mps1 が Bub1 の一領域をリン酸化することで Mad1 が動原体に結合し: Phosphorylation of a region of Bub1 by Mps1 allows Mad1 to bind kinetochores, activating the spindle checkpoint (24402315)
Mps1 と Cdk1 にリン酸化された Spc110 は γ-TuSC の重合: Spc110 phosphorylated by Mps1 and Cdk1 enhances γ-TuSC oligomerization and microtubule nucleation in a cell cycle-dependent manner. The activating sites lie between SPM and CM1 (24842996)
Mps1 と Cdk1 にリン酸化された Spc110 は細胞周期に応じて γ-: Spc110 phosphorylated by Mps1 and Cdk1 activates γ-TuSC multimerization and microtubule nucleation according to the cell cycle, and the activating sites lie between SPM and CM1 (24842996). Mps1 is essential for mitotic phosphorylation of Spc110 in vivo and phosphorylates S60, T64, and T68 in vitro. Alanine substitutions at these sites combined with S36A are synthetically lethal with SPC97 mutations (11278681)
Mps1 は G1 で Sfi1 の伸長（半橋の伸長）を促し SPB の複製を活: Mps1 promotes Sfi1 extension (half-bridge elongation) in G1 and activates SPB duplication (24954044)
Mps1 は Spc105 の MELT モチーフをリン酸化して Bub1 を動: Mps1 phosphorylates the MELT motifs of Spc105 to recruit Bub1 to kinetochores, and PP1 reverses this. Spc105 mutants lacking the phosphorylation sites are defective in the spindle checkpoint (22521787). Phosphorylation of Spc105 by Mps1 acts in both establishment of biorientation and the SAC (32307893)
Mps1 は試験管内で Dam1 の 6 つのセリンをリン酸化し、S218・S2: Mps1 phosphorylates six serines of Dam1 in vitro, and in S218/S221 non-phosphorylatable mutants kinetochores do not attach correctly to microtubule plus ends. Phosphorylation of S218/S221 by Mps1 is required for kinetochore–plus end attachment (16890524). In meiosis too, Dam1 phosphorylation by Mps1 maintains kinetochore–microtubule attachment (29237818). BioGRID's 18060784 is about the role of Mps1 in biorientation, and Dam1 phosphorylation is not in its abstract. 20614870 is a methods paper (in vitro only), and 34313341 is a paper on phosphorylation and Bim1 binding that does not name the kinase in its abstract
Mps1 も Cdc28 の基質で、Cdc28 による Mps1 のリン酸化は細: Mps1 is also a Cdc28 substrate, and phosphorylation of Mps1 by Cdc28 is required to maintain cellular Mps1 levels (15296722)
Mps2 は Csm4 と Mps3 に結合し、Csm4 のテロメアへの局在は: Mps2 binds Csm4 and Mps3, and telomere localization of Csm4 depends on Mps2 and Mps3 (32967926)
Mps3 の N 末端は試験管内と体内で Eco1 にアセチル化され、部位は膜貫: The N-terminus of Mps3 is acetylated by Eco1 in vitro and in vivo at three lysines near the transmembrane segment. In non-acetylatable mps3, sister chromatid cohesion and recruitment of chromosomes to the nuclear envelope are impaired. In the main text the sites are K147, K148, and K150 (22593213)
Mps3 の SUN ドメインと Mps2 の C 末端が結合し、半橋を SPB: The SUN domain of Mps3 binds the C-terminus of Mps2, connecting the half-bridge to the SPB core (16923827)
Mpt5 は HO mRNA を制御しその poly(A) の除去（脱アデニル化: Mpt5 controls HO mRNA and promotes removal of its poly(A) (deadenylation). Repression in vivo depends on POP2 (17090538)
Mpt5 は Ste7 と Tec1 のタンパク質量を抑え、Kss1 の活性も負: Mpt5 suppresses Ste7 and Tec1 protein levels and also negatively controls Kss1 activity (17327913)
Mra1 は複合体 IV の組み立てを止め、Rcf2 の結合などが Mra1 の: Mra1 halts complex IV assembly, and Rcf2 binding and other events cause Mra1 degradation, allowing assembly to proceed (38508182)
Mrc1 は正常な DNA 複製と Rad53 の活性化に必要で、複製フォークに: Mrc1 is required for normal DNA replication and Rad53 activation and is present at replication forks. Altering the Mec1 phosphorylation sites of Mrc1 stops Rad53 activation (12865299)
Mrc1/Rad53 の複製チェックポイントが必要で、Dun1 が Cep3 を: The Mrc1/Rad53 replication checkpoint is required, and Dun1 phosphorylates Cep3. Main text: Dun1 activated by Rad53 phosphorylates Cep3 (40742805)
Mrd1 を含む 12 個を ex vivo メチル化と MS/MS で Hmt: Twelve proteins including Mrd1 were confirmed as Hmt1 substrates by ex vivo methylation and MS/MS (26572822)
Mre11 複合体は Exo1 と共に、DNA 損傷と複製の停止のあと Mec1: The Mre11 complex, together with Exo1, acts in activation of the Mec1 signaling pathway after DNA damage and replication arrest. Both generate long single-stranded DNA at DSB ends and gather Mec1 at DSBs (15509802)
Mrh4 がないと 21S rRNA は成熟するが、Mrpl16 と Mrpl3: Without Mrh4, 21S rRNA matures but forms assembly intermediates lacking Mrpl16 and Mrpl39 (24206665)
Mrh4 が無いと 21S rRNA は成熟するが、Mrpl16・Mrpl39: Without Mrh4, 21S rRNA matures but remains in assembly intermediates lacking Mrpl16 and Mrpl39 (24206665)
Mrh4 による bL33m の組み込みが、Mtg1 の 21S rRNA への: Incorporation of bL33m by Mrh4 occurs before recruitment of Mtg1 to 21S rRNA (40865570)
Mrn1 は N 末端の領域で標的 mRNA を抑え、その標的に NCA3 と: Mrn1 represses target mRNAs through its N-terminal region, and its targets include NCA3 and UTH1. Mitochondrial enlargement in mrn1Δ is partly due to dysregulation of NCA3 (33857138)
Mrn1 は標的 mRNA を抑え、その標的に NCA3 と UTH1 がある（: Mrn1 represses target mRNAs, and its targets include NCA3 and UTH1 (33857138)
Mrp10 はマトリックスへ入る途中で Mia40 と結合し酸化される。ジスルフ: Mrp10 binds Mia40 and is oxidized on its way into the matrix. The disulfide bonds protect Mrp10 from degradation (24360785)
Mrp4 をタグにしてミトコンドリアリボソームを精製し、質量分析で Img1 を: Mitochondrial ribosomes were purified using tagged Mrp4, and mass spectrometry confirmed Img1 as a large subunit component (12392552)
MrpL32 は m-AAA プロテアーゼで切断され、リボソームの前駆粒子に組み: MrpL32 is cleaved by the m-AAA protease and incorporated into ribosome precursor particles (16239145). Presequence-assisted folding halts degradation and releases the mature form (21610694)
MrpL35 は MrpL7・Mrp7・MrpL36・MrpL17・MrpL28: MrpL35 forms a subcomplex with MrpL7, Mrp7, MrpL36, MrpL17, and MrpL28. MrpL35 and Mrp7 act in COX assembly (28931599)
MrpL35 forms a subcomplex with MrpL7, Mrp7, MrpL36, MrpL17, and MrpL28 (28931599)
Mrpl4 の過剰発現が mtg3（GEP3）欠失の呼吸欠損を一部戻し、プロセシ: Overexpression of Mrpl4 partly restores the respiratory defect of mtg3 (GEP3) deletion and increases processed 15S rRNA. Mtg3 and Mrpl4 are thought to jointly regulate small subunit assembly (22621929)
Mrpl51 は mtDNA の維持に特に必要で、Mhr1 が Mrpl51 と: Mrpl51 is specifically required for mtDNA maintenance, and Mhr1 binds Mrpl51 physically (31374566)
Mrs1 は aI5beta スプライシングの律速因子で、切り出された RNP: Mrs1 is the rate-limiting factor for aI5beta splicing, and Suv3 is required for recycling of the excised RNP (20064926)
Mrs6 は GGTase-II の component A で、体内で Ypt: Mrs6 is component A of GGTase-II and is required in vivo for membrane binding of Ypt1 and Sec4 (8183917)
Mrs6 を加えると Bet2・Mad2 の GGTase-II 活性が試験管内: Adding Mrs6 reconstitutes GGTase-II activity of Bet2/Mad2 in vitro, so Mrs6 is component A. Mrs6 is required in vivo for membrane binding of Ypt1 and Sec4, and its depletion stops vesicular transport (8183917)
Mrt4 は pre-60S のストーク部位を覆い、Mex67-Mtr2 が核内: Mrt4 covers the stalk site of pre-60S and prevents premature assembly of Mex67-Mtr2 on nuclear pre-60S (27775710)
Mrx4 は Cbp3-Cbp6 か Cbs2 のどちらかと相互作用し、COB: Mrx4 interacts with either Cbp3-Cbp6 or Cbs2 and determines translation initiation of COB mRNA (40637229)
Mrx4 は組み立て因子 Cbp3-Cbp6 か Cbs2 のどちらかと相互作用: Mrx4 interacts with either of the assembly factors Cbp3-Cbp6 or Cbs2 (40637229)
Mrx6 の欠失や Mrx6-Pim1 の結合を壊す変異で Rpo41 と Ci: Deletion of Mrx6 or mutations disrupting Mrx6–Pim1 binding stabilize Rpo41 and Cim1 (41533588)
Mrx6 は Lon プロテアーゼ Pim1 と、Mam33・Pet20 を含む: Mrx6 interacts with the Lon protease Pim1 in a complex containing Mam33 and Pet20 (31532710)
Mrx6 は Pim1 と、Mam33 と Mrx6 に似た Pet20 を含む: Mrx6 forms a complex with Pim1, Mam33, and the Mrx6-like Pet20 (31532710)
Mrx9 の過剰で COX1・COB の成熟 mRNA が減り未処理の転写産物が: Excess Mrx9 reduces mature COX1 and COB mRNAs and causes unprocessed transcripts to accumulate. There is no effect in intronless strains (35779633)
Excess Mrx9 reduces mature COX1 and COB mRNAs and causes unprocessed transcripts to accumulate (35779633)
Msa1・Msa2 はグルコース枯渇後に SWI4・CLN2 など SBF の標: Msa1/Msa2 are required to repress transcription of SBF targets such as SWI4 and CLN2 after glucose depletion (27272642)
Msb1 は Rho1 と結合し、過剰発現で芽の形成初期のグルカン合成での Rh: Msb1 binds Rho1, and its overexpression lowers Rho1 function in glucan synthesis early in bud formation (23785492)
Msb1 は細胞内で Cdc42・Boi1・Boi2 と結合し、Cdc42 の働: Msb1 binds Cdc42, Boi1, and Boi2 in cells and is thought to positively regulate Cdc42 function (23785492)
Msb2 による Hog1 の活性化には足場 Bem1 とアクチン骨格が要る。B: Msb2-mediated Hog1 activation requires the scaffold Bem1 and the actin cytoskeleton. Bem1 binds the cytoplasmic part of Msb2 and gathers Ste20 and Cla4 at the membrane (24570489)
Msb2 は分泌型と細胞に残る型に切られる。Yps1 による細胞外抑制ドメインの: Msb2 is cleaved into secreted and cell-retained forms. Cleavage of the extracellular inhibitory domain by Yps1 generates active Msb2 according to nutrient status, and active Msb2 activates the MAPK through Sho1 (18591427)
Msb2 は糸状成長経路に特有の因子で、その経路の MAPK Kss1 の活性化: Msb2 is a factor specific to the filamentous growth pathway; it promotes activation of the pathway MAPK Kss1 and interacts with Cdc42 and Sho1. Removing the mucin domain causes pathway hyperactivity (15256499). Active Msb2 activates the MAPK through Sho1 (18591427)
Msb3/Gyp3 は Vps21 に特異的な GAP で、msb3 を欠くと: Msb3/Gyp3 is a GAP specific to Vps21; without msb3, Vps21 and the effector Vps8 accumulate on the vacuolar membrane. It also shows the highest GAP activity toward Vps21 in vitro (22593206). Gyp3 is the main Rab5 GAP for Vps21, keeping active Vps21 on intermediate endosomes and preventing its accumulation on the vacuole (22748138)
Msc2 と Zrg17 は共免疫沈降で結合し、ER への亜鉛輸送のヘテロ複合体: Msc2 and Zrg17 bind in co-immunoprecipitation and are proposed to form a hetero-complex for zinc transport into the ER (15961382)
Msg5 は活性化した Slt2 に結合して脱リン酸化し、細胞壁の経路の信号を低: Msg5 binds and dephosphorylates activated Slt2, keeping cell wall pathway signaling low (14703512). Phosphorylated Slt2 increases in msg5 deletion and disappears with MSG5 overexpression (10625705)
Msh4 と Msh5 が MutSγ 複合体を作る。Msh4 の SUMO 化: Msh4 and Msh5 form the MutSγ complex. SUMOylation of Msh4 promotes Msh4–Msh5 binding (34214491)
Msh4 は E2 の Ubc9 に直接 SUMO 化され、DNA 二本鎖切断に: Msh4 is directly SUMOylated by the E2 Ubc9: mono-SUMOylated in response to DNA double-strand breaks and multi-SUMOylated upon homolog pairing. Msh4 SUMOylation promotes stabilization of joint molecules and their resolution into crossovers, and strengthens Msh4–Msh5 binding (34214491). SUMOylation in vivo does not depend on any of the four E3s
Msh4 は N 末端のデグロンで不安定で、MutSγ ははじめ交叉に働かない。: Msh4 is unstable owing to an N-terminal degron, and MutSγ initially does not act in crossing over. Direct phosphorylation of Msh4 by DDK, which neutralizes the degron, is required for MutSγ activation. The amount of Msh4 is decisive for crossing over (32130890)
Msh6 の ATPase/コアドメインと Mlh1 の結合が働く。Mlh1 は: Binding of the Msh6 ATPase/core domain to Mlh1 is functional. Mlh1 is recruited to mispaired DNA by binding to both subunits of Msh2-Msh6 (36122480)
Msi1 は Npr1 を介して活性型 Rho5 のシグナルも抑える（18621: Msi1 also suppresses signaling of active Rho5 via Npr1 (18621925)
Msl5 は生体内で Mud2 と異種二量体をつくり、U1 snRNP と結合し: Msl5 forms a heterodimer with Mud2 in vivo and is bound to the U1 snRNP (22287628)
Msn1 と Mss11 は Mep2・Ras2 の下流で STA2 と MUC: Msn1 and Mss11 control transcription of STA2 and MUC1 (FLO11) downstream of Mep2 and Ras2, and their effect on invasive growth is mediated by MUC1 (9987114)
Msn1p と Mss11p は STA2 と MUC1（FLO11）の転写を制: Msn1p and Mss11p control transcription of STA2 and MUC1 (FLO11), and MUC1 accounts for the effect on invasive growth (9987114)
Msn2 の PKA 部位の置換で cAMP による核外輸送が消える。Msn2: Substitution of the PKA sites of Msn2 abolishes cAMP-induced nuclear export. Nuclear import of Msn2 is suppressed by PKA-dependent phosphorylation (action as PKA)
Msn2 も Srb10 の基質で、熱ストレスで核に移ると Srb10 依存に過: Msn2 is also a Srb10 substrate and, when it moves into the nucleus under heat stress, is hyperphosphorylated in a Srb10-dependent manner. In srb10 mutants, nuclear exclusion of Msn2 is partly impaired, and it is proposed that Srb10 represses gene expression by promoting degradation or nuclear export of transcription factors (11331604)
Msn2/4 は RTC3・HSP12・DAK1・ALD3 の 4 つのプロモー: Msn2/4 are involved in control of all four promoters, RTC3, HSP12, DAK1, and ALD3. RTC3 is induced even without the four activators (32804965)
Msn2/Msn4 と HSF の二つの経路が独立に UBI4 の熱ショック誘導: Two pathways, Msn2/Msn4 and HSF, independently mediate heat shock induction of UBI4 (10048026)
Msn2・Msn4 の核局在は cAMP 量・PKA 活性と逆相関し、PKA 部: Nuclear localization of Msn2/Msn4 is inversely correlated with cAMP levels and PKA activity, and substitution of the PKA sites abolishes cAMP-induced nuclear export
Msn2・Msn4 の核局在は cAMP 量・PKA 活性と逆相関する（PKA: Nuclear localization of Msn2/Msn4 is inversely correlated with cAMP levels and PKA activity (action as PKA; phosphorylation site analysis was on Msn2)
Msn2・Msn4 は STRE を介した CTT1・DDR2・HSP12 の活: Msn2/Msn4 are required for STRE-mediated activation of CTT1, DDR2, and HSP12 and bind specifically to STRE-containing oligonucleotides (8641288)
Msn5 は Crz1 のエクスポーチンで、Crz1 の NES とリン酸化に依: Msn5 is the exportin for Crz1 and binds dependent on the Crz1 NES and its phosphorylation. Calcineurin dephosphorylates the NES and stops export (11877380)
Mso1 は Sec1 と試験管内でも two-hybrid でも結合し、MSO: Mso1 binds Sec1 both in vitro and in two-hybrid assays, and high expression of MSO1 specifically suppresses sec1-1 (9207091)
Msp1 はミトコンドリア外膜へ誤って向かう Pex15 変異体に結合し、その分: Msp1 binds Pex15 mutants mistargeted to the mitochondrial outer membrane and promotes their degradation (24821790). Part of peroxisomal Pex15 (increased by overexpression) is degraded by Msp1 (28906250)
Mss11 は Flo8 と組んで凝集を強く誘導し、その主な標的は FLO1。M: Mss11 together with Flo8 strongly induces flocculation, and its main target is FLO1. MSS11 deletion abolishes flocculation (16568252)
Mss116 は RPO41 がコードするミトコンドリア RNA ポリメラーゼの: Mss116 acts as an elongation factor for the mitochondrial RNA polymerase encoded by RPO41 and stabilizes paused elongation complexes (24732805)
Mss2 は Cox2 の C 末端をマトリックスで認識し、膜間腔への運び出しを: Mss2 recognizes the C-terminus of Cox2 in the matrix and promotes its export to the intermembrane space (11604502)
Mss2・Pnt1 が Cox18 と共免疫沈降し、Cox2 の運び出しで共に働: Mss2 and Pnt1 co-immunoprecipitate with Cox18 and act together in Cox2 export (11950926)
Mss4 は核と細胞質を行き来する。核に Mss4 が溜まる mss4 変異体で: Mss4 shuttles between the nucleus and cytoplasm. In mss4 mutants where Mss4 accumulates in the nucleus, PI(4,5)P2 decreases and actin polarity is lost. Bcp1, a multicopy suppressor of mss4, is required for nuclear export of Mss4 (12912920)
Mst27 とその相同体 Mst28 は同じ複合体に含まれる（12925749）: Mst27 and its homolog Mst28 are contained in the same complex (12925749)

Mtc6 は高圧下でトリプトファン透過酵素 Tat2 を安定化し、欠失で Tat: Mtc6 stabilizes the tryptophan permease Tat2 under high pressure; in the deletion, Tat2 is degraded in the vacuole in a Rsp5-Bul1-dependent manner (38918055)

Mtr4 と Trf5 の結合部位を決め、結合を壊すと snoRNA のプロセシ: The binding sites between Mtr4 and Trf5 were determined, and disrupting the binding impairs TRAMP/exosome functions such as snoRNA processing (25589546)
Mtr4 の RNA 巻き戻し活性は Trf4/Air2 で大きく促進され、ポリ: The RNA unwinding activity of Mtr4 is greatly stimulated by Trf4/Air2 and does not depend on polyadenylation (22532666)

Mtr4 は Nop53 と直接結合し、この結合が 5.8S rRNA の成熟に: Mtr4 binds Nop53 directly, and this binding is key for 5.8S rRNA maturation (crystal structure) (28883156)
Mtw1p と Nnf1p・Nsl1p・Dsn1p が物理的な複合体をつくり、動: Mtw1p forms a physical complex with Nnf1p, Nsl1p, and Dsn1p and localizes to kinetochores (14657030)
Mum2 と Slz1 は Ime4 と共沈し、減数分裂期の mRNA メチル化: Mum2 and Slz1 co-precipitate with Ime4 and are required for mRNA methylation during meiosis (MIS complex) (22685417)
Mup1 の Art1-Rsp5 によるユビキチン化とエンドサイトーシスに要る特: The features of Mup1 required for Art1-Rsp5-mediated ubiquitination and endocytosis were shown (27798240)
Mup1・Can1・Lyp1・Tat2 の飢餓によるエンドサイトーシスには Ar: Starvation-induced endocytosis of Mup1, Can1, Lyp1, and Tat2 requires Art2 (32744498, PMC main text)
Mus81-Mms4 に結合する足場 Rtt107 は Cdc7 と結合し、DD: The scaffold Rtt107, which binds Mus81-Mms4, binds Cdc7 and directs DDK and Cdc5 to the complex, fully activating Mus81 (28096179)
Mus81-Mms4 は Cdc28 と Cdc5 に依存する Mms4 のリン: Mus81-Mms4 is regulated by Cdc28- and Cdc5-dependent phosphorylation of Mms4; this phosphorylation occurs after DNA synthesis and before chromosome segregation and is absolutely required for complex function. Cdc5 increases the nuclease activity of Mus81-Mms4 in vitro (22645308). 28096179 also states that mitotic activation depends on CDK and Cdc5 phosphorylation and works together with DDK
Mus81-Mms4 は非触媒サブユニット Mms4 の Cdc28 と Cdc: Mus81-Mms4 is controlled by Cdc28- and Cdc5-dependent phosphorylation of the non-catalytic subunit Mms4, and this phosphorylation is absolutely required for complex function. Non-phosphorylatable mms4 mutations greatly reduce nuclease activity (22730299). BioGRID's 14574415 is a high-throughput screen, and 34502421 does not address Mms4
Mvb12 は ESCRT-I の新しい構成要素で、Vps23 のコイルドコイル: Mvb12 is a new component of ESCRT-I and binds the coiled-coil of Vps23 (17145965)
Mvb12 は Vps37 に結合して ESCRT-I に加わるらしい（1713: Mvb12 appears to join ESCRT-I by binding Vps37 (17135292)
Mvp1 は試験管内で膜を変形させ、細胞内で Vps1 のエンドソームへの結合を: Mvp1 deforms membranes in vitro and promotes binding of Vps1 to endosomes in cells (24567361)
Mxr2 は Mge1 の 155 番の酸化メチオニンを選んで還元し、試験管内と: Mxr2 selectively reduces oxidized methionine 155 of Mge1 and restores Mge1 activity in vitro and in vivo (25428986)
Myo2 は Sec4 と exocyst の Sec15 に直接結合し、この結: Myo2 binds Sec4 and the exocyst subunit Sec15 directly; disrupting this binding impairs growth and causes secretory vesicles to accumulate (22172676). Sec4 is the Myo2 receptor on secretory vesicles (27307583)
Myo2 は Ypt31/32 の効果器で、GTP 型 Ypt31/32 は M: Myo2 is an effector of Ypt31/32; GTP-bound Ypt31/32 binds the Myo2 GTD directly, and this binding is required for polarized secretion. In ypt31Δ/32ts and in binding-deficient myo2 mutants, intracellular localization of Myo2 is disrupted, and in the latter unpolarized secretory vesicles accumulate
Myo3 の頭部の S357 は Ste20 と Cla4 のリン酸化部位で、S: S357 in the Myo3 head is a phosphorylation site for Ste20 and Cla4; S357A abolishes Myo3 function in vivo, and S357D retains it (9388196). The contribution of Ste20 alone overlaps with Cla4
Myo3 の頭部の S357 は Ste20 と Cla4 の唯一のリン酸化部位: S357 in the Myo3 head is the only phosphorylation site for Ste20 and Cla4. S357A abolishes Myo3 function in vivo, and S357D retains it (9388196)
Myo4 は試験管内では非進行性の単量体モーターで She3 と複合体を作る。M: Myo4 is a non-processive monomeric motor in vitro and forms a complex with She3. Myo4, She3, and She2 are the main components of the transport unit (20457760)
Myo5 の TEDS 部位のリン酸化はリガンドで誘導されるエンドサイトーシスに: Phosphorylation of the Myo5 TEDS site is essential for ligand-induced endocytosis. The Pkh1/2 → Ypk1/2 pathway activates Myo3/Myo5
Mzm1 は物理的な結合で Rip1 を安定化し、とくに高温で Rip1 のシャ: Mzm1 stabilizes Rip1 by physical binding and acts as a Rip1 chaperone, especially at high temperature (21807901)
N 末を欠いた Pet494 断片が Pet54 とツーハイブリッドで結合（82: A Pet494 fragment lacking the N-terminus binds Pet54 in two-hybrid assays (8289785)
N 末端の 4 か所の Cdk1 部位を Glu にすると分裂期キナーゼがなくて: Changing the four N-terminal Cdk1 sites to Glu keeps Chs2 in the ER even without mitotic kinase, and changing them to Ala allows export even in mitosis. Cdk1 phosphorylation blocks incorporation into COPII vesicles (23525003)
N 末端則の E3 である Ubr1 は Ptr2 の転写抑制因子 Cup9 の: The N-end rule E3 Ubr1 mediates degradation of Cup9, the transcriptional repressor of Ptr2.
