BioGRID's 39920309 is a paper on regulation of Ubr1 by Roq1, and Cup9 does not appear in its abstract
N-BAR タンパク質 Rvs167 は RabGAP の Gyp5 と Gyl: The N-BAR protein Rvs167 is recruited to the tips of small buds by the RabGAPs Gyp5 and Gyl1 and acts in exocytosis (32015451)
NAC の 3 つのサブユニットは EGD2・EGD1・BTT1 がコードし、β: The three NAC subunits are encoded by EGD2, EGD1, and BTT1, and NAC binds ribosomes through the β subunit. Losing one reduces the others (10219998)
NADPH から Tah18 を経て Dre2 の Fe-S クラスターへ電子が: Electrons pass from NADPH via Tah18 to the Fe-S cluster of Dre2. Tah18-Dre2 acts at an early step of CIA (20802492)
NBP1 は ndc1-39 の多コピー抑圧因子で、ツーハイブリッドで Nbp1: NBP1 is a multicopy suppressor of ndc1-39; Nbp1p binds Ndc1p in two-hybrid assays and is also contained in the Mps2p–Bbp1p complex (16436507)
NC2（Bur6-Ydr1）は試験管内で TBP に結合してその働きを抑える一般: NC2 (Bur6-Ydr1) is a general negative regulator that binds TBP in vitro and inhibits its function. In vivo it binds promoters and has positive and negative effects on about 17% of genes (11283253)
NCA2 と NCA3 の変異が同時にあると ATP8-ATP6 共転写産物（5: When NCA2 and NCA3 mutations are both present, the ATP8-ATP6 co-transcript (5.2 kb) is greatly reduced and subunits 6 and 8 are deficient. Disruption of NCA3 drastically reduces the 5.2 kb mRNA (7586026)
NCA2 は ATP 合成酵素サブユニット 6・8 のミトコンドリアでの合成の制: NCA2 is required for control of mitochondrial synthesis of ATP synthase subunits 6 and 8. Complementation partly restores the 5.2 kb transcript and synthesis of subunits 6 and 8 (7723016)
NEM・アクロレインで Yap1 依存に応答する 327 遺伝子のうち、YDR0: Of 327 genes responding to NEM and acrolein in a Yap1-dependent manner, YDR042C acts in defense (20971184)
NEP1（EMG1）と遺伝学的に相互作用する遺伝子に RPS18A・RPS18B: Genes interacting genetically with NEP1 (EMG1) include RPS18A and RPS18B. It is suggested that Rps18, together with Nep1 and Utp30, forms the surface for Rps19 incorporation (22588997)
NER を欠く細胞では、チェックポイントのタンパク質による Rev1 のリン酸化: In NER-deficient cells, phosphorylation of Rev1 by checkpoint proteins increases the efficiency of Pol ζ-dependent TLS (unnecessary when NER is present) (19528320). Mec1-dependent phosphorylation promotes binding of the Pol ζ-Rev1 complex to DSBs (16546083)
NH4+ の添加による Gap1 の細胞内取り込みと液胞での分解にはユビキチン化: Internalization of Gap1 and its vacuolar degradation upon NH4+ addition require ubiquitination, which depends on Npi1/Rsp5 (11500493)
NIP1/eIF3c の N 末端は eIF1・eIF5 と直接結合し MFC: The N-terminus of NIP1/eIF3c binds eIF1 and eIF5 directly to form the MFC. It regulates start codon selection (15485912)
NNS 複合体と Rrp6 が FLO1・FLO5・FLO9・FLO10 の発現: The NNS complex and Rrp6 are involved in expression of FLO1, FLO5, FLO9, and FLO10, and flocculation occurs upon Rnt1 deletion or with SEN1 mutations that cannot bind Rnt1 (26364722)
NNS 複合体（Sen1 を含む）と Rrp6 が FLO1・FLO5・FLO9: The NNS complex (including Sen1) and Rrp6 are involved in expression of FLO1, FLO5, FLO9, and FLO10, and Rnt1, Rrp6, and NNS cooperatively repress FLO genes (26364722)
NOT2 の N 末の変異で NOT5 の CCR4-NOT への会合が変わり、: Mutations in the NOT2 N-terminus alter association of NOT5 with CCR4-NOT, and the Not2 N-terminus contacts and stabilizes Not5 (12215412)
NOT5 は two-hybrid で NOT1・NOT3 と相互作用し、Not: NOT5 interacts with NOT1 and NOT3 in two-hybrid assays, and Not1p, Not3p, and Not4p co-immunoprecipitate with Not5p (9511744)
NPC に入った Nup1-GFP は熱ストレスで特にプロテアソーム分解され、S: Nup1-GFP incorporated into NPCs is specifically degraded by the proteasome under heat stress, dependent on San1, Cdc48, and Doa1 (38302116)
NPD2560 による細胞壁ストレスで、CRH1・KDX1・CWP1・PIR3: Cell wall stress from NPD2560 induces Rlm1-dependent cell wall genes such as CRH1, KDX1, CWP1, and PIR3 (42233670)
NPL4 の変異で Mga2 の切断が止まり OLE1 の発現が消える（1159: NPL4 mutations stop Mga2 cleavage and abolish OLE1 expression (11598205)
NPL4 の変異で Spt23 の切断が止まり OLE1 の発現が消える（115: NPL4 mutations stop Spt23 cleavage and abolish OLE1 expression (11598205). Cdc48(Ufd1/Npl4) releases p90 and sends it to the nucleus (11733065)
NQM1 はグルコースで抑制され、カロリー制限・非発酵性炭素源・浸透圧と酸化スト: NQM1 is repressed by glucose and is induced in a VHR1-dependent manner by caloric restriction, non-fermentable carbon sources, and osmotic and oxidative stress (25887987)
NRE(DIT) による栄養増殖中の DIT1・DIT2 の抑制に Ssn6-T: Repression of DIT1/DIT2 during vegetative growth by NRE(DIT) requires the Ssn6-Tup1 repressor complex (8972192)
NRE(DIT) は栄養増殖中の DIT1・DIT2 の発現を止め、その働きに: NRE(DIT) shuts off expression of DIT1/DIT2 during vegetative growth, and this requires the Ssn6-Tup1 repressor complex (8972192)
NRT1（YOR071C）は Sum1・Hst1・Rfm1 に負に制御される（1: NRT1 (YOR071C) is negatively controlled by Sum1, Hst1, and Rfm1 (18258590)
NSF1 の転写は Met4 に制御される。Nsf1 の核局在は硫黄に依存（24: NSF1 transcription is controlled by Met4. Nuclear localization of Nsf1 depends on sulfur (24130853)
Na+ ポンプ Ena1 はエプシン（Ent1・Ent2）に特異的な積荷で、取り: The Na+ pump Ena1 is a specific cargo of the epsins (Ent1, Ent2), and its internalization requires K1090 (32694166)
Nab2 は RGG ドメインを Hmt1 にメチル化され、アルギニンのメチル化: The RGG domain of Nab2 is methylated by Hmt1, and arginine methylation is required for nuclear export of Nab2 (11779864). Arginine methylation is required for nuclear export of Npl3, Hrp1, and Nab2 (12756332)
Nag1 の産生は CWI 経路の MAPK Slt2 とその下流の転写因子 R: Nag1 production depends on the CWI pathway MAPK Slt2 and its downstream transcription factor Rlm1 (18310357)
Nam1（MTF2）は two-hybrid で mtRNA ポリメラーゼ（RP: Nam1 (MTF2) binds specifically to the N-terminal region of mtRNA polymerase (RPO41) in two-hybrid assays (11118450, 11805046)
Nam2p と bI4 マチュラーゼはそれぞれ bI4 イントロンに結合し、イン: Nam2p and the bI4 maturase each bind the bI4 intron, and the intron bridges their binding (11142386)
Nap1 に結合するタンパク質をアフィニティーで探し、Sda1 が試験管内と生体: An affinity search for Nap1-binding proteins found that Sda1 binds Nap1 in vitro and in vivo (11160833)
Nar1 は CTC の Cia1 の酸性面に静電的に結合し、さらに Cia1-: Nar1 binds electrostatically to the acidic surface of Cia1 in the CTC and also binds the Cia1–Cia2 interface (reconstitution, binding quantification, AlphaFold) (42349787)
Nas2 は Rpt5 の C 末端領域に結合し、Rpt5 の尾部はこの結合に必: Nas2 binds the C-terminal region of Rpt5, and the Rpt5 tail is essential for this binding (21878651)
Nas6 と Rpt3 の C 末端ドメインの複合体の結晶構造を解き、両者は電荷: The crystal structure of the complex of Nas6 and the Rpt3 C-terminal domain was solved, and the two bind stably through charge-complementary surfaces (17555716)
Nat3 はオートファジーに必須の N 末端アセチル化酵素で、Act1 と Vp: Nat3 is an N-terminal acetyltransferase essential for autophagy, with Act1 and Vps1 as substrates. Acetylated Act1 forms actin filaments and promotes Atg9 vesicle transport (34788606). NatB consists of the catalytic subunit Nat3 and the auxiliary subunit Mdm20, and N-terminal acetylation of Act1 promotes actin filament formation (35090375)

Nat3 is an N-terminal acetyltransferase essential for autophagy, with Act1 and Vps1 as substrates. Acetylated Vps1 recruits and bundles SNARE complexes, assisting fusion of autophagosomes with the vacuole (34788606). N-terminal acetylation of Vps1 promotes interaction with SNAREs (35090375)
Nat4 は H4 と H2A の N 末端をアセチル化する酵素で、nat4 変: Nat4 is the enzyme that acetylates the N-termini of H4 and H2A; in nat4 mutants the N-termini of H4 and H2A are not acetylated (12915400)
NatA に第 3 のサブユニット Nat5p が含まれ、Nat1p が Ard: NatA contains a third subunit, Nat5p, and Nat1p anchors Ard1p and Nat5p to ribosomes (14517307)
NatB の NAT3・MDM20 の欠損で NAD+ が下がる。Nma1/Nm: Loss of NatB NAT3/MDM20 lowers NAD+. This appears to be caused by reduced Nma1/Nma2 levels, and N-terminal acetylation of Nma1/Nma2 by NatB appears essential for maintaining NAD+ (29317496)
NatC は Mak3・Mak10・Mak31 が互いに結合した活性のある複合体: NatC is an active complex in which Mak3, Mak10, and Mak31 bind each other (11274203)
NatC は Mak3・Mak10・Mak31 の 3 サブユニットが結合して活: NatC forms an active complex of three bound subunits, Mak3, Mak10, and Mak31 (11274203)
NatC は Mak3（触媒）・Mak10・Mak31 からなり、3 つが結合し: NatC consists of Mak3 (catalytic), Mak10, and Mak31, and the three bind to form an active complex. Lacking any one gives the same phenotype (11274203)
Nbl1p は CPC（Ipl1p・Sli15p・Bir1p）と共局在・共精製さ: Nbl1p co-localizes and co-purifies with the CPC (Ipl1p, Sli15p, Bir1p) and is required for CPC localization, stability, integrity, and function (19158380)
Nbp2 は N 末端で Ptc1、SH3 で Pbs2 に結合するアダプター（: Nbp2 is an adaptor that binds Ptc1 via its N-terminus and Pbs2 via its SH3 (14685261). Dephosphorylation of Pbs2 by Ptc1 requires Nbp2, which recruits Ptc1 to Pbs2. Ptc1-Ptc4 collectively negatively regulate Pbs2 (36870684)
Nbp2 は Ptc1 を Pbs2-Hog1 複合体へ運び Hog1 を負に制: Nbp2 brings Ptc1 to the Pbs2-Hog1 complex and negatively controls Hog1. In nbp2 deletion, the Ptc1-Pbs2 complex does not form (14685261). Dephosphorylation of Pbs2 by Ptc1 requires Nbp2 (36870684)
Ncp1 は Pcl1・Pho85 複合体で特異的にリン酸化される（150825: Ncp1 is specifically phosphorylated by the Pcl1/Pho85 complex (15082539)
Ncw2 は Pmt1-Pmt2 複合体による O-マンノシル化の後に細胞表面へ: Ncw2 is transported to the cell surface after O-mannosylation by the Pmt1-Pmt2 complex and co-localizes with bud scars (33945065)
Ndc1 は膜貫通タンパク質 Pom152・Pom34 と独立した複合体を作る（: Ndc1 forms independent complexes with the transmembrane proteins Pom152 and Pom34 (19414609)
Nde1 の表面に出る型はプロテアソーム/Cdc48 系で分解される（31668: The surface-exposed form of Nde1 is degraded by the proteasome/Cdc48 system (31668496)
Nde1 の表面に出る型は細胞質のプロテアソーム/Cdc48 とミトコンドリアの: The surface-exposed form of Nde1 is degraded by the cytoplasmic proteasome/Cdc48 and the mitochondrial protease Yme1 (31668496)
Ndj1 の SPB への局在は Mps3 に依存し、Ndj1 は Mps3 と: Localization of Ndj1 to the SPB depends on Mps3, and Ndj1 forms a complex with Mps3 (25897084)
Ndl1 は LIS1（Pac1）と生化学的に結合し、LIS1 を介してダイニン: Ndl1 binds LIS1 (Pac1) biochemically and controls targeting of dynein to plus ends via LIS1 (15965467)
Ndt80 が Ime2 を活性化し、Ime2 に依存して MECA（Num1・: Ndt80 activates Ime2, and MECA (Num1, Mdm36) is phosphorylated and degraded in an Ime2-dependent manner. Ime2 directly phosphorylates Mdm36 in vitro, and inactivating Ime2 weakens degradation of Num1/Mdm36 (30538140)
Ndt80 のリン酸化は転写因子としての活性化と同時に起こり、ime2 変異株で: Ndt80 phosphorylation coincides with its activation as a transcription factor; in ime2 mutants, Ndt80 is not modified and its ability to activate target genes drops. Ime2 also phosphorylates Ndt80 in vitro (12242283). Analysis of ime2-as1 shows that Ime2 stimulates Ndt80 to drive meiotic divisions (12783856). In 14680970, phosphorylation of the DNA-binding domain does not change DNA affinity
Nej1 は DNA 損傷で Mec1・Rad53・Dun1 に依存してリン酸化: Nej1 is phosphorylated upon DNA damage in a Mec1-, Rad53-, and Dun1-dependent manner, and mutation of serines matching the Dun1 consensus lowers NHEJ efficiency (17101301). Dun1-dependent phosphorylation of S297/S298 strengthens Nej1–Srs2 binding and helps recruit Srs2 to DSBs (19571008). In 34244791, S298 is also phosphorylated by Tpk1, so the kinases responsible for the site overlap and confidence is medium
Nej1 は Dna2 と Mre11・Sgs1 の結合を抑える（3139056: Nej1 suppresses binding of Dna2 to Mre11 and Sgs1 (31390569). Nej1 suppresses Sae2-dependent Dna2 assembly independently of Sgs1 (35429499)
Nej1 は Sae2 と MRX の結合と Sae2 の DSB への局在を抑: Nej1 suppresses Sae2–MRX binding and Sae2 localization to DSBs (35429499)
Nem1-Spo7 による Pah1 の脱リン酸化で PA ホスファターゼ活性が: Dephosphorylation of Pah1 by Nem1-Spo7 increases PA phosphatase activity 6-fold, with particular preference for the Pho85-Pho80 sites (25359770). Upon dephosphorylation, Pah1 moves to the nuclear/ER membrane and acts there (30201607)
Nem1-Spo7 ホスファターゼ複合体は Pah1 を脱リン酸化して核膜・小胞: The Nem1-Spo7 phosphatase complex dephosphorylates Pah1 and activates it at the nuclear and ER membranes. Spo7 is a regulatory subunit required for Nem1 catalysis, and its C-terminal basic tail is important for Pah1 dephosphorylation and cellular function (38141768). The Spo7 LLI sequence is required for Nem1-Spo7 complex formation and Nem1 catalysis on Pah1 in vivo (32527729)
Net1 は Cdc14 を核小体に閉じ込める。FEAR 経路はサイクリン B-: Net1 sequesters Cdc14 in the nucleolus. The FEAR pathway promotes phosphorylation of Net1 by cyclin B-Cdk, and this phosphorylation is required for Cdc14 release (15273393). When PP2A-Cdc55 decreases at early anaphase, Net1 phosphorylation proceeds and Cdc14 exits the nucleolus (30927017)
Net1 は Pol I に直接結合し、試験管内と体内で rRNA の合成を促す: Net1 binds Pol I directly and promotes rRNA synthesis in vitro and in vivo. It also regulates nucleolar structure (11511359)
Nfs1 が減る変異株では、細胞の鉄取り込み系の遺伝子が常に上がり、これは Af: In mutants with reduced Nfs1, genes of the cellular iron uptake system are constitutively upregulated, through an effect on Aft1. Shutting off galactose-induced NFS1 gives the same phenotype (10551871)
Nfs1 のリン酸化はシステインデスルフラーゼ活性を高め、脱リン酸化で下がる。N: Nfs1 phosphorylation increases cysteine desulfurase activity, and dephosphorylation lowers it. Yck2, which co-purifies with Nfs1, phosphorylates Nfs1 in vitro and increases its activity. In Δyck2 mitochondria, Nfs1 phosphorylation activity is reduced and persulfide formation on Nfs1 is slow (28941588)
Nha1 は 14-3-3 の Bmh2 と結合することが知られていた。14-3: Nha1 was known to bind the 14-3-3 protein Bmh2. 14-3-3 binds phosphorylated S481, and the S481A mutation greatly increases Nha1-mediated cation efflux (31446061)
Nhp2 は Cbf5・Nop10 と三量体を作り、Pro83 の異性化が No: Nhp2 forms a trimer with Cbf5 and Nop10, and isomerization of Pro83 affects the interface with Nop10 (21708174)
Nhp2 は Cbf5・Nop10 と核の三量体を作り H/ACA RNA に結: Nhp2 forms a core trimer with Cbf5 and Nop10 and binds H/ACA RNAs (21708174)
Nhp6a・Nhp6b は CP 複合体（Cdc68-Pob3）と結合し、CP: Nhp6a/Nhp6b bind the CP complex (Cdc68-Pob3) and mediate genetic effects on CP-related transcription (11313475)
Nhx1 の C 末端は Gyp6 と結合し、前液胞区画で共局在する。gyp6: The Nhx1 C-terminus binds Gyp6, and they co-localize in the prevacuolar compartment. gyp6 deletion shows phenotypes consistent with loss of negative regulation of Nhx1, such as hygromycin resistance and increased vacuolar pH, and overexpression shows the opposite (14610088)
Nic96 の N 末の heptad repeat が Nsp1-Nup49-: The N-terminal heptad repeat of Nic96 binds the Nsp1-Nup49-Nup57 trimer (7828598)
Nis1 は Nap1 と結合し、Nis1 の安定な維持は Nap1 に依存する: Nis1 binds Nap1, and stable maintenance of Nis1 depends on Nap1 (11817649)
Nis1 は Shs1 を餌にした Y2H で見つかり、生体内でも共免疫沈降で結: Nis1 was found in a Y2H screen with Shs1 as bait, and binding was confirmed in vivo by co-immunoprecipitation (11817649)
Nma1 は Pho4 と結合し、Pho4 を細胞質にとどめて PHO の活性化: Nma1 binds Pho4, retaining Pho4 in the cytoplasm and dampening PHO activation (42615999)
Nmd4-Upf1 の結晶構造。Nmd4 は Upf1 の ATPase 活性を: Crystal structure of Nmd4-Upf1. Nmd4 increases Upf1 ATPase activity, and this binding contributes to elimination of NMD substrates (39331656)
Nob1 は 26S プロテアソームの 19S 制御粒子および Pno1 と複合: Nob1 forms a complex with the 19S regulatory particle of the 26S proteasome and with Pno1 (12502737)
Noc1/Noc2 が 25S rRNA ドメイン I と Rrp5 の両方に結: Noc1/Noc2 bind both 25S rRNA domain I and Rrp5 (31217256)
Noc4 と Nop14 は 40S サブユニットの形成と核外輸送に働く Noc: Noc4 and Nop14 form a Noc complex that acts in 40S subunit formation and nuclear export (12446671). The Noc4 C-terminus is necessary and sufficient for binding Nop14 (20019888)
Nop1 は H2A Q105 をメチル化する酵素で、nop1 の温度感受性変異: Nop1 is the enzyme that methylates H2A Q105; in temperature-sensitive nop1 mutants, Q105 methylation is halved at the restrictive temperature. This mark is restricted to rDNA and blocks FACT binding (24352239)
Nop1p の SRGG モチーフは Hmt1p にメチル化され、Sky1p に: The SRGG motif of Nop1p is methylated by Hmt1p, phosphorylated by Sky1p, and dephosphorylated by Glc7p, and phosphorylation blocks methylation. Without HMT1, Nop1p-GFP does not show typical nucleolar localization. In conditional two-hybrid assays, binding to Nop56p and Nop58p appears to weaken without methylation (31756331)
Nop53 は Nop17 のほか核小体タンパク質 Nip7 とも結合する（tw: Nop53 binds the nucleolar protein Nip7 in addition to Nop17 (two-hybrid) (16128814)
Nop53 は Rrp6 と Mtr4 に結合し、7S のプロセシングにエキソソ: Nop53 binds Rrp6 and Mtr4 and is regarded as an adaptor that recruits the exosome for 7S processing (31662437)
Nop7-Erb1-Ytm1 複合体は AAA ATPase Rea1 によって: The Nop7-Erb1-Ytm1 complex is removed from pre-60S by the AAA ATPase Rea1 (26657628). Crystal structure of the complex of Rea1-MIDAS with the Ytm1 UBL domain (31296859)
Nop9 は Nob1 の切断部位近くの 20S pre-rRNA を認識し、N: Nop9 recognizes 20S pre-rRNA near the Nob1 cleavage site and suppresses Nob1 cleavage (27725644)
Northern・ゲルシフト・フットプリントで PDR15 の転写は Pdr1・: By Northern, gel shift, and footprinting, PDR15 transcription is controlled by Pdr1 and Pdr3. They bind the PDRE (9428726)
Not1 の C 末・Not2・Not5 の芯の複合体の結晶構造で、Not2 と: In the crystal structure of the core complex of the Not1 C-terminus, Not2, and Not5, Not2 and Not5 wrap around Not1 (24121231)
Not4 E3 リガーゼは生体内・試験管内で Rps7A をユビキチン化し、パラ: The Not4 E3 ligase ubiquitinates Rps7A in vivo and in vitro, but not its paralog Rps7B (22243599)
Not4 は Ecm29 と相互作用する。Not4 が無いと Ecm29 はプロ: Not4 interacts with Ecm29. Without Not4, Ecm29 binding to the proteasome weakens, and Ecm29 is ubiquitinated and degraded (21321079)
Not5 は Rpb4 と結合し（two-hybrid・共免疫沈降）、Rpb4: Not5 binds Rpb4 (two-hybrid, co-immunoprecipitation) and is required for the presence of Rpb4 on polysomes, its binding to eIF3, and its binding to mRNA (25340856)
Npa1・Npa2 は Dbp6 に直接結合し、Npa1 は Dbp6 の 90: Npa1/Npa2 bind Dbp6 directly, and Npa1 is essential for incorporation of Dbp6 into 90S pre-ribosomal particles (30169518)
Npa2p（Urb2p）と Npa1p（Urb1p）が Dbp6p・Nop8p・: Npa2p (Urb2p) and Npa1p (Urb1p) form a small complex with Dbp6p, Nop8p, and Rsa3p (17145778)
Npa2p（Urb2p）・Dbp6p・Npa1p・Nop8p・Rsa3p が R: Npa2p (Urb2p), Dbp6p, Npa1p, Nop8p, and Rsa3p form a small RNA-independent complex (17145778)
Npa3 は Gpn3・Rba50 と結合し、Npa3 と Gpn3 のタンパク: Npa3 binds Gpn3 and Rba50, and Npa3 and Gpn3 protein levels depend on each other (32985767)
Npi3/Bro1 はアンモニウムで起こる Gap1 の取り込みと分解、とくに: Npi3/Bro1 is required for ammonium-induced internalization and degradation of Gap1, especially efficient ubiquitination of Gap1. It is also required for direct sorting of newly made Gap1 to the vacuole in npr1 mutants (12062418)
Npl3 の細胞質でのリン酸化は mRNA の運び出しに要り、mRNA に結合し: Cytoplasmic phosphorylation of Npl3 is required for mRNA export, and mRNA-bound Npl3 is the dephosphorylated form. The nuclear phosphatase Glc7 promotes Npl3 dephosphorylation in vivo, and this dephosphorylation is required for mRNA export. Recruitment of Mex67 to mRNA depends on Glc7 (14759366)
Npl4・Ufd1・Cdc48 を含む膜結合複合体がプロテアソームによる Mga: A membrane-bound complex containing Npl4, Ufd1, and Cdc48 mediates proteasomal cleavage of Mga2 and Spt23; mutations stop cleavage and abolish OLE1 expression (11598205)
Npr1 と Npr2 は Mep2 の C 末端の自己抑制ドメインをリン酸化で: Npr1 and Npr2 control transport activity by silencing the C-terminal autoinhibitory domain of Mep2 through phosphorylation. When nitrogen is scarce, Npr1 enables Mep2 S457 phosphorylation and transport activity (24476960)
Npr1 の過剰発現は Tat2 の分解を引き起こす。TOR は Npr1 をリ: Npr1 overexpression triggers Tat2 degradation. TOR phosphorylates Npr1 and suppresses starvation-induced Tat2 degradation (9843498)
Npr1 は Gap1 を細胞膜で安定させ、新しく作られた Gap1 を細胞膜へ: Npr1 stabilizes Gap1 at the plasma membrane and is required for delivering newly made Gap1 to the plasma membrane (in npr1Δ it goes directly to the vacuole). Gap1 phosphorylation does not strictly depend on Npr1
Npr1 はエンドサイトーシスの負の調節因子で、TORC1 に抑えられる。Npr: Npr1 is a negative regulator of endocytosis and is inhibited by TORC1. Npr1 suppresses the activity of Art1, which directs Rsp5 to plasma membrane cargo, and N-terminal phosphorylation of Art1 prevents Art1 from associating with the plasma membrane (22118465). No PMC main text
Npr1 は窒素に依存した Pib2 のリン酸化と、Pib2 に依存した TOR: Npr1 mediates nitrogen-dependent phosphorylation of Pib2 and Pib2-dependent inhibition of TORC1. A feedback enabling rapid reactivation of TORC1 (31622882)
Nrd1 と Nab3 のヘテロ二量体化は、新生 RNA の認識と Pol II: Nrd1–Nab3 heterodimerization is essential for linking recognition of nascent RNA with recognition of the Pol II CTD. The structure was determined (35022249)
Nrd1–Nab3 heterodimerization is essential for linking recognition of nascent RNA with recognition of the Pol II CTD (35022249)
Nrs1 は Swi4・Swi6 と物理的に結合し G1/S のプロモーターに局: Nrs1 binds Swi4/Swi6 physically and localizes to G1/S promoters. It appears only when nitrogen is scarce and acts at Start (35239649)
Nrs1 binds Swi4/Swi6 physically and localizes to G1/S promoters (35239649)
Nsa2 は Nog1 の働きの相手。Nsa2 がなくても Nog1 は pre: Nsa2 is a functional partner of Nog1. Without Nsa2, Nog1 still binds pre-60S, but without Nog1, Nsa2 disappears from pre-60S (16861225)
Nse1 の RING ドメインの変異 nse1-103 は Nse3・Nse4: The Nse1 RING domain mutation nse1-103 cannot bind Nse3, Nse4, or Smc5 (29119272)
Nse1 の RING 変異 nse1-103 は Nse3 と、Smc5/6: The Nse1 RING mutation nse1-103 weakens binding to Nse3 and to Nse4 and Smc5 of Smc5/6 (29119272)
Nse5 と Nse6 は互いに結合し、ヘテロ二量体として Smc5・Smc6: Nse5 and Nse6 bind each other and, as a heterodimer, bind the hinge regions of Smc5/Smc6 (two-hybrid, recombinant proteins, 19141609)
Nse5-Nse6 ヘテロ二量体が Smc5・Smc6 のヒンジ領域に結合する（: The Nse5-Nse6 heterodimer binds the hinge regions of Smc5/Smc6 (19141609)
Nsi1 がないと Sir2 の NTS1 への結合が減り、NTS1 のヒストン: Without Nsi1, Sir2 binding to NTS1 decreases and histone acetylation at NTS1 increases (22362748)
Nsi1 は Net1・Sir2・Fob1 と物理的に結合（22362748）: Nsi1 binds Net1, Sir2, and Fob1 physically (22362748)
Nst1 を介した Ste11 と Mkk1 の結合が、熱とフェロモンに応じて: Nst1-mediated binding of Ste11 and Mkk1 links the HOG and pheromone pathways to the CWI pathway in response to heat and pheromone (26787465)
Ntc20p は Prp19p とは直接結合せず、Ntc85p と相互作用する（: Ntc20p does not bind Prp19p directly but interacts with Ntc85p (11018040). Ntc85p is Cef1p (10092627)
Ntc30（Isy1）は Prp19 とは直接結合せず、複合体の別の構成要素 N: Ntc30 (Isy1) does not bind Prp19 directly but binds Ntc85 (Cef1), another component of the complex (11018040)
Ntc90 は NTC によるスプライソソーム活性化には要らないが、Yju2 の: Ntc90 is not required for NTC-mediated spliceosome activation but is required for recruitment of Yju2 (19617314)
Ntf2 は RanGDP の取り込み因子（12654904）。ntf2 の条件: Ntf2 is the import factor for RanGDP (12654904). In conditional lethal ntf2 mutants, Gsp1 does not accumulate in the nucleus (11024003). Gsp1–Ntf2 binding is indispensable for nuclear transport; NTF2 overexpression suppresses gsp1 mutations, but mutant Ntf2 that cannot bind Gsp1 does not (9199309)
Ntg1 が ori5 に二本鎖切断を入れ、それが Mhr1 によるローリングサ: Ntg1 introduces a double-strand break at ori5, which initiates Mhr1-mediated rolling-circle replication. The increase in mtDNA copy number with hydrogen peroxide depends on Ntg1 and Mhr1 (19074198)
Nth1 は PKA の既知の標的だが、Ypk1 の下流でもリン酸化・活性化され: Nth1 is a known PKA target but is also phosphorylated and activated downstream of Ypk1 (32102971 abstract). Main text: inhibition of Ypk1 lowers Nth1 phosphorylation and activity in vivo, and Ypk1 activates Nth1 in vitro. Whether phosphorylation is direct "remains to be determined"
Ntr1 による Prp43 のヘリカーゼ活性の促進がラリアット・イントロンの放: Stimulation of Prp43 helicase activity by Ntr1 is required for lariat intron release. The lethal Prp43 mutants T384A and T384V hydrolyze ATP but are not stimulated by Ntr1 and cannot release the intron (17875666)
Ntr1（Spp382）と Ntr2 は安定な複合体を作り、Prp43 と NT: Ntr1 (Spp382) and Ntr2 form a stable complex and form the NTR complex with Prp43. Ntr2 binds Brr2 and is essential for association with U5 and the spliceosome (17893323)
Ntr2 は Brr2 の C 末端のヘリカーゼ部分に結合し、試験管内で Brr: Ntr2 binds the C-terminal helicase portion of Brr2 and lowers Brr2 helicase activity in vitro (29490241)
NuA4 が SWR-C でクロマチンに入った Htz1 の K14 をアセチル: NuA4 acetylates K14 of Htz1 deposited into chromatin by SWR-C. Elp3 is not mentioned (16543219) (PMID: 16543219)
NuA4 と NHEJ 因子は互いに拮抗する。NuA4 は Nej1 と Yku: NuA4 and NHEJ factors antagonize each other. NuA4 newly acetylates Nej1 and Yku80, and acetylation-mimicking Nej1 mutants block NHEJ repair, reduce binding to Yku80 and Lif1, and promote end resection (34543274). The results are from mimetic mutants, so confidence is medium. BioGRID's 19303850 is a proteome-wide protein chip analysis
NuA4 による Sip2 のアセチル化は Snf1 との結合を強め、Sip2-: Acetylation of Sip2 by NuA4 strengthens its binding to Snf1, and Sip2–Snf1 binding suppresses Snf1 activity and reduces Sch9 phosphorylation (21906795)
NuA4 の Esa1 が Nup60 をアセチル化して mRNA の輸出を促し: Esa1 of NuA4 acetylates Nup60 to promote mRNA export, and acetylated Nup60 recruits Sac3 (35735140)
NuA4 の構造で、Piccolo モジュールのサブユニット Esa1・Yng2: In the NuA4 structure, the positions of the Piccolo module subunits Esa1, Yng2, and Eaf6 were determined (36417436)
NuA4 の非クロマチン基質として Pck1 が見つかり、K514 のアセチル化: Pck1 was found as a non-chromatin substrate of NuA4, and K514 acetylation is required for enzyme activity and growth on non-fermentable carbon sources. Sir2 deacetylates Pck1 (19303850)
NuA4 は Cdc3・Cdc12・Shs1 を試験管内でアセチル化し、触媒活性: NuA4 acetylates Cdc3, Cdc12, and Shs1 in vitro, and acetylation of Shs1 and Cdc10 decreases in catalytically inactive esa1 mutants. Cells expressing Shs1 with reduced acetylation show septin localization defects like NuA4 mutants (21984913). The in vivo dependence on Esa1 is partial, so confidence is medium
NuA4 は RPS11B などのプロモーターに来て TFIID を呼び込み転写: NuA4 comes to promoters such as RPS11B, recruits TFIID, and initiates transcription. In eaf1Δ, this recruitment is impaired (26100014)
NuA4 は SWR-C がクロマチンに入れた後の Htz1 の K14 をアセ: NuA4 acetylates K14 of Htz1 after SWR-C deposits it into chromatin, and K14 mutants show chromosome transmission defects (16543219). Htz1 K14 acetylation is enriched at promoters of active genes and requires Gcn5 and Esa1 (16543223). Acetylation of Htz1 K8, K10, and K14 is all added by Esa1 and removed by Hda1 (20952395)
Nuf2 の CH ドメインの 2 つの部分が Ndc80 複合体での Mps1: Two parts of the Nuf2 CH domain form the Mps1-binding site in the Ndc80 complex; disrupting them causes defects in the spindle checkpoint and chromosome segregation (38776906)
Nug2 は核質の pre-60S 粒子に Nmd3 より先に結合し、その位置は: Nug2 binds nucleoplasmic pre-60S particles before Nmd3, and its position clashes with that of the export adaptor Nmd3. Reducing Nug2 causes premature Nmd3 binding, and with G-domain mutations Nmd3 is not recruited and 60S export is strongly blocked (24240281)
Num1 が Pac1/LIS1 を外してダイニンの運動をオンにする（26483: Num1 removes Pac1/LIS1 and switches on dynein motility (26483554)
Nup1-GFP のプロテアソーム分解は San1 に依存。nup120Δ では: Proteasomal degradation of Nup1-GFP depends on San1. In nup120Δ, San1 also contributes to degradation of endogenous Nup1 (38302116)
Nup120 と Nup133 の結合を見つけ、生体内での意義も確かめた（197: Binding between Nup120 and Nup133 was found, and its in vivo significance was confirmed (19706512)
Nup157 と Nup145N が Nup84 の 7 量体複合体に結合する（: Nup157 and Nup145N bind the heptameric Nup84 complex (15741174)
Nup159 を分解すると Dbp5 が NPC から離れる（10428971）: Degrading Nup159 releases Dbp5 from the NPC (10428971). Nup159 is required for ADP release from Dbp5 (in vitro, 21576266)
Nup170 の N 末領域が Nup159・Nup188・Pom34 などを核: The N-terminal region of Nup170 recruits and retains Nup159, Nup188, Pom34, and others at nuclear pores (19414606)
Nup42-CTD は Gle1 に結合し、IP6 とともに Gle1 による: The Nup42 CTD binds Gle1 and, together with IP6, promotes Gle1-mediated activation of Dbp5 in vitro. NUP42 deletion abolishes Gle1–Dbp5 binding (28869701)
Nup53 の分裂期に特有のリン酸化に Cdk1 も寄与し、Cdk1 の阻害か: Cdk1 also contributes to the mitosis-specific phosphorylation of Nup53, and Cdk1 inhibition or mutation of Cdk1 sites partly blocks the phosphorylation (17461799)
Nup53-プロテイン A で Nup53・Nup59・Nup170 の複合体を: A complex of Nup53, Nup59, and Nup170 was purified using Nup53-protein A, and each was shown to bind the others in vitro (9864357)
Nup53・Nup59・Nup170 の複合体を精製し、試験管内でそれぞれが互い: A complex of Nup53, Nup59, and Nup170 was purified, and each was shown to bind the others in vitro (9864357)
Nup82 の β プロペラが Nup116 の C 末端断片と Nup159: The β-propeller of Nup82 binds a C-terminal fragment of Nup116 and the C-terminal tail of Nup159. Hotspots were determined by mutation (21930948)
Nup84 は Nup120・Nup85・Sec13・Sec13 相同体と複合体: Nup84 forms a complex with Nup120, Nup85, Sec13, and a Sec13 homolog and is required for nuclear pore formation (8565072)
Nup84 forms a complex with Nup120, Nup85, Sec13, and a Sec13 homolog (8565072)
Nur1 は Net1 と結合し、Cdk にリン酸化された形で Cdc14 の放: Nur1 binds Net1 and, in its Cdk-phosphorylated form, suppresses Cdc14 release. In early anaphase Cdc14 dephosphorylates Nur1, forming a positive feedback loop (25569132)
OAF3 欠損で POT1 mRNA の蓄積が野生型より速い。Oaf3 は β: In OAF3 deletion, POT1 mRNA accumulates faster than in wild type. Oaf3 is a repressor of β-oxidation genes (23088601)
OMS1 の過剰発現で変異型・野生型の Oxa1 の定常量が増える（153559: OMS1 overexpression increases steady-state levels of mutant and wild-type Oxa1 (15355998)
ORC の ATP 加水分解には Orc1 と Orc4 の協調した働きが要る（: ATP hydrolysis by ORC requires coordinated action of Orc1 and Orc4 (15610739)
OSI1 プロモーターのレポーターで、アリシンによる OSI1 の発現誘導は Y: With an OSI1 promoter reporter, allicin-induced OSI1 expression depends completely on Yap1p (28479370)
OST を弱く変性させると Stt3・Ost3・Ost4 の部分複合体が得られる: Mild denaturation of OST yields an Stt3-Ost3-Ost4 subcomplex (9405463)
OST5 の過剰発現が ost1 変異を抑圧し、Ost5 は OTase の構成: OST5 overexpression suppresses ost1 mutations, and Ost5 is thought to be an OTase component, probably binding Ost1 (9135133)
OYE2 の抗酸化作用は相同でヘテロ二量体を作る OYE3 に打ち消される。OY: The antioxidant effect of OYE2 is counteracted by the homologous OYE3, which forms heterodimers with it. OYE3 requires OYE2 to act (17897954)
Oaf1 と Oaf2（Pip2）の複合体が POX1 と FOX3（POT1）: The Oaf1–Oaf2 (Pip2) complex is required for oleate activation of POX1 and FOX3 (POT1). Oaf1 binds UAS1 of POX1 (8972187)
Oct1 は Coq5 の N 末端を直接切断し、Coq5 の安定性を大きく高め: Oct1 directly cleaves the N-terminus of Coq5 and greatly increases Coq5 stability. A single mutation in the Oct1 recognition sequence of Coq5 abolishes cleavage, causing CoQ deficiency and loss of respiration (29220658)
Om45 のミトコンドリアへの取り込みにはプレ配列受容体 Tom20・Tom22: Import of Om45 into mitochondria requires the presequence receptors Tom20/Tom22 and Tom40 (24781694)
Oma1 は Coa2 を欠く細胞で Cox1 の速い分解を担うが、ほかの組み立: Oma1 mediates rapid degradation of Cox1 in cells lacking Coa2 but not in other assembly mutants (22219186)
Oms1 は シトクロム c 酸化酵素の組み立て中間体の構成要素で、新しく合成さ: Oms1 is a component of cytochrome c oxidase assembly intermediates and stabilizes newly synthesized Cox1 (27030670)
Opy1 は Mss4 と相互作用し、細胞膜での PI(4,5)P2 合成の負の: Opy1 interacts with Mss4 and is proposed to act as a negative regulator of PI(4,5)P2 synthesis at the plasma membrane (22562153)
Opy2 は Ste50 の結合部位 CR-A・CR-B をもつ。CR-A はい: Opy2 has the Ste50-binding sites CR-A and CR-B. CR-A always binds Ste50, but CR-B binds Ste50 only when Opy2 is phosphorylated by Yck1/Yck2 under glucose-rich conditions, transmitting the signal mainly to Hog1 (20932477)
Orm2 はリン酸化で ER を出て、ゴルジ・エンドソームで Dsc ユビキチン: Upon phosphorylation, Orm2 exits the ER and is polyubiquitinated by the Dsc ubiquitin ligase in the Golgi/endosomes, extracted from the membrane by Cdc48/VCP, and tightly coupled to proteasomal degradation. EGAD prevents Orm2 accumulation and releases the brake on sphingolipid synthesis (31368600)
Osh1 は Nvj1 と物理的に結合して核-液胞接合部に局在する（Vac8 が: Osh1 binds Nvj1 physically and localizes to nucleus–vacuole junctions (co-localizing with Nvj1 even without Vac8) (15367582)
Osh2 と Osh3 が Myo5 を小胞体の VAP（Scs2）につなぎ、エ: Osh2 and Osh3 link Myo5 to the ER VAP (Scs2), creating contacts between endocytic sites and the ER (29173820)
Osh2・Osh3 が Myo5 と Scs2 をつなぎ、この接触がエンドサイト: Osh2/Osh3 link Myo5 and Scs2, and this contact assists actin polymerization at endocytic sites (29173820)
Osh6 の ER-PM 接触部位への局在は Ist2 の尾部との結合に依存（3: Localization of Osh6 to ER-PM contact sites depends on binding to the Ist2 tail (32327560). Ist2 directly recruits Osh6/7 to ER-PM contact sites (34259806)
Osm1 はミトコンドリア膜間腔に局在し Erv1 と複合体を作る。Erv1 か: Osm1 localizes to the mitochondrial intermembrane space and forms a complex with Erv1. It assists electron transfer from Erv1 to fumarate (28814504)
Otu1 は Cdc48 複合体に呼び込まれて活性化され、ユビキチン鎖を刈り込む: Otu1 is recruited to and activated by the Cdc48 complex and trims ubiquitin chains (25215493). Cdc48 binds Otu1 (16427015)
Oxa1 はミトリボソームの大サブユニットと会合し、出口トンネルの隣の Mrp2: Oxa1 associates with the large subunit of the mitoribosome and crosslinks to Mrp20 next to the exit tunnel (14657017)
P ボディのタンパク質 Lsm1 は複製ストレスのとき TMA16 などの mR: The P-body protein Lsm1 limits levels of mRNAs such as TMA16 during replication stress, preventing their harmful accumulation (28916784)
P-Fbp1 は野生型では半減期 30 分未満で分解されるが、gid1Δ・gid: P-Fbp1 is degraded with a half-life under 30 minutes in wild type but is stable in gid1Δ, gid2Δ, gid3Δ, and gid4Δ (28126757). Under gluconeogenic conditions the GID ligase consists of six subunits including Gid1/Vid30, and with glucose Gid4 joins to cause Fbp1 ubiquitination (22645139)
PAB1 の欠失体を使った質量分析で、PBP2 などの PAB1 の特定のドメイ: Mass spectrometry using PAB1 deletion constructs confirmed direct binding of PBP2 and others via specific PAB1 domains (22836166)
PAD1 と FDC1 を一緒に過剰発現すると桂皮酸の脱炭酸活性が大きく上がり、: Co-overexpression of PAD1 and FDC1 greatly increases cinnamic acid decarboxylation activity, which is not seen with FDC1 alone (25852989)
PAD1 は補因子 prFMN を作る酵素。細菌の AroY-B が Fdc1: PAD1 is the enzyme that makes the cofactor prFMN. Bacterial AroY-B can substitute for Pad1 function in Fdc1-mediated decarboxylation (28283523)
PAK（Ste20・Cla4・Skm1）は Sut1 と複合体を作り、核に入って: PAKs (Ste20, Cla4, Skm1) form complexes with Sut1, enter the nucleus, and lower expression of the Sut1 targets AUS1 and DAN1. Dependent on SUT1 (19793923)
PALO でアルギニンを制限すると HIS3 と TRP5 のプロモーター融合の: Restricting arginine with PALO increases expression of HIS3 and TRP5 promoter fusions, and the increase depends on GCN4 protein (2689869)
PALO によるアルギニン欠乏で CPA1・CPA2 の発現が上がり、これは G: Arginine deprivation by PALO increases CPA1/CPA2 expression, dependent on GCN4. In gcn4, CPA2-lacZ is 1/5 to 1/6 (2689869)
PAN3 がコードする 76 kDa のタンパク質は PAN の酵素活性に必要。: The 76 kDa protein encoded by PAN3 is required for PAN enzyme activity. Extracts lacking PAN3 lose PAN activity, and removing Pan3 from purified PAN abolishes activity. Pan2 and Pan3 bind, and lacking either lengthens poly(A) tails in vivo (8816488). Consistent with the UniProt direction (activation)
PAS キナーゼは UDP-グルコースピロホスホリラーゼ（Ugp1）とグリコーゲ: PAS kinase phosphorylates UDP-glucose pyrophosphorylase (Ugp1) and glycogen synthase (Gsy2); both enzymes are inhibited by this phosphorylation, lowering sugar storage (12372297). The abstract describes the two PAS kinase genes together
PBS2 の過剰発現と PTC1 の破壊はどちらも EXG1 の転写を高め、エキ: PBS2 overexpression and PTC1 disruption both increase EXG1 transcription, raising exo-β-glucanase activity and reducing β-1,6-glucan. pbs2 loss of function is epistatic to ptc1 disruption (7565587)
PCL2 は PHO85 と生体内・試験管内で結合し、G1 期に周期的な活性をも: PCL2 binds PHO85 in vivo and in vitro and forms a kinase complex with periodic activity in G1 (7973731)
PCL9 は M 期の終わり〜G1 期の初めに発現し、転写因子 Swi5 によっ: PCL9 is expressed from late M to early G1 and is activated by the transcription factor Swi5 (9593297
PCNA の K63 鎖のポリユビキチン化には MMS2・UBC13・RAD5: K63-linked polyubiquitination of PCNA requires MMS2, UBC13, and RAD5 (12226657). (Ubc13-Mms2)-Rad5 extends K63 chains on monoubiquitinated PCNA, promoting error-free damage bypass (19706603)

K63-linked polyubiquitination of PCNA requires MMS2, UBC13, and RAD5 (12226657). Upon DNA damage, PCNA K164 is monoubiquitinated by Rad6-Rad18 and then polyubiquitinated with K63 chains dependent on Mms2-Ubc13 and Rad5 (15121847)
PCNA の変異体の一部は Mlh1-Pms1 エンドヌクレアーゼの活性化に欠け: Some PCNA mutants are deficient in activating the Mlh1-Pms1 endonuclease (24981171, in vivo genetics and in vitro). In vitro, activation of Mlh1-Pms1 requires Msh2-Msh6, PCNA, and RFC (26170454)
PCNA は Apn2 と結合し、Apn2 の 3'→5' エキソヌクレアーゼと: PCNA binds Apn2 and stimulates its 3'→5' exonuclease and 3'-phosphodiesterase activities (12192046)
PCNA は RAD6・RAD18 でモノユビキチン化され、損傷による PCNA: PCNA is monoubiquitinated by RAD6/RAD18, and damage-induced PCNA ubiquitination is indispensable for DNA repair (12226657). Upon DNA damage, PCNA K164 is monoubiquitinated in a Rad6-Rad18-dependent manner (15121847)

PCNA is monoubiquitinated by RAD6/RAD18, and damage-induced PCNA ubiquitination is indispensable for DNA repair (12226657). Upon DNA damage, PCNA is monoubiquitinated at K164, and this modification is required for translesion synthesis by Polη and Polζ (16611731)
PCSS（Psy3・Csm2・Shu1・Shu2）は組換えの場に結合し、減数分裂: PCSS (Psy3, Csm2, Shu1, Shu2) binds recombination sites and is required for Rad51 assembly and function in meiosis. In vitro, Psy3-Csm2 stabilizes the Rad51-ssDNA complex (23575680)
PDC1 欠失株で PDC5 の発現が誘導され（自己調節）、その誘導は転写調節因: In PDC1 deletion strains, PDC5 expression is induced (autoregulation), and the induction depends on the transcriptional regulator Pdc2 (42388010)
PDE1 は低親和性 cAMP ホスホジエステラーゼ。BCY1 への作用は cA: PDE1 is a low-affinity cAMP phosphodiesterase. Its effect on BCY1 is via cAMP degradation (when cAMP falls, BCY1 inhibits PKA)
PDE2 は高親和性 cAMP ホスホジエステラーゼで、多コピーで RAS2Va: PDE2 is a high-affinity cAMP phosphodiesterase, and in multicopy it counteracts the RAS2Val19 phenotype. Its effect on BCY1 is via cAMP degradation
PDH 複合体は Pda1 の可逆的なリン酸化で調節される。YOR090C の欠: The PDH complex is regulated by reversible phosphorylation of Pda1. Loss of YOR090C lowers PDH activity, and Yor090c acts as a PDH phosphatase (16643908)
PDI の相同タンパク質 Mpd2 も Ero1 に酸化される: The PDI homolog Mpd2 is also oxidized by Ero1
PDR10 の転写は Pdr1 と Pdr3 が制御し、pdr3 欠失・pdr3: PDR10 transcription is controlled by Pdr1 and Pdr3, and mRNA levels change with pdr3 deletion and the pdr3-2 mutation (9428726)
PDR10 の転写は Pdr1 と Pdr3 が制御する（ノーザン・ゲルシフト・: PDR10 transcription is controlled by Pdr1 and Pdr3 (Northern, gel shift, DNase I footprinting). GST-Pdr1 binds the PDRE of PDR10 (9428726)
PDR16 などのプロモーターに Pdr1 の結合配列があり、PDR1 の欠失・: The promoters of PDR16 and others have Pdr1-binding sequences, and PDR1 deletion and pdr1-3 change PDR16 promoter activity and mRNA levels (11470516)
PDR16 の過剰発現によるアムホテリシン B 耐性には PMP3 が必須（38: PMP3 is essential for amphotericin B resistance due to PDR16 overexpression (38727600)
PDX3 のプロモーターに Gcn4 結合配列の候補がいくつかあり、窒素代謝の一: The PDX3 promoter has several candidate Gcn4-binding sequences, and it is presumed to be under general control of nitrogen metabolism (no experiments) (7896706) (PMID: 7896706)
PEP3 は PEP12・PEP7 と遺伝学的に相互作用し、Pep3・Pep5: PEP3 interacts genetically with PEP12 and PEP7, and Pep3/Pep5 bind Pep7 in two-hybrid assays (10978279)
PES4 と MIP6 は NDT80 で誘導される遺伝子で、NDT80 の標的: PES4 and MIP6 are NDT80-induced genes that regulate the timing of translation of some NDT80 target mRNAs (28193845)
PET117 は活性のあるシトクロム c 酸化酵素の組み立てに要るが、完成した複: PET117 is required for assembly of active cytochrome c oxidase but is not a subunit of the finished complex (8381337)
PET122 の C 末欠失を対立遺伝子特異的に抑圧する新しい遺伝子として MR: MRP17 and PET127 were identified as new genes that allele-specifically suppress a C-terminal deletion of PET122 (1279374)
PET191 は活性のあるシトクロム c 酸化酵素の組み立てに要るが、完成した複: PET191 is required for assembly of active cytochrome c oxidase but is not a subunit of the finished complex (8381337). Pet191 is essential for cytochrome c oxidase maturation (18503002)
PEX39 は PEX7 に結合して PTS2 積み荷との相互作用を安定にし、P: PEX39 binds PEX7, stabilizing its interaction with PTS2 cargo and assisting transport of PTS2 proteins into peroxisomes (40739340)
PG の分解産物ジアシルグリセロールが Pgs1 の基質と競合し、余分な PG: Diacylglycerol, a PG breakdown product, competes with Pgs1 substrates and suppresses excess PG synthesis. Without Pgc1, this loop does not operate (36377885)
PGI1・ENO2・TPI1・FOL3 の変異で H3T11 のリン酸化が下がる: Mutations in PGI1, ENO2, TPI1, and FOL3 lower H3T11 phosphorylation. Glycolysis regulates H3T11 phosphorylation by supplying the substrate PEP and the coactivator FBP to Pyk1 (28426732)
PGK プロモーターの Reb1・Abf1 結合部位は染色体上の PGK 遺伝子: The Reb1 and Abf1 binding sites in the PGK promoter are required for full transcriptional activation of the chromosomal PGK gene, and the main activity is due to the Rap1 site (8602150)
PGM1 は RAS2(val19) 変異のガラクトースでの増殖欠損の量的抑圧因: PGM1 was obtained as a dosage suppressor of the growth defect of RAS2(val19) mutants on galactose (16292676)
PGU1 の発現は 2 つの転写因子 TEC1 と STE12 の転写量で決まる: PGU1 expression is determined by the transcript levels of two transcription factors, TEC1 and STE12 (19840115)
PGU1 を抑えるサイレントな構造の形成は Isw2 クロマチンリモデリング複合: Formation of the silent structure that represses PGU1 depends on the Isw2 chromatin remodeling complex and its subunit Dls1 (20074297)
PHO13 を欠くと TAL1 などペントースリン酸経路の遺伝子の転写が活性化さ: Without PHO13, transcription of pentose phosphate pathway genes such as TAL1 is activated, and increased TAL1 expression is the main cause of improved xylose metabolism (26724864)
PHO2 と GCN4 は TRP4 の UAS1 に排他的に結合し、低リン酸か: PHO2 and GCN4 bind UAS1 of TRP4 exclusively, and under low phosphate with amino acid starvation PHO2 binding blocks the general control response (2656261) (PMID: 2656261)
PHO3 を含む THI 遺伝子のチアミン欠乏での誘導には Thi2 と Thi: Induction of THI genes, including PHO3, under thiamine deficiency requires Thi2 and Thi3 simultaneously (16194233)
PHO3 を含む THI 遺伝子の誘導には Thi2 と Thi3 が同時に必要: Induction of THI genes, including PHO3, requires Thi2 and Thi3 simultaneously (16194233)
PHO5・PHO81・PHO84 の転写には Pho4 と Pho2 が必要（9: Transcription of PHO5, PHO81, and PHO84 requires Pho4 and Pho2 (9392074). PHO81 transcription is regulated by phosphate levels through Pho4/Pho2 (8626060)
PHO5・PHO81・PHO84 の転写には Pho4 と Pho2 が要るが、: Transcription of PHO5, PHO81, and PHO84 requires Pho4 and Pho2, but PHO8 is transcribed with Pho4 alone (9392074)
PHO81 の転写には Pho4 と Pho2 が必要で、Pho2 は PHO: PHO81 transcription requires Pho4 and Pho2, and Pho2 binds A/T-rich sequences in PHO promoters (9392074). Phosphate regulation of PHO81 transcription is through Pho4/Pho2 (8626060)
PHO84 の転写には Pho4 と Pho2 が必要で、PHO84 の部位 D: PHO84 transcription requires Pho4 and Pho2, and sites D and E of PHO84 act as UASs responding to phosphate concentration and pho2 mutation (9392074). Pho2/Pho4 are required for alkaline induction of PHO84 (12453218)
PHO84 プロモーターに Pho4 の結合部位があり、誘導時のクロマチン再構成: The PHO84 promoter has Pho4-binding sites, and chromatin remodeling upon induction strictly depends on Pho4
PHO92 上流の Gcr1 結合部位の変異や GCR1 欠失で PHO92 が: Mutation of the Gcr1-binding site upstream of PHO92 or GCR1 deletion increases PHO92 (24850134)
PI(3,5)P2 は Vph1 を含む V-ATPase の完全な組み立てと活: PI(3,5)P2 is required for full assembly and activity of Vph1-containing V-ATPase, and adding it increases activity and proton transport. PI(3,5)P2 appears to bind Vph1 directly (31023825)
PI4P は Sec2 の膜への呼び込みと調節の切り替えを担う（20493815: PI4P mediates membrane recruitment of Sec2 and the switch in its regulation (20493815). Main text: PI4P production by Pik1, together with Ypt32, is required for Sec2 localization
PIR1 の発現は Swi5 だけに依存する（11309124）: PIR1 expression depends on Swi5 alone (11309124)
PIR1・YPL158C・YNL046W の発現は Swi5 だけに依存する（1: Expression of PIR1, YPL158C, and YNL046W depends on Swi5 alone (11309124)
PIS1 のイノシトールによる誘導は Ino2・Ino4 に依存しないが、十分な: Inositol induction of PIS1 does not depend on Ino2/Ino4, but full expression requires Ino4 (19019152)
PKA が Nth1 の N 末端をリン酸化すると 14-3-3 が結合して酵素: When PKA phosphorylates the N-terminus of Nth1, 14-3-3 binds and enzyme activity increases; Ser60 and Ser83 are the main sites (PMID 22320399). In tpk1 tpk2 strains with low PKA activity, neutral trehalase is inactivated by heat, and restoring TPK1 or TPK2 restores the increase in activity (PMID 9738892). BioGRID's 20639203 is an in vitro substrate specificity experiment
PKA と TORC1 は Dot6・Tod6 という抑制因子を不活性化して R: PKA and TORC1 activate Ribi genes by inactivating the repressors Dot6 and Tod6 (title of 19901341). Sch9, a direct TORC1 substrate, directly phosphorylates and inhibits Stb3, Dot6, and Tod6, promoting expression of Ribi and RP genes (21730963)
PKA と TORC1 は抑制因子 Dot6・Tod6 を不活性化して Ribi: PKA and TORC1 activate Ribi genes by inactivating the repressors Dot6 and Tod6. Tod6 mediates repression after inhibition of the TORC1 pathway
PKA による Yak1 の S295 などのリン酸化は Yak1 の核移行を抑: Phosphorylation of Yak1 at S295 and other sites by PKA suppresses nuclear translocation of Yak1. Under high glucose, Yak1 stays in the cytoplasm in an inactive form (together with Bmh1 binding). The only BioGRID record was a protein chip (16319894)
PKA による t-SNARE のリン酸化は SNARE の組み立てを妨げエキソ: PKA phosphorylation of t-SNAREs blocks SNARE assembly and suppresses exo- and endocytosis. Phosphorylation of Sso1 S79 promotes binding of the inhibitor Vsm1 (PMID 12925750). The S79A mutation allows snc deletion strains to grow (PMID 11157748)
PKA に依存した Yak1 の S295 などのリン酸化は Yak1 の核移行: PKA-dependent phosphorylation of Yak1 at S295 and other sites suppresses nuclear translocation of Yak1
PKA に抑えられている Yak1 は、グルコース枯渇などで PKA が下がると: Yak1, held in check by PKA, phosphorylates and activates Hsf1 when PKA falls, e.g., upon glucose depletion. It phosphorylates Hsf1 directly in vitro and increases its DNA binding (18793336)
PKA に抑えられる Yak1 が、PKA 活性が下がると Msn2 をリン酸化: Yak1, inhibited by PKA, phosphorylates and activates Msn2 when PKA activity falls (phosphorylated in vitro; DNA binding and nuclear localization are unchanged)
PKA の活性が高い株では Sko1 の抑制がさらに強まり、PKA は Sko1: In strains with high PKA activity, Sko1 repression is further strengthened, and PKA phosphorylates near the Sko1 bZIP (site mutations abolish this effect). This mechanism is separate from Hog1 phosphorylation (relief of repression). The only BioGRID record was a protein chip (16319894)
PKA は Atg1 に加えて Atg13 を直接リン酸化し、Atg13 の P: PKA directly phosphorylates Atg13 in addition to Atg1 and controls Atg13 localization to the PAS. High PKA activity suppresses autophagy
PKA は Atg12 の Atg17 結合部位（S55）をリン酸化し、Atg1: PKA phosphorylates the Atg17-binding site (S55) of Atg12, blocking binding of Atg12-Atg5-Atg16 (the E3-like complex) to Atg17, the scaffold of the Atg1 complex (39826713; the main text of 40395985, a commentary by the same authors, confirms that S55 is phosphorylated in vivo)
PKA は CTP シンテターゼ（Ura7）の S424 をリン酸化して活性を上: PKA phosphorylates S424 of CTP synthetase (Ura7) and increases its activity. S424A is not stimulated by PKA and becomes sensitive to CTP inhibition (10393561). Phosphatidylcholine synthesis decreases in S424A cells (12709422). Not an experiment limited to Tpk1
PKA は Cdc25 の Ras2 GEF 活性を下げ、Cdc25 と Ras: PKA lowers the Ras2 GEF activity of Cdc25 and reduces Cdc25 binding to Ras2-GTP (negative feedback)
PKA は Cdc25 の Ras2-GEF 活性を下げ Ras2-GTP との: PKA lowers the Ras2-GEF activity of Cdc25 and reduces its binding to Ras2-GTP (21457714). Hyperphosphorylation of Cdc25 is not seen in tpk2Δ, suggesting that PKA feedback inhibition of Cdc25 is mediated by Tpk2 (21888905). Cdc25 phosphorylation lowers GEF activity in vitro (21073870)
PKA は Crz1 の核局在シグナル付近をリン酸化して核への取り込みを抑え、C: PKA phosphorylates near the nuclear localization signal of Crz1, suppressing nuclear import and lowering Crz1-dependent transcription. Changing the sites to alanine increases nuclear translocation and transcription (PMID 15470242)
PKA は Maf1 を生体内で PKA 部位でリン酸化し、PKA が強い株では: PKA phosphorylates Maf1 at PKA sites in vivo, and in strains with strong PKA, Pol III repression does not occur. PKA lowers Maf1 function by suppressing its nuclear import (17005718). Maf1 function is inhibited by PKA and Sch9 through seven phosphorylation sites (22810236). Not an experiment limited to Tpk1
PKA は Nth1 の N 末端をリン酸化し、14-3-3（Bmh1・Bmh2: PKA phosphorylates the N-terminus of Nth1, 14-3-3 (Bmh1, Bmh2) binds, and activity increases. S60 and S83 are the main sites for PKA activation (22320399). In vivo activation upon glucose or nitrogen addition is accompanied by phosphorylation of S21 and S83 (23155055). Not an experiment limited to Tpk1

PKA phosphorylates the N-terminus of Nth1, 14-3-3 (Bmh1, Bmh2) binds, and activity increases. S60 and S83 are the main sites for PKA activation (22320399). In vivo activation upon glucose or nitrogen addition is accompanied by phosphorylation of S21 and S83 (23155055). Not an experiment limited to Tpk3. BioGRID's 25065647 is a paper on Bcy1-binding proteins, and Nth1 does not appear in its abstract
PKA は P ボディの足場 Pat1 を直接リン酸化して大きな P ボディの形: PKA directly phosphorylates the P-body scaffold Pat1 and suppresses formation of large P-bodies. Phosphomimetic Pat1-EE has about half the P-body localization. In vivo, Tpk1 overexpression increases Pat1 phosphorylation, and inhibition of tpk1-as abolishes it (21925385)
PKA は P ボディの足場である Pat1 を直接リン酸化して、大きな P ボ: PKA directly phosphorylates Pat1, the P-body scaffold, and suppresses formation of large P-bodies. Non-phosphorylatable Pat1-AA enters P-bodies even in cells with strong PKA activity (bcy1Δ) and restores large P-bodies. Phosphomimetic Pat1-EE has half the assembly into P-bodies (21925385)
PKA は Pah1 の S10・S677・S773・S774・S788 をリン: PKA phosphorylates Pah1 at S10, S677, S773, S774, and S788, lowering catalytic efficiency and suppressing PAP activity, mainly through S10 phosphorylation. S10 phosphorylation suppresses membrane binding and TAG synthesis (22865862). Not an experiment limited to Tpk1 (same evidence as TPK2 and TPK3)

PKA phosphorylates Pah1 at S10, S677, S773, S774, and S788, lowering catalytic efficiency and suppressing PAP activity, mainly through S10 phosphorylation. S10 phosphorylation suppresses membrane binding and TAG synthesis (22865862). Not an experiment limited to Tpk2. BioGRID's 27044741 is a CKII paper in which PKA was only used for prior phosphorylation

PKA phosphorylates Pah1 at S10, S677, S773, S774, and S788, lowering catalytic efficiency and suppressing PAP activity, mainly through S10 phosphorylation. S10 phosphorylation suppresses membrane binding and TAG synthesis (22865862). Not an experiment limited to Tpk3. BioGRID's 31645435 is a Yck1 paper in which PKA was only used for comparison of prior phosphorylation
PKA は Pde1 の S252 をリン酸化して、グルコースの添加などで上がる: PKA phosphorylates Pde1 S252, restraining the rise in cAMP upon glucose addition and other stimuli (feedback). In S252A, cAMP accumulates. Phosphorylation does not change the activity of the enzyme itself and is thought to act through localization or binding
PKA は Pyk1（Cdc19）の S22 をリン酸化し、FBP がないときの: PKA phosphorylates Pyk1 (Cdc19) at S22, increasing its activity in the absence of FBP (16426231). Tpk1 phosphorylates pyruvate kinase in vitro, and bcy1 deletion increases its activity in vivo (11877433)
PKA は Ras2 の局在を変え、Ras2 の活性を下げる（Cdc25 の G: PKA changes Ras2 localization and lowers Ras2 activity (because the GEF activity of Cdc25 decreases)
PKA は Ras2 の膜への局在と活性を下げる（負のフィードバック）: PKA lowers membrane localization and activity of Ras2 (negative feedback)
PKA は Rim4 の Bmh1/2 結合部位をリン酸化して Rim4-Bmh: PKA phosphorylates the Bmh1/2-binding sites of Rim4, causing formation of the Rim4-Bmh1/2 complex and expelling mRNA from Rim4 (relief of translational repression). At the same time it protects Rim4 from autophagic degradation. Cdc14 acts oppositely (PMID 37659077 main text)
PKA は Tom40 の前駆体をリン酸化し、リン酸化された前駆体はミトコンドリ: PKA phosphorylates the Tom40 precursor, and the phosphorylated precursor is blocked from import into mitochondria. PKA suppresses biogenesis of the TOM complex (22419819)
PKA は Whi3 をリン酸化し、S568 のリン酸化は Whi3 の働きを抑: PKA phosphorylates Whi3, and S568 phosphorylation suppresses Whi3 function. Phosphorylation lowers binding to CLN3 mRNA and promotes G1/S progression. Phosphomimetic S568D blocks the switch to sporulation and invasive growth (23471970)
PKA は精製した Opi1 の S31・S251 を試験管内でリン酸化し、体内: PKA phosphorylates purified Opi1 at S31 and S251 in vitro, and phosphorylation is also reduced in vivo in S31A/S251A. With S31A/S251A Opi1, INO1 reporter expression is 35-55% higher, so these phosphorylations strengthen the repressor function of Opi1 (12668681)
PKA は試験管内で Pfk26（PFK2）の T157・S644 をリン酸化し: PKA phosphorylates and activates Pfk26 (PFK2) at T157 and S644 in vitro. When the Ras-cAMP pathway is stimulated by glucose addition, PFK2 is activated in vivo, and S644 phosphorylation is due to PKA (12755632). Not an experiment limited to Tpk1

PKA phosphorylates and activates Pfk26 (PFK2) at T157 and S644 in vitro. When the Ras-cAMP pathway is stimulated by glucose addition, PFK2 is activated in vivo, and S644 phosphorylation is due to PKA (12755632). Not an experiment limited to Tpk2

PKA phosphorylates and activates Pfk26 (PFK2) at T157 and S644 in vitro. When the Ras-cAMP pathway is stimulated by glucose addition, PFK2 is activated in vivo, and S644 phosphorylation is due to PKA (12755632). Not an experiment limited to Tpk3
PKA は非呼吸条件で Tom70 をリン酸化し、受容体活性と代謝物キャリアの取: PKA phosphorylates Tom70 under non-respiratory conditions, suppressing its receptor activity and import of metabolite carriers (PMID 21215441). PKA impairs Tom70 receptor activity and also suppresses Tom40 biogenesis (PMID 22419819)
PKA を体内で活性化すると Cki1 のリン酸化が一時的に増え活性が上がる。試: Activating PKA in vivo transiently increases Cki1 phosphorylation and raises its activity. In vitro, PKA phosphorylation increases activity 1.9-fold, and dephosphorylation lowers it by 60% (10092638). PKA phosphorylates S30 and S85, and in S30A,S85A both in vivo phosphorylation and PC synthesis via the CDP-choline pathway are greatly reduced (12105205)
PKA 経路は抑制因子 Sfl1 を通して AQY2 を脱抑制し、Kss1 経路: The PKA pathway derepresses AQY2 through the repressor Sfl1, and the Kss1 pathway represses it independently of Kss1 activity (19889095)
PKA 触媒サブユニットの過剰発現は DAM1 変異体で致死で、野生型でも染色体: Overexpression of the PKA catalytic subunit is lethal in DAM1 mutants and increases chromosome loss even in wild type. S31A suppresses this lethality. PKA directly phosphorylates Dam1 S31 in vitro, and S31 phosphorylation is also seen in vivo. High-copy TPK2 or S31D reduces kinetochore Dam1, accompanied by spindle abnormalities. Glucose restriction reduces S31 phosphorylation (30546002). Results are from overexpression and mimetic mutants, so confidence is medium
PKA（Tpk1・Tpk2・Tpk3 のどれも試験管内で Rgt1 をリン酸化）: PKA (Tpk1, Tpk2, and Tpk3 each phosphorylate Rgt1 in vitro) and the PKA sites of Rgt1 are required for glucose-induced release of Rgt1 from HXT promoters and induction of HXT. TPK overexpression causes constitutive HXT expression (16844691). Contributions of the individual isoforms are not separated, so confidence is medium
PKA（cAPK）による in vitro のリン酸化で Rim15 のキナーゼ: In vitro phosphorylation by PKA (cAPK) strongly suppresses Rim15 kinase activity. Rim15 is negatively controlled immediately downstream of PKA
PKC のリン酸化は試験管内では Pah1 の活性をわずかに上げるが、局在やトリ: PKC phosphorylation slightly increases Pah1 activity in vitro but has little effect on localization or triacylglycerol synthesis function, and reduces Pah1 levels when it is not phosphorylated by Pho85-Pho80 (24876385). Pkc1-mediated degradation of Pah1 is weakened in cho1Δ, which lacks phosphatidylserine (28154205)
PKC は Nem1 の Ser-201 をリン酸化し Nem1-Spo7 ホス: PKC phosphorylates Nem1 Ser-201, increasing Nem1-Spo7 phosphatase activity and triacylglycerol synthesis (PMID 31501244). 28154205 is an in vitro paper showing that the phosphorylation requires PS and DAG
PKC は精製した Opi1 の S26 を試験管内でリン酸化する。体内でも S: PKC phosphorylates purified Opi1 at S26 in vitro. In vivo, phosphorylation is also reduced by 50% in S26A. In cells with S26A Opi1, INO1 reporter expression is about 50% lower, so S26 phosphorylation weakens the repressor function of Opi1 (11395523)
PLB3 の過剰発現は sec12-4 の制限温度での増殖とタンパク質輸送を一部: PLB3 overexpression partly restores growth and protein transport of sec12-4 at the restrictive temperature, and lyso-PI increases (29887313)
PLD/Spo14 は減数分裂で発現する Sma1 と複合体をつくる（16148: PLD/Spo14 forms a complex with Sma1, which is expressed in meiosis (16148007)
PLP1 欠失は過剰な β チューブリンの毒性を抑え、plp1Δ の β チュー: PLP1 deletion suppresses the toxicity of excess β-tubulin; in plp1Δ, β-tubulin pairs poorly with α-tubulin and heterodimers decrease. Plp1p mediates an early step of β-tubulin folding (14573467)
PMA1 と PMP1 の共局在解析で、膜マイクロドメインを壊すと H+-ATP: Co-localization analysis of PMA1 and PMP1 shows that disrupting membrane microdomains blocks formation of the H+-ATPase complex (37700284)
POG1 の過剰発現はα因子による CLN1・CLN2 の転写抑制を妨げ、CLN: POG1 overexpression blocks α-factor-induced transcriptional repression of CLN1/CLN2 and promotes recovery through upregulation of CLN2 (9927449)
PP1（Glc7）は Msn2 の核移行ドメインの PKA 依存のリン酸化を直接: PP1 (Glc7) directly reverses PKA-dependent phosphorylation of the Msn2 nuclear localization domain (it can transmit the glucose starvation signal)
PP2A の触媒サブユニットの遺伝子の変異で、ラパマイシンによる Maf1 の脱: Mutations in the PP2A catalytic subunit genes prevent rapamycin-induced dephosphorylation of Maf1, its nuclear accumulation, and repression of Pol III transcription. Under repressing conditions, Maf1 is dephosphorylated, accumulates in the nucleus, and binds Pol III more (16762835)
PP2A(Cdc55) は分裂中期に Net1 を低リン酸化の状態に保ち、分裂後: PP2A(Cdc55) keeps Net1 hypophosphorylated in metaphase, and when separase inhibits PP2A(Cdc55) in anaphase, Cdk phosphorylation of Net1 proceeds (16713564). In meiosis without cdc55, Net1 is hyperphosphorylated and Cdc14 is released early from the nucleolus, which is reversed by a Net1 mutant lacking Cdk sites (21690311). When PP2A(Cdc55) decreases at the start of anaphase, Net1 is phosphorylated and Cdc14 is released (30927017). Dephosphorylation maintains the ability of Net1 to tether Cdc14
PP2A-Cdc55 が抑えられると Gis1 のリン酸化型が保たれ、転写の活性: When PP2A-Cdc55 is inhibited, the phosphorylated form of Gis1 is maintained and transcriptional activation proceeds (PP2A-Cdc55 dephosphorylates Gis1 and suppresses its function)
PP2A-Cdc55 と Slk19 は Pds1 と重複して動原体周辺で Es: PP2A-Cdc55 and Slk19 suppress Esp1 around kinetochores redundantly with Pds1; without them, premature anaphase spindle elongation occurs (29561844)
PP2A-Cdc55 は APC/C を脱リン酸化して Cdc28 の働きに対抗: PP2A-Cdc55 dephosphorylates APC/C to counter Cdc28 action, blocking adaptation to the spindle checkpoint (progression to anaphase). The main text states that dephosphorylation of Cdc16 blocks APC/C-Cdc20 formation (23999167)
PP2A-Cdc55 は Cdk1 による Wee1（Swe1）の最初のリン酸化: PP2A-Cdc55 reverses the initial phosphorylation of Wee1 (Swe1) by Cdk1, creating a threshold that limits Wee1 activation (21849476). In cdc55 deletion, Cdc28 Y19 is hyperphosphorylated and Swe1 is ectopically stabilized in G2/M, caused by disturbed PP2A activity (11027284)
PP2A-Cdc55 は Pds1 を体内でも試験管内でも直接脱リン酸化する。c: PP2A-Cdc55 dephosphorylates Pds1 directly both in vivo and in vitro. When Pds1 is hyperphosphorylated in cdc55Δ, Pds1–Esp1 binding strengthens and nuclear accumulation of Pds1 and spindle elongation proceed. Dephosphorylation blocks Pds1–Esp1 binding and nuclear accumulation of Pds1 (32591482). This addresses the aspects of Pds1 function concerning Esp1 binding and nuclear import
PP4 が Maf1 の主な脱リン酸化酵素で、触媒サブユニットは Pph3。PP: PP4 is the main phosphatase for Maf1, with the catalytic subunit Pph3. PP4 co-precipitates with Maf1 and dephosphorylates Maf1 in vitro. In pph3Δ, Maf1 does not enter the nucleus 30 minutes into nutrient deprivation and Pol III repression is impaired. Also Pph3-dependent with MMS, DTT, CPZ, and phosphate deprivation (22333918)
PP4 は Hop1 と結合して Hop1 と Red1 を減数分裂の染色質に組: PP4 binds Hop1 and is required for loading Hop1 and Red1 onto meiotic chromatin. This function is independent of DSB-induced Tel1/Mec1 activity and is not restored by pch2 deletion, so it is required for initial loading rather than Hop1 stabilization (37243502)
PP4（Pph3/Psy2）の変異体では交叉の修復の初期と、相同性によらないセン: In PP4 (Pph3/Psy2) mutants, both early crossover repair and homology-independent centromere pairing stop, caused by persistent phosphorylation of Zip1 S75. Pairing is restored in mec1 mutants (20951350)
PP4（Pph3・Psy2・Rrd1・Tip41）が Maf1 の主な脱リン酸化: PP4 (Pph3, Psy2, Rrd1, Tip41) is the main Maf1 phosphatase and acts in nuclear accumulation of Maf1 and Pol III repression (22333918)
PPS1 の過剰発現による増殖停止を RAS2 が多コピーで抑える。RAS1・T: Multicopy RAS2 suppresses the growth arrest caused by PPS1 overexpression. RAS1, TPK2, TPK3, and cAMP do not suppress it (9083070)
PRB1 はグルコースで抑制され、tup1・mig1・grr1 の変異でその抑制: PRB1 is repressed by glucose, and tup1, mig1, and grr1 mutations partly relieve this repression (9045801)
PRT1 の RNP1 モチーフの変異は TIF32・HCR1 との試験管内の直: Mutations in the RNP1 motif of PRT1 impair direct in vitro binding to TIF32 and HCR1 and reduce eIF3 binding to 40S (16581774)
PRT1・TIF34・TIF35 の相互作用をツーハイブリッドと試験管内結合で検: Interactions among PRT1, TIF34, and TIF35 were detected by two-hybrid and in vitro binding (9660829)
PSP1・PSP2 は POL1 変異の温度感受性の多コピー抑圧因子（95295: PSP1/PSP2 are multicopy suppressors of the temperature sensitivity of POL1 mutations (9529527)
PTC1（CWH47）の破壊で EXG1 の転写とエキソ-β-グルカナーゼ活性が: Disruption of PTC1 (CWH47) increases EXG1 transcription and exo-β-glucanase activity. Ptc1 and Pbs2 act in opposite directions in cell wall glucan assembly (7565587)
PTC2 の過剰発現は Hog1 の活性化を抑え、試験管内で Ptc2 は Ho: PTC2 overexpression suppresses Hog1 activation, and in vitro Ptc2 is specific for pThr of Hog1. Lacking both PTC2 and PTC3, Hog1 activation under osmotic stress is stronger than in wild type. Ptc2/Ptc3 restrain maximal Hog1 activity and, unlike Ptc1, are not notably involved in inactivation during adaptation (12477803). Consistent with the UniProt direction (inhibition)
PTK2 と HRK1 は、グルコースの代謝に応じて細胞膜 H+-ATPase（: PTK2 and HRK1 are kinases that activate the plasma membrane H+-ATPase (Pma1) in response to glucose metabolism. Whether directly or indirectly is unknown; they increase Pma1 affinity for ATP (11003661). Under acetic acid stress, Hrk1 acts in Pma1 activation and pH maintenance (38053573)
PTK2 と HRK1 はグルコース代謝に応じた Pma1 の活性化に関わるキナ: PTK2 and HRK1 are kinases involved in glucose metabolism-dependent activation of Pma1 and increase Pma1 affinity for ATP (probably via S899 phosphorylation). ptk2 mutants become resistant to toxic cations (11003661). Ptk2 is at the plasma membrane and phosphorylates S899 of a Pma1 C-terminal peptide in vitro. The Ptk2 C-terminus is essential for glucose-induced Pma1 activation and S899 phosphorylation (16510118). S911-T912 phosphorylation is carried out by the largely redundant Ptk1 and Ptk2, and in glucose-grown cells both prevent autoinhibition by the Pma1 R domain. ptk1Δ ptk2Δ is inviable (38227612)
PUF 型 RNA 結合タンパク質 Mpt5 は Ste7 と Tec1 のタン: The PUF-family RNA-binding protein Mpt5 suppresses Ste7 and Tec1 protein levels, also negatively controls Kss1 activity, and suppresses pathway output in the absence of stimulus (17327913)
PUT1・PUT2 はプロリンで誘導され Put3 に活性化される。Put3 は: PUT1/PUT2 are induced by proline and activated by Put3. Put3 recognizes the UASs of both genes (2689862). Put3 activates transcription most strongly when proline is the sole nitrogen source (10629046)
PUT1・PUT2 はプロリンで誘導され Put3 に活性化される（268986: PUT1/PUT2 are induced by proline and activated by Put3 (2689862). Activation is strongest when proline is the sole nitrogen source (10629046)
Pac1 と Dyn1 はプラス端への局在に互いと Bik1 を要し、Pac1: Pac1 and Dyn1 require each other and Bik1 for plus-end localization, and Pac1 overexpression increases Dyn1 accumulation at plus ends. Dyn1 forms a complex with Pac1 even without Bik1 (21294277). Pac1 is required for plus-end localization of dynein (12566428)
Pac2p は α チューブリンと結合し、その複合体を直接示した（9725898: Pac2p binds α-tubulin, and the complex was shown directly (9725898)
Paf1C は ATG 遺伝子の転写抑制因子で、paf1・ctr9 欠失で AT: Paf1C is a transcriptional repressor of ATG genes; paf1 or ctr9 deletion increases ATG32 and ATG11 expression and promotes mitophagy. Under glucose-rich conditions it binds the ATG32 promoter and keeps mitophagy low (31525119)
Pag1(Tao3) と Cbk1 は同じ極性部位に局在し共免疫沈降する（118: Pag1 (Tao3) and Cbk1 localize to the same polarity sites and co-immunoprecipitate (11854408). Many suppressors of ram mutations such as tao3 are S745F, which constitutively activates Cbk1 (19967545)
Pah1 の 7 部位のうち S602・T723・S744 が Cdc28 の部: Of the seven Pah1 sites, S602, T723, and S744 are Cdc28 sites. Without phosphorylation at the seven sites, Pah1 associates with membranes and functions without Nem1-Spo7. Alanine substitution of only the three Cdc28 sites bypasses the Nem1-Spo7 requirement only partly (21081492). BioGRID's 16319894 is a proteome-wide in vitro protein chip experiment
Pah1 は定常期にプロテアソームで分解され、pre1 pre2 などのプロテア: Pah1 is degraded by the proteasome in stationary phase and is stabilized by proteasome mutations such as pre1 pre2 (24563465)
Pal1 と Pal2 は HAC1 mRNA の 3′UTR に結合し、両方を: Pal1 and Pal2 bind the 3′UTR of HAC1 mRNA, and strains lacking both cannot process HAC1 mRNA. They mediate HAC1 splicing downstream of Kin1/Kin2 (34035143)
Pal1・Pal2 は HAC1 mRNA の 3'UTR に結合し、両方を欠く: Pal1/Pal2 bind the 3'UTR of HAC1 mRNA, and lacking both causes defects in HAC1 mRNA processing. Kin1/Kin2 directly phosphorylate Pal2, and non-phosphorylatable Pal2 cannot complement the UPR defect of pal1Δ pal2Δ (34035143)
Pam16 は Pam18 と複合体を作るが典型的な J タンパク質としては働か: Pam16 forms a complex with Pam18 but does not act as a typical J protein, and specifically suppresses Pam18-mediated stimulation of mtHsp70 ATPase activity (15218029)
Pam17 はチャネルの Tim23 と相互作用し、TIM23 と PAM の新: Pam17 interacts with the channel Tim23, forming a new contact point between TIM23 and PAM (18400944)
Pam18 は J ドメインをもつ内膜タンパク質で、Ssc1 の ATPase: Pam18 is an inner membrane protein with a J domain that stimulates Ssc1 ATPase activity. Depleting Pam18 in vivo disrupts protein import into the matrix (14605210). Pam18 (Tim14) is the fourth essential subunit of PAM, stimulates mtHsp70 ATPase, and is required for mtHsp70–Tim44 binding and import (14638855). Consistent with the GO direction (activation)
Pan1 の Glc7 による脱リン酸化は Scd5 に依存する。Scd5 は: Dephosphorylation of Pan1 by Glc7 depends on Scd5. Scd5 links Glc7 to Pan1 directly and indirectly via End3 (17898076)
Pan1 は Prk1 の基質で Arp2/3 の活性化因子。Prk1 が狙う: Pan1 is a Prk1 substrate and an Arp2/3 activator. Changing all 15 threonines targeted by Prk1 to alanine mimics the ark1Δ prk1Δ phenotype. Prk1 phosphorylation blocks Pan1 F-actin binding and Arp2/3 activation, stopping actin polymerization on endocytic vesicles (15711538). Prk1 phosphorylation lowers Pan1 activity, and Glc7 (targeted by Scd5) restores it by dephosphorylation (17898076)
Pap1 の N 末端 18 アミノ酸の領域に特異的に結合するタンパク質として: Cft1, Pta1, Nab6, and Sub1 were identified as proteins that bind specifically to the N-terminal 18-amino-acid region of Pap1 (22575652)
Pap1 の N 末端に特異的に結合するタンパク質として Cft1・Pta1・N: Cft1, Pta1, Nab6, and Sub1 were identified as proteins that bind specifically to the Pap1 N-terminus (22575652)
Par32 の K6 型ユビキチン鎖がないと Npr1 との結合とリン酸化が減り: Without K6-linked ubiquitin chains on Par32, binding to and phosphorylation by Npr1 decrease, and Par32 binds Gnp1 and suppresses Gnp1 endocytosis. As a result, serine uptake increases (42050885, only one paper)
Pat1 は Not1 に拮抗し、Dhh1 との直接の結合を通じて P ボディの: Pat1 antagonizes Not1 and promotes P-body formation through direct binding to Dhh1. In vitro, Pat1 enhances phase separation of Dhh1 and RNA, and Not1 reverses Pat1-Dhh1-RNA condensation (30648970)
Pat1・Edc3・Dhh1・Scd6 はみな脱キャップ酵素に結合するが、活性を: Pat1, Edc3, Dhh1, and Scd6 all bind the decapping enzyme, but only Pat1 and Edc3 increase its activity (20832728)
Pau5 は主に Pmt1 で O-マンノシル化され、それが Pau5 を安定に: Pau5 is O-mannosylated mainly by Pmt1, which stabilizes Pau5 (18312373)
Pba1-Pba2 は安定なヘテロ二量体を作り、HbYX モチーフで 20S プ: Pba1-Pba2 forms a stable heterodimer and binds the 20S proteasome via HbYX motifs. The crystal structure was also determined (22930756)
Pbn1 の結合相手として ER のレクチン Emp47 と Emp46 が最も: Among the strongest binding partners of Pbn1 are the ER lectins Emp47 and Emp46. The emp46 emp47 double deletion impairs ERAD of O-mannosylated substrates (42412609)
Pbn1（PIG-X の相同体）は Gpi14（PIG-M の相同体）の働きに不: Pbn1 (PIG-X homolog) is indispensable for the function of Gpi14 (PIG-M homolog) (15635094)
Pbp1 は呼吸での増殖のときに TORC1 と結合し、低複雑性領域を使って T: Pbp1 binds TORC1 during respiratory growth and suppresses TORC1 using its low-complexity region (30982600). Psk1, activated in a Snf1-dependent manner, phosphorylates and activates Pbp1, which suppresses TORC1 by sequestering it in stress granules (25428989)
Pbp1 を欠くと Puf3 の標的 mRNA とミトコンドリアのタンパク質が減: Without Pbp1, Puf3 target mRNAs and mitochondrial proteins decrease. Pbp1 supports translation of Puf3 target mRNAs under respiratory conditions, and Pbp1 and Puf3 bind each other via their low-complexity regions, which is required for translation of Puf3 target mRNAs (37216416)
Pbp1 を餌にした two-hybrid で PBP4（YDL053C）が相手: PBP4 (YDL053C) was obtained as a partner in a two-hybrid screen using Pbp1 as bait (15121841)
Pbr1 は Fks1 と物理的に結合し、Pbr1 の働きが部分的に失われると: Pbr1 binds Fks1 physically, and when Pbr1 function is partly lost, Fks1 does not reach the cell surface, accumulates in ER-associated compartments, and becomes unstable (42441850)
Pbs2 の活性化部位 S514・T518 のリン酸化を各変異株で調べた。Ptc: Phosphorylation of the Pbs2 activation sites S514 and T518 was examined in each mutant strain. Ptc1-Ptc4 collectively negatively control Pbs2; T518 is dephosphorylated mainly by Ptc1, and S514 by any of Ptc1-4. Dephosphorylation by Ptc1 requires the adaptor Nbp2, which brings Ptc1 to Pbs2 (36870684)
Pby1 の P ボディへの呼び込みには脱キャップ酵素への結合が必要（32396: Recruitment of Pby1 to P-bodies requires binding to the decapping enzyme (32396195)
Pby1 は C 末端ドメインで脱キャップ酵素 Dcp2 に直接結合する（323: Pby1 binds the decapping enzyme Dcp2 directly through its C-terminal domain (32396195)
Pca1 は Doa10 依存に膜上でプロテアソームと複合体をつくり、プロテアソ: Pca1 forms a complex with the proteasome on the membrane in a Doa10-dependent manner, and Cdc48 is required for recruiting the proteasome to Pca1 (27226596)
Pcf11 は NRD ターミネーター上で Nrd1 の下流に局在し、その呼び込: Pcf11 localizes downstream of Nrd1 on NRD terminators, and its recruitment depends on Nrd1 (25877920)
Pch2 は六量体の AAA+ ATPase で、ヌクレオチド依存に Hop1: Pch2 is a hexameric AAA+ ATPase that binds Hop1 in a nucleotide-dependent manner and removes Hop1 from DNA (requiring ATP binding and hydrolysis) (24367111)
Pcl-Pho85 による Bni4 のリン酸化が bud neck への局在に: Phosphorylation of Bni4 by Pcl-Pho85 is required for its localization to the bud neck (19458192)
Pcl-Pho85 は Whi5 をリン酸化して抑え、G1 転写を促す。Pcl9: Pcl-Pho85 phosphorylates and inhibits Whi5, promoting G1 transcription. Phosphorylation by Pcl9-Pho85 blocks binding of Whi5 to HDACs (Hos3, Rpd3). The defect of the pho85 cln3 double deletion is reversed by whi5 deletion (PMID 19823668)
Pcl1 の two-hybrid で Hms1・Ncp1・Epa1 が取れ、G: Hms1, Ncp1, and Epa1 were obtained in a two-hybrid screen with Pcl1, bind in GST pull-downs, and are specifically phosphorylated by Pcl1-Pho85 (15082539)
Pcl1 は自分の CDK（Pho85）にリン酸化されて Dma1 ユビキチンリ: Pcl1 is phosphorylated by its own CDK (Pho85), binds the Dma1 ubiquitin ligase, and is degraded. Non-phosphorylated Pcl1 accumulates throughout the cell cycle (PMID 23264631)
Pcl2-Pho85 が試験管内でリン酸化する部位は体内の増殖中もリン酸化され、: Sites phosphorylated by Pcl2-Pho85 in vitro are also phosphorylated in vivo during growth, and two of them depend on Pcl-Pho85. Phosphorylation blocks binding to Las17 (12857883). Maximal phosphorylation in vivo requires Pho85 and Pcl1,2-type cyclins (9843683)
Pcl5 の N 末端の分解シグナルは、結合した Pho85 による特定のトレオ: The N-terminal degradation signal of Pcl5 requires phosphorylation of specific threonines by the bound Pho85, and Pcl5 is degraded by SCF (18794371)
Pcl7-Pho85 の活性はリン酸の飢餓で抑えられ、この調節は Pcl7 と結: Pcl7-Pho85 activity is suppressed by phosphate starvation, and this regulation depends on Pho81, which binds Pcl7 (11069666)
Pcl8/Pcl10 のサイクリンが Pho85 にグリコーゲン合成酵素をリン酸: The Pcl8/Pcl10 cyclins direct Pho85 to phosphorylate glycogen synthase (in vivo and in vitro) (9584169)
Pcl8/Pcl10 のサイクリンは Pho85 にグリコーゲン合成酵素をリン酸: The Pcl8/Pcl10 cyclins direct Pho85 to phosphorylate glycogen synthase. Pcl10-Pho85 phosphorylates Gsy2 Ser-654 and Thr-667 (9584169)
Pcl9 と Pho85 は複合体をつくり、Pcl9 に結合したキナーゼ活性は: Pcl9 and Pho85 form a complex, and Pcl9-associated kinase activity depends on PHO85 (9593297)
Pdc2 は PDC5 の上流に結合し、その配列は PDC5 の発現に必要（22: Pdc2 binds upstream of PDC5, and this sequence is required for PDC5 expression (22404710)
Pdc2 は転写を活性化し Thi3 と結合する。どちらもチアミン欠乏で強まり、: Pdc2 activates transcription and binds Thi3. Both are enhanced by thiamine deficiency but not in thi3 strains (19013460)
Pdp3 は NuA3（触媒 Sas3）の構成要素と共精製され、NuA3b をつ: Pdp3 co-purifies with components of NuA3 (catalytic Sas3) to form NuA3b (25104842)

Pdr16 は Ldo45 によって特異的に vCLIP へ呼び込まれる（383: Pdr16 is specifically recruited to the vCLIP by Ldo45 (38367622)
