Pph3 を含む HTP-C は生体内で γH2A のリン酸化を調節し、試験管内: HTP-C containing Pph3 regulates γH2A phosphorylation in vivo and dephosphorylates γH2A in vitro. This dephosphorylation is required for recovery from the checkpoint (16299494)
Pph3-Psy2 は Psy2 の EVH1 ドメインで Mth1 に直接結合: Pph3-Psy2 binds Mth1 directly through the EVH1 domain of Psy2 and dephosphorylates it, acting in regulation of HXT expression (24277933)
Pph3-Psy2 は活性化した Rad53 に結合して脱リン酸化する。欠くと回: Pph3-Psy2 binds and dephosphorylates activated Rad53. Without it, Rad53 dephosphorylation during recovery is delayed (17517611)
Ppq1 は接合の MAPK 経路の負の調節因子で、Fus3 かその上流を標的に: Ppq1 is a negative regulator of the mating MAPK pathway and lowers signaling by targeting Fus3 or upstream components. Phosphatase activity is required (24309106)
Ppt2 を欠くと Acp1 に PP を付けられず、Acp1 枯渇株と同じ表現: Without Ppt2, PP cannot be attached to Acp1, giving the same phenotype as Acp1-depleted strains (defective FeS cluster formation) (39251117)
Ppz を欠く株では MPK1 の発現・Mpk1 の量・リン酸化した活性型が増え: In strains lacking Ppz, MPK1 expression, Mpk1 levels, and its phosphorylated active form increase, and Mpk1 target genes also go up. This does not occur when K+ is lowered by disrupting TRK1/TRK2 or when the cell wall is stabilized with sorbitol (14871941)
Ppz ホスファターゼが TRK1・TRK2 がコードする主要なカリウム輸送系を: Ppz phosphatases have been shown to negatively control the major potassium transport system encoded by TRK1/TRK2 (15581616). When Ppz activity decreases, Trk is activated, causing membrane depolarization and increases in intracellular K+ and pH (11867520, Rb+ uptake measurements)
Pre2/Doa3 のプロペプチドが Ump1 のプロテアソーム成熟での働きに必: The propeptide of Pre2/Doa3 is required for Ump1 function in proteasome maturation (9491890)
Pre4 の C 末端尾部を欠くと Pre3 のプロペプチドの切断と post-: Without the C-terminal tail of Pre4, cleavage of the Pre3 propeptide and post-acidic activity are lost (14722099)
Prk1 が Scd5 の 3 つの LxxTxTG モチーフを試験管内・生体内: Prk1 phosphorylates the three LxxTxTG motifs of Scd5 in vitro and in vivo, and PRK1 deletion suppresses the actin and endocytosis defects of scd5 mutants (13679512)
Prk1 と Ark1 は小胞の取り込み後に因子をリン酸化して被覆を解体する。S: Prk1 and Ark1 phosphorylate factors after vesicle internalization to disassemble the coat. The LxxQxTG repeats of Sla1 are phosphorylated by Prk1, and in the dephosphorylated state they bind Pan1 (22825870). Prk1 phosphorylates Sla1 and Pan1, dissociating the Sla1/Pan1/End3 complex (17178891). BioGRID's 11739778 identifies Sla1 as a Prk1 substrate and shows complex disassembly upon overexpression. 18939955 is a paper on Prk1 autophosphorylation
Prk1 による Pan1 のリン酸化は Pan1 の活性を下げ、エンドサイトー: Phosphorylation of Pan1 by Prk1 lowers Pan1 activity, causing disassembly of the endocytic coat and termination of actin polymerization. Glc7 dephosphorylates Pan1 in a Scd5-dependent manner, and reducing Glc7 causes defects in growth, actin, and endocytosis that are partly suppressed by prk1Δ. Glc7 antagonizes Prk1 to maintain Pan1 function (17898076). The conclusion is a "suggestion", so confidence is medium
ProtA-Gsp1 または ProtA-Gsp2 の精製で Kap121・Ka: Purification of ProtA-Gsp1 or ProtA-Gsp2 co-purifies Kap121, Kap123, and Pdr6 (10617640)
Prp16 は第 1 反応のあと Yju2 と Cwc25 を不安定化する（23: Prp16 destabilizes Yju2 and Cwc25 after the first step (23438600)
Prp2 による B* スプライソソームへの移行の際、Cwc24 などが B*: During Prp2-mediated transition to the B* spliceosome, Cwc24 and others quantitatively leave the B* complex (22535589)
Prp20 は核にある Gsp1 の GEF で、Gsp1 の GDP を GT: Prp20 is the nuclear GEF for Gsp1, exchanging GDP for GTP on Gsp1 (11589573). In conditional lethal prp20 mutants, Gsp1 does not accumulate in the nucleus (11024003)
Prp21 は Prp9・Prp11 と結合。ts 変異は Prp9 との結合だ: Prp21 binds Prp9 and Prp11. A ts mutation impairs only binding to Prp9, and the domain required for binding is essential for viability (8718683)
Prp21 は Prp9・Prp11 と結合し、その結合ドメインは生存に必須（8: Prp21 binds Prp9 and Prp11, and the binding domain is essential for viability (8718683)
Prp22 はエキソン連結の前に Slu7 のスプライソソームへの結合を安定化し: Prp22 stabilizes Slu7 binding to the spliceosome before exon ligation and promotes ligation. After ligation, it removes Slu7 by ATP hydrolysis (40876859)
Prp28 の ATPase 活性はリン酸化 Npl3 で高まり、非リン酸化 N: Prp28 ATPase activity is increased by phosphorylated Npl3 but not by non-phosphorylated Npl3 (34035302)
Prp4 は U4/U6 snRNP の Prp3 と結合する（ツーハイブリッド: Prp4 binds Prp3 of the U4/U6 snRNP (two-hybrid, immunoprecipitation) (9826507)
Prp40 の 1 番目の FF ドメインが U1 タンパク質 Luc7 と t: The first FF domain of Prp40 binds the U1 protein Luc7 in two-hybrid and GST pull-down assays (19014439)
Prp40 の FF ドメイン 2・3 が Snu71 に結合する（190144: FF domains 2 and 3 of Prp40 bind Snu71 (19014439)
Prp46 は Prp19 を含む Ntc の Ntc50 にあたると考えられる: Prp46 is thought to correspond to Ntc50 of the Prp19-containing Ntc (12088152)
Prp5 は試験管内で Spt8 と直接結合する（Spt3 とは結合しない）。s: Prp5 binds Spt8 directly in vitro (but not Spt3). spt8Δ suppresses the defects of prp5 mutations (32399566)
Prr1（と Prr2）の過剰発現は、フェロモン・STE11-4・Ste12 の: Overexpression of Prr1 (and Prr2) suppresses transcription caused by pheromone, STE11-4, or Ste12 overexpression, without changing Fus3 activity. It acts downstream of the MAPK (11337509)
Prs1/Prs3 ヘテロ二量体が最重要の機能単位で、Prs3 がないと GFP: The Prs1/Prs3 heterodimer is the most important functional unit, and without Prs3 the GFP-Prs1 signal disappears (23368839)
Prx1 は内膜ペプチダーゼの切断で膜間腔へ、MPP と Oct1 の切断でマト: Prx1 goes to the intermembrane space after cleavage by the inner membrane peptidase and to the matrix after cleavage by MPP and Oct1. Cleavage by Imp2 or Oct1 determines Prx localization (28821623)
Psd2 の活性を生体内で調節するのは Sfh4 と Stt4 だけで、Sfh4: Only Sfh4 and Stt4 regulate Psd2 activity in vivo, and Sfh4 acts through physical binding to Psd2 (32303746)
Psg1 の欠失で Pma1 の液胞での分解が増える。Psg1 は Pma1 の: Psg1 deletion increases vacuolar degradation of Pma1. Psg1 assists Pma1 maturation (28727280)
Psg1 は Exp1 と物理的に結合し、ゴルジ体と COPI 小胞にある（28: Psg1 binds Exp1 physically and is found in the Golgi and COPI vesicles (28727280)
Psh1 は Cse4 をユビキチン化して分解させ、Cse4 の量を抑える。ユビ: Psh1 ubiquitinates Cse4 for degradation and limits Cse4 levels. Mutation of the ubiquitinated Lys blocks ubiquitination in vitro and stabilizes Cse4 in vivo (21070970). Psh1 causes Cse4 degradation, and in psh1Δ Cse4 overexpression becomes toxic and Cse4 localizes to euchromatin (21070971). Binding to Spt16 is required for Cse4 ubiquitination and exclusion from euchromatin (25128498)
Psk1 の結合相手 25 個の試験管内キナーゼ解析で Mot3・Zds1・Ut: In vitro kinase analysis of 25 Psk1-binding partners identified Mot3, Zds1, Utr1, and Cbf1 as substrates (24850888)
Psk1 は Pbp1 を直接リン酸化・活性化し、PAS キナーゼを欠く酵母では: Psk1 directly phosphorylates and activates Pbp1; in yeast lacking PAS kinase, cytoplasmic punctate localization of Pbp1 decreases and TORC1 inhibition is relieved (25428989)
Psk1 は試験管内で Cbf1 をリン酸化し、体内でも T211/T212 の: Psk1 phosphorylates Cbf1 in vitro, and T211/T212 phosphorylation and repression of respiration were also shown in vivo (24850888). Without CBF1 respiration decreases, and without PAS kinase or with Cbf1 T211A respiration increases. PAS kinase suppresses respiration partly by inhibiting Cbf1 (30381292)
Psp2 は ATG1・ATG13 の翻訳を促す。窒素飢餓で 5' UTR に結: Psp2 promotes translation of ATG1 and ATG13. It binds their 5' UTRs under nitrogen starvation (31666677)
Psr1 は Snu66 に結合して脱リン酸化し、スプライシングを調節する。欠失: Psr1 binds and dephosphorylates Snu66, regulating splicing. Deletion causes splicing defects (39484844)
Psr1・Psr2 の標的は分かっていないが、活性部位の変異で TORC1 を抑: The targets of Psr1/Psr2 are not known, but active-site mutations abolish their TORC1-inhibiting function (40103213). Whi2 suppresses TORC1 activity via its binding partners Psr1/Psr2 (30142151)
Ptc1 は体内で MAPK Hog1 を不活性化する（MEK の Pbs2 に: Ptc1 inactivates the MAPK Hog1 in vivo (it does not act on the MEK Pbs2). PTC1 overexpression reduces Hog1 activation under osmotic stress from about 12-fold to about 3-fold; without PTC1, basal Hog1 activity is high and activity persists after stress. In vitro, Ptc1 dephosphorylates the phosphothreonine of the activation loop to inactivate Hog1 (11113180). Consistent with the UniProt direction (inhibition)
Ptc1 も生体内で Snf1 T210 の脱リン酸化に関わる。sit4Δ pt: Ptc1 is also involved in dephosphorylation of Snf1 T210 in vivo. sit4Δ ptc1Δ is partly defective in regulating Snf1 phosphorylation. Reg1-Glc7 is the main one, and the three phosphatases keep T210 dephosphorylated (24019512)
Ptc1〜Ptc4 はまとめて Pbs2 を負に制御し、活性化部位 S514 は: Ptc1-Ptc4 collectively negatively control Pbs2, and the activation site S514 is dephosphorylated by any of Ptc1-4 (36870684)
Ptc2 は Ire1 に特異的・直接に結合し、試験管で Ire1 を脱リン酸化: Ptc2 binds Ire1 specifically and directly and dephosphorylates Ire1 in vitro. In PTC2-deficient strains, the UPR rises 3-4-fold and spliced HAC1 mRNA increases. Overexpression of catalytically active Ptc2 weakens the UPR (9528768)
Ptc7 を欠くとマトリックスの一部のタンパク質のリン酸化が上がり、呼吸での増殖: Without Ptc7, phosphorylation of some matrix proteins rises and respiratory growth is defective. In Δptc7, Cit1 phosphorylation increases and its activity decreases. S462 phosphorylation can abolish Cit1 enzyme activity. Dephosphorylation by Ptc7 restores Cit1 activity (28076776). Consistent with the UniProt direction (activation)
Pth2 は Dsk2 の UBL 領域に結合し、Dsk2 と Rpn1・Rpn: Pth2 binds the UBL region of Dsk2 and blocks binding of Dsk2 to Rpn1 and Rpn10 (17082762)
Pth2 は Rad23・Dsk2 の UBL 領域に結合し、それらと Rpn1: Pth2 binds the UBL regions of Rad23 and Dsk2, blocks their binding to Rpn1 and Rpn10, and suppresses ubiquitin-dependent degradation (17082762)
Pti1・Swd2・Glc7・Ssu72・Ref2・Syc1 が CPF の P: Pti1, Swd2, Glc7, Ssu72, Ref2, and Syc1 associate with Pta1 of CPF to form the APT complex (12819204)
Ptp2 と Ptp3 が Hog1 のチロシン脱リン酸化の主なホスファターゼ: Ptp2 and Ptp3 are the main phosphatases for tyrosine dephosphorylation of Hog1
Ptp2 は Hog1 を脱リン酸化する（ptp2 ptp3 で Hog1 のチ: Ptp2 dephosphorylates Hog1 (in ptp2 ptp3, Hog1 tyrosine phosphorylation persists constitutively)
Ptp2・Ptp3 は Mpk1（SLT2）を不活性化する（in vivo・in: Ptp2/Ptp3 inactivate Mpk1 (SLT2) (in vivo and in vitro). Ptp2 has the stronger effect and binds and dephosphorylates Mpk1
Ptp3 は Fus3 のチロシンを脱リン酸化して不活性化する主なホスファターゼ: Ptp3 is the main phosphatase that dephosphorylates the Fus3 tyrosine and inactivates it, keeping basal activity low and acting in recovery after pheromone (PMID 9224718). Binding of the Ptp3 N-terminus to Fus3 is required for in vivo dephosphorylation and inactivation (PMID 10557209)
Ptr2 はシクロヘキシミド処理後に速く分解され、その分解は Rsp5 に依存す: Ptr2 is rapidly degraded after cycloheximide treatment, and its degradation depends on Rsp5 (25172766)
Ptr3 の過剰なリン酸化は外のアミノ酸で増え、SPS 経路の活性化と相関する。: Ptr3 hyperphosphorylation increases with external amino acids and correlates with SPS pathway activation. Without PP2A activity, Ptr3 is hyperphosphorylated and the SPS pathway is constitutively activated. CKI (Yck1, Yck2) and PP2A act oppositely through Ptr3 phosphorylation (17984223)
Ptr3 は Ssy1 の構造変化を伝え、Ssy5 前駆ドメインと Yck1/2: Ptr3 is an adaptor that transmits the conformational change of Ssy1, bringing the Ssy5 prodomain and Yck1/2 together to cause phosphorylation (23447701)
Ptr3 は Ssy1 受容体が始める形の変化の信号を伝えるアダプターとして、S: As an adaptor transmitting the conformational signal initiated by the Ssy1 receptor, Ptr3 brings the Ssy5 prodomain and Yck1/2 together to cause phosphorylation (23447701). Ptr3 hyperphosphorylation increases with external amino acids and depends on Ssy1 but not Ssy5. SPS activation correlates with Ptr3 phosphorylation state (17984223)
Puf1（Jsn1）と Puf2 は試験管内でも体内でも Ypk1 の基質。Yp: Puf1 (Jsn1) and Puf2 are Ypk1 substrates both in vitro and in vivo. Phosphorylation by Ypk1 increases protein and mRNA levels of transcripts bound by Puf1/Puf2. Ypk1 phosphorylation relieves post-transcriptional repression by Puf1/Puf2, mainly by counteracting their transcript-destabilizing function (34209236)
Puf2 は試験管内でも体内でも Ypk1 の基質。Puf2 はリン酸化されない: Puf2 is a Ypk1 substrate both in vitro and in vivo. Unphosphorylated Puf2 is in puncta near the plasma membrane, and when phosphorylated it disperses into the cytoplasm. Ypk1 phosphorylation relieves post-transcriptional repression by Puf1/Puf2, mainly by counteracting their transcript-destabilizing function (34209236)
Puf3 は COX17 mRNA の脱アデニル化を速めて分解を特異的に促し、C: Puf3 accelerates deadenylation of COX17 mRNA, specifically promoting its decay, and binds the COX17 3′ UTR. It does not affect COX17 translation (11101532)
Puf3 はミトコンドリアの OXPHOS 量・翻訳・呼吸を全体に抑え、代謝サイ: Puf3 globally suppresses mitochondrial OXPHOS levels, translation, and respiration, and post-transcriptionally suppresses Slf1, a cytoplasmic translation factor that fluctuates with the metabolic cycle (21655263)
Puf5 による YGP1 プロモーターの制御は一部 Haa1 を介す（4256: Control of the YGP1 promoter by Puf5 is partly mediated by Haa1 (42566436)
Puf5 の抑制には Eap1 が特に要る。Eap1 は Puf5 と Dhh1: Repression by Puf5 specifically requires Eap1. Eap1 binds Puf5 and Dhh1, and recruitment of Eap1 to repressed mRNAs is mediated by Puf5 (22890846)
Puf5 の抑制には Eap1 が要る。Eap1 は脱キャップを促して mRNA: Repression by Puf5 requires Eap1. Eap1 promotes decapping and accelerates mRNA decay; EAP1 deletion greatly reduces decapping, and deadenylated, capped mRNAs accumulate. Eap1 binds Puf5 and Dhh1 (22890846)
Puf5 は IXR1 の 3′UTR に依存して IXR1 の発現を抑える。結: Puf5 represses IXR1 expression dependent on the IXR1 3′UTR. Removing the binding sequence increases a GFP reporter 2.5-fold, and RIP confirmed binding of Puf5 to IXR1 mRNA. In puf5Δ, Ixr1 protein increases about 1.7-fold (mRNA 1.2-fold) (35905103)
Puf5 は Rho1 の GAP の LRG1 mRNA の発現を負に調節する: Puf5 negatively regulates expression of LRG1 mRNA, encoding a Rho1 GAP. In ccr4Δ puf5Δ, Lrg1 protein increases greatly, and the growth defect is partly restored by LRG1 deletion. Puf5 regulates LRG1 expression independently of Ccr4 (30281869)
Puf6 は Fun12（eIF5B）との結合を介して ASH1 mRNA の翻: Puf6 represses translation initiation of ASH1 mRNA through binding to Fun12 (eIF5B), and this repression is released by CK2-mediated N-terminal phosphorylation. Blocking phosphorylation of S31, S34, and S35 strengthens translational repression and disrupts ASH1 mRNA localization (18413716)
Puf6・Loc1 は RPL43 mRNA に結合し、RPL43A/B mRN: Puf6/Loc1 bind RPL43 mRNA and lower the stability and translation of RPL43A/B mRNAs (34661244)
Pus1 は Rad53 が試験管内で直接リン酸化する 12 個の基質の 1 つ: Pus1 is one of 12 substrates directly phosphorylated by Rad53 in vitro (30377154)
Put3 が MCH5 の過剰発現を担い、ゲルシフトで MCH5 プロモーターに: Put3 mediates overexpression of MCH5 and binds the MCH5 promoter in gel shift assays. Activation requires proline (18940788)
Put6 と Put7 はミトコンドリア内膜の大きなヘテロオリゴマー複合体をつく: Put6 and Put7 form a large hetero-oligomeric complex in the mitochondrial inner membrane, whose levels are regulated by proline (32978391)
Pwp2 と Utp21 の C 末ドメインが Utp12:Utp13 ヘテロ二: The C-terminal domains of Pwp2 and Utp21 mediate incorporation of the Utp12:Utp13 heterodimer (28600509)
Pwp2 の N 末のタンデム WD リピートが Utp21・Utp18・Utp: The N-terminal tandem WD repeats of Pwp2 bind Utp21, Utp18, and Utp6 to form the core complex (28600509)
Pxa1 と Pxa2 の相互作用に Pxa2 の C 末端が必要（ツーハイブリ: The Pxa2 C-terminus is required for the Pxa1–Pxa2 interaction (two-hybrid) (25118695)
Pxa1-Pxa2 複合体はペルオキシソーム膜の内側で Faa2 と/または F: The Pxa1-Pxa2 complex functionally cooperates with Faa2 and/or Fat1 on the inner side of the peroxisomal membrane to re-esterify VLCFAs (22493507)
Pxl1 は試験管内で Rho1-GDP に直接結合し、rho1-2・rho1-: Pxl1 binds Rho1-GDP directly in vitro and inhibits growth of rho1-2 and rho1-3 mutants in a dose-dependent manner (15215315)
QCR6 破壊株の bc1 複合体の組み立ての欠損を QCR9 の過剰発現が抑圧: QCR9 overexpression suppresses the bc1 complex assembly defect of QCR6 disruption strains (1651316)
QDR2 の転写は窒素制限やロイシン制限で活性化され、この制御は Gcn4 によ: QDR2 transcription is activated by nitrogen limitation and leucine limitation, and this control depends on general amino acid control by Gcn4 (17189489)
RAD30 を壊すと him1 による UV 誘発変異が完全に抑えられる（331: Disrupting RAD30 completely suppresses UV-induced mutagenesis caused by him1 (33128582)
RAD9 の欠失は DSB への Mre11 の結合を減らし、Sgs1 に依存し: RAD9 deletion reduces Mre11 binding to DSBs and promotes Rad52 assembly and end tethering in a Sgs1-dependent manner. In sae2Δ, Rad9 is proposed to keep Mre11 bound at persistent DSBs (25569305)
RAM は RAS の機能に要り、変異で RAS の膜局在と成熟が妨げられる（3: RAM is required for RAS function, and its mutation blocks RAS membrane localization and maturation (3533274). Ram1-Ram2 is a farnesyltransferase required for Ras membrane localization (1763050). ram1 lacks Ras2 farnesylation activity (2124698)
RAM1・RAM2 の働きは Ras の膜局在に要る: RAM1/RAM2 function is required for Ras membrane localization
REB1 が ILV1 の基底発現に要る配列に特異的に結合し、結合できない変異部: REB1 binds specifically to the sequence required for basal ILV1 expression, and mutant sites that cannot bind it do not support basal expression (1448083)
REG1 は GLC7 と物理的に結合する PP1 の調節サブユニットで、グルコ: REG1 is a PP1 regulatory subunit that binds GLC7 physically and directs GLC7 to the glucose repression pathway
RES 複合体の Snu17・Bud13・Pml1 が協同して折りたたまれ、Sn: Snu17, Bud13, and Pml1 of the RES complex fold cooperatively, stabilizing the Snu17 RRM and increasing the binding affinity among the three more than 100-fold (25218446)
RFC(2/3)・RFC(3/4) の部分複合体は PCNA に安定に結合し、R: The RFC(2/3) and RFC(3/4) subcomplexes bind PCNA stably, whereas Rfc2 and Rfc4 alone do not, so Rfc3 is the strong contact with PCNA (14530260)
RFC(3/4) 複合体は DNA 依存の ATPase で、RFC3 が RF: The RFC(3/4) complex is a DNA-dependent ATPase, and RFC3 supplies the catalytic arginine to the ATP site of RFC4 (14530260)
RFC-Ctf18 は Mrc1 に依存する Rad53 の活性化と止まったフォ: RFC-Ctf18 is indispensable for Mrc1-dependent Rad53 activation and maintenance of stalled forks. Rad24-RFC, 9-1-1, and Elg1-RFC are not required (20972444). Ctf18-RFC activates Rad53, and its binding to Pol ε is required for the S-phase checkpoint downstream of Mec1 (26250113)
RGG タンパク質 Psp2 は ATG1・ATG13 の翻訳を促してオートファ: The RGG protein Psp2 promotes translation of ATG1 and ATG13 and positively controls autophagy. It binds the 5' UTRs of ATG1 and ATG13 under nitrogen starvation (31666677)
RIM15 を欠くと IME1 と初期減数分裂遺伝子（IME2 など）の発現が下: Without RIM15, expression of IME1 and early meiotic genes (such as IME2) decreases (9111339)
RIM15 を欠くと IME2・SPO13・HOP1 の発現が下がり、IME2: Without RIM15, expression of IME2, SPO13, and HOP1 decreases, and Ume6-mediated activation at the IME2 promoter is lacking (9111339)
RING 型ユビキチンリガーゼ Asr1 は Ser5 リン酸化 CTD を介し: The RING-type ubiquitin ligase Asr1 binds Pol II via the Ser5-phosphorylated CTD and ubiquitinates Rpb1 and Rpb2. This releases Rpb4/Rpb7 and is accompanied by inactivation of polymerase function (19064926). The effect is on the complex rather than on Rpb2 alone, so confidence is medium
RING 型ユビキチンリガーゼ Asr1 は Ser5 リン酸化された CTD: The RING-type ubiquitin ligase Asr1 binds Pol II directly via the Ser5-phosphorylated CTD and ubiquitinates Rpb1 and Rpb2. This releases Rpb4/Rpb7 from the complex and abolishes polymerase function (19064926). Asr1-mediated ubiquitination of Pol II is required for silencing of subtelomeric genes, and disrupting the ligase activity of Asr1 or the Rpb1 ubiquitination sites allows transcription (26787877)
RM-A による IleRS の阻害で、Gcn2-Gcn4 の一般アミノ酸制御経: Inhibition of IleRS by RM-A activates ILS1 transcription via the Gcn2-Gcn4 general amino acid control pathway (12050165)
RNase MRP 固有の Snm1 も自身および Pop4 と相互作用する（1: The RNase MRP-specific Snm1 also interacts with itself and with Pop4 (11880623)
RP 遺伝子の転写は Rap1 結合部位で活性化され、RPL30 の Rap1: RP gene transcription is activated at Rap1-binding sites, and the Rap1-binding site of RPL30 is sufficient for transcriptional repression when the secretory pathway is impaired (10409730)
RPC34 の変異が C34 と TFIIIB70 の結合を変え、C34 は開始: RPC34 mutations alter binding of C34 to TFIIIB70, and C34 is the main determinant of Pol III recruitment by the preinitiation complex (9312031). Crosslinking shows that the cyclin repeats of Brf1 contact C34 (24277937)
RPC40 と RPC19 がコードする AC40・AC19 は two-hyb: AC40 and AC19, encoded by RPC40 and RPC19, associate in vivo by two-hybrid and genetic suppression (8516295)
RPI1 の過剰発現は正常な Ras2 の働きを下げ、IRA1/IRA2 を要す: RPI1 overexpression lowers normal Ras2 function and requires IRA1/IRA2 (1649384). On the other hand, another report describes Rpi1 as a transcriptional regulator acting independently of the Ras/cAMP pathway (12455971)
RPL40A か RPL40B の欠失・L40 の枯渇で 60S の成熟が損なわ: Deletion of RPL40A or RPL40B, or depletion of L40, impairs 60S maturation; Nmd3 and Rlp24 fail to leave cytoplasmic pre-60S and return poorly to the nucleus (22995916)
RPN4 はプロテアソームのサブユニット遺伝子の転写活性化因子で、サブユニットの: RPN4 is a transcriptional activator of proteasome subunit genes and is required to keep subunit levels normal (11248031)
RPN4 は非常に不安定（半減期約 2 分）で、RPN2 に直接結合し、組み上が: RPN4 is extremely unstable (half-life about 2 minutes), binds RPN2 directly, and is degraded by the assembled proteasome, forming negative feedback (11248031)
RPS28A のプロモーターの Abf1 結合部位と T に富む配列は効率的な転: The Abf1-binding site and T-rich sequence in the RPS28A promoter are essential for efficient transcription (10684934)
RPS28A/B などの Abf1 依存のリボソームタンパク質遺伝子のプロモータ: Promoters of Abf1-dependent ribosomal protein genes such as RPS28A/B contain Fhl1 sequences, and Fhl1 binding was confirmed by ChIP and gel shift (27016735)
RPT5 プロモーターの Rpn4 結合部位を変えて RPT5 の発現を下げると: Lowering RPT5 expression by altering the Rpn4-binding site in the RPT5 promoter causes polyubiquitinated proteins to accumulate (30629175)
RSC の核構造は Rsc8 の非対称な二量体を足場に Sfh1・Rsc6・Rs: The core structure of RSC is built from Sfh1, Rsc6, Rsc9, and Sth1 on a scaffold of an asymmetric Rsc8 dimer (31886770)
RSC の芯は Rsc8 の非対称な二量体を足場に Sfh1・Rsc6・Rsc9: The core of RSC is built from Sfh1, Rsc6, Rsc9, and Sth1 on a scaffold of an asymmetric Rsc8 dimer (cryo-EM, crosslinking mass spectrometry, 31886770)
RSC は Rsc4 の K25 で Gcn5 にアセチル化される。このアセチル: RSC is acetylated by Gcn5 at Rsc4 K25. This acetylation is essential in vivo for resistance to DNA damage (21673141)
RSN1 の過剰発現は Ena1 を細胞膜へ戻して sro7Δ 株の NaCl: RSN1 overexpression returns Ena1 to the plasma membrane and restores NaCl tolerance of sro7Δ strains (17005914)
RSP5 を減らすとイソフルランによる Bap2 のエンドサイトーシスが起きず、: Reducing RSP5 prevents isoflurane-induced endocytosis of Bap2, and Bap2 is ubiquitinated upon isoflurane exposure (34536986)
RSS は Yca1 の活性中心 Cys276 を過硫化し、自己切断と基質 Bi: RSS persulfidates the Yca1 active-site Cys276, suppressing autocleavage and cleavage of the substrate Bir1. Without CYS3, which produces RSS, Yca1 activity rises greatly and chronological lifespan shortens (38790694)
RT-PCR で野生型と crt1 欠失株を比べ、YLR345W が Crt1: Comparison of wild type and crt1 deletion strains by RT-PCR showed that YLR345W is under Crt1 control (15494396)
RTA1-lacZ とプロモーターの欠失解析で、Tup1 と Rox1・Mot3: RTA1-lacZ and promoter deletion analysis identified regions under negative regulation by Tup1 and Rox1/Mot3 (22129104)
RTC3 は Hog1 の標的（恒常活性型 Hog1 で誘導）で、4 つの活性化: RTC3 is a Hog1 target (induced by constitutively active Hog1) and is induced even in cells lacking the four activators (32804965)
RUB1 か活性化酵素 ENR2/ULA1 を壊すと Cul3 の Rub1 修: Disrupting RUB1 or the activating enzyme ENR2/ULA1 abolishes Rub1 modification of Cul3 (14519104)
Rab の Ypt1 は Hrr25 に結合して活性化し、キナーゼ活性を場所で制: The Rab Ypt1 binds and activates Hrr25, controlling its kinase activity spatially. hrr25 mutants show defects in ER–Golgi transport and macroautophagy (26195667)
Rab の運び手 Mrs6 は栄養に応じて Sfp1 と結合し、過剰発現で豊富な: The Rab escort Mrs6 binds Sfp1 depending on nutrients; its overexpression blocks nuclear localization of Sfp1 even with abundant nutrients, and without it Sfp1 enters the nucleus even with poor nutrients. In rapamycin-resistant MRS6 mutants, Sfp1 is not retained in the cytoplasm (19684114)
Rab5 の GEF（Muk1・Vps9）や Rab5 の 3 つの相同遺伝子（: Without the Rab5 GEFs (Muk1, Vps9) or the three Rab5 homologs (Vps21, Ypt52, Ypt53), TORC2-mediated phosphorylation and activation of Ypk1 greatly decrease. Vps21 co-precipitates with TORC2, and without Rab5 TORC2 activity decreases (30578283)
Rad1-Rad10 は Rad14 と強固な複合体を作り、Rad14 との結合: Rad1-Rad10 forms a tight complex with Rad14, and binding to Rad14 is indispensable for guiding Rad1-Rad10 to damage sites in vivo (16428464)
Rad14 との複合体形成が Rad1-Rad10 の損傷部位への導きに欠かせな: Complex formation with Rad14 is indispensable for guiding Rad1-Rad10 to damage sites (16428464)
Rad2 のスペーサーの 2 つの酸性部分が Tfb1 の PH ドメインにナノ: Two acidic portions of the Rad2 spacer bind the PH domain of Tfb1 with nanomolar affinity (22373916)
Rad2 スペーサーの酸性部分が Tfb1 の PH ドメインに nM の親和性: The acidic portion of the Rad2 spacer binds the PH domain of Tfb1 with nM affinity, and in NER TFIIH recruits Rad2 to damaged DNA (22373916)
Rad23 と Rad4 の結合を担う短い配列が Rad4 の安定化に必要で、単: A short sequence mediating Rad23–Rad4 binding is required for Rad4 stabilization and works on its own (15601997)
Rad26 は Pol II を直接は外さず、TC-NER を抑える伸長因子 S: Rad26 does not remove Pol II directly but constantly evicts the elongation factor Spt5, which suppresses TC-NER, from chromatin (30790631)
Rad34（YDR314C）は Rad33（YML011C）と物理的に相互作用し: Rad34 (YDR314C) interacts physically with Rad33 (YML011C), and in rad23 and rad33 cells the protein levels of Rad4 and YDR314C are greatly reduced (16595192)
Rad5 のユビキチンリガーゼ活性は PCNA のポリユビキチン化と、それに続く: The ubiquitin ligase activity of Rad5 mediates polyubiquitination of PCNA and subsequent recombination-mediated damage bypass (25690888). (Ubc13-Mms2)-Rad5 extends K63 chains on monoubiquitinated PCNA, promoting error-free damage bypass (19706603)
Rad5 の損傷許容での 2 つの働きは PCNA のポリユビキチン化による鋳型: The two functions of Rad5 in damage tolerance are activation of template switching through PCNA polyubiquitination and recruitment of TLS polymerases (36533078, mutations in the Rev1-binding region). In the crystal structure, the RFF motif at the Rad5 N-terminus binds a pocket at the Rev1 C-terminus (27001510)
Rad52 は Mps1 の動原体への動員と SAC の活性の維持に働き、Ipl: Rad52 acts in recruitment of Mps1 to kinetochores and maintenance of SAC activity, and phosphorylation of Rad52 by Ipl1 promotes Mps1 accumulation at kinetochores (29078282)
Rad52 は Mps1 の動原体への動員と紡錘体チェックポイント（SAC）の活: Rad52 acts in recruitment of Mps1 to kinetochores and maintenance of spindle checkpoint (SAC) activity. Rad52 is a substrate of Ipl1 and Mps1 in vitro, and Mps1-dependent phosphorylation of Rad52 is important for accurate SAC regulation upon spindle damage (29078282)
Rad52 は相同組換えとは別に、Mps1 の動原体への集合と SAC の活性の: Separately from homologous recombination, Rad52 acts in assembly of Mps1 at kinetochores and maintenance of SAC activity. Rad52 is a substrate of Ipl1 and Mps1 (in vitro). Ipl1-dependent phosphorylation of Rad52 promotes Mps1 assembly at kinetochores (29078282)
Rad53 が Dun1 の活性化ループの Thr380 をリン酸化して Dun: Reconstitution showed that Rad53 phosphorylates Thr380 in the Dun1 activation loop to activate Dun1 (17114794). The Dun1 FHA domain is required for direct phosphorylation by Rad53, and in FHA mutants the checkpoint function of Dun1 is greatly impaired (12556502)
Rad53 による Rdh54 の C 末端のリン酸化が Rdh54 のクラスタ: Phosphorylation of the Rdh54 C-terminus by Rad53 regulates the clustering activity of Rdh54 (single-molecule imaging). Loss of phosphorylation changes LOH outcomes (37850655)
Rad53 の FHA1 ドメインが Mdt1（PIN4）と結合する（15024: The FHA1 domain of Rad53 binds Mdt1 (PIN4) (15024067)
Rad53 の新しい基質 12 個を試験管内で直接リン酸化と確認、その中に De: Twelve new Rad53 substrates were confirmed to be directly phosphorylated in vitro, among them Ded1 (30377154)
Rad53 の新しい基質 12 個を試験管内で直接リン酸化と確認、その中に Hs: Twelve new Rad53 substrates were confirmed to be directly phosphorylated in vitro, among them Hst1 (30377154)
Rad53 の新しい基質 12 個を試験管内で直接リン酸化と確認、その中に Rp: Twelve new Rad53 substrates were confirmed to be directly phosphorylated in vitro, among them Rps7b (30377154)
Rad53 の新しい基質 33 個のうち Gcd11 など 12 個を試験管内で: Of 33 new Rad53 substrates, 12 including Gcd11 were confirmed to be directly phosphorylated in vitro (30377154)
Rad53 の活性化には Mec1 部位の多重リン酸化が要り、Rad9 が Me: Rad53 activation requires multisite phosphorylation at Mec1 sites, and Rad9 mediates phosphorylation of Rad53 by Mec1 (16085488). The Mec1/Ddc2 complex directly activates Rad53 through phosphorylation (16365046)
Rad53 は Dbf4 を直接リン酸化して DDK の経路を止め、Sld3 の: Rad53 directly phosphorylates Dbf4 to shut down the DDK pathway and, together with Sld3 phosphorylation, suppresses origin firing (20835227). dbf4(7A), with altered Rad53 sites, escapes origin suppression by the S-phase checkpoint (21098477)
Rad53 は G2・M・G1 期に Cdc5 と Cdc28 に依存してリン酸: Rad53 is phosphorylated in G2, M, and G1 in a Cdc5- and Cdc28-dependent manner and is also phosphorylated by both in vitro. Loss of the sites accelerates adaptation (20046099). Cdc5 abolishes Rad53 hyperphosphorylation at the DNA damage checkpoint, causing adaptation (20126259) (PMID: 20046099, 20126259)
Rad55 がないと Rad51 の ssDNA への結合が遅れ、鎖の侵入と H: Without Rad55, Rad51 binding to ssDNA is delayed, and strand invasion and movement of Rad51 to HML do not occur (12887906). Rad55-Rad57 joins Rad51-ssDNA filaments and makes them more stable than Rad51 alone (22020281)
Rad55 と Rad57 は解離定数 2×10^-10 M 未満の安定なヘテロ: Rad55 and Rad57 form a stable heterodimer with a dissociation constant below 2×10^-10 M (9159392)
Rad55 と結べない csm2-F46A は、Shu 複合体による Rad51: csm2-F46A, which cannot bind Rad55, loses the Shu complex's promotion of Rad51 presynaptic filament formation (in vitro) and also impairs HR in vivo (26215801). Csm2–Rad51 binding depends on Rad55 (23460207)
Rad55-Rad57 は安定なヘテロ二量体で、Rad51・RPA に加えると鎖: Rad55-Rad57 is a stable heterodimer, and adding it to Rad51 and RPA greatly stimulates strand exchange (9159392)
Rad6 は Sam1 をユビキチン化する主な E2 の一つで、rad6Δ で: Rad6 is one of the main E2s that ubiquitinate Sam1, and Sam1-containing stress granules increase in rad6Δ (41935435)
Rad6/Bre1 が Swd2 の修飾に直接関わる（18849979）: Rad6/Bre1 is directly involved in modification of Swd2 (18849979)
Rad7-Elc1 複合体の構造を決め、Rad7-Rad16-Elc1-Cul3: The structure of the Rad7-Elc1 complex was determined, showing the regions required for formation of the Rad7-Rad16-Elc1-Cul3 complex (30840920)
Rad7-Rad16 は Elc1・Cul3 と ECS 型 E3 を作り UV: Rad7-Rad16 forms an ECS-type E3 with Elc1 and Cul3 and ubiquitinates Rad4 in response to UV (30840920). Mutations in NEF4 (Rad7, Rad16) increase Rad4 levels (15226437)
Rad7-Rad16 は Elc1・Cul3 と ECS 型 E3 を作り、UV: Rad7-Rad16 forms an ECS-type E3 with Elc1 and Cul3 and ubiquitinates Rad4 in response to UV. Structure of Rad7-Elc1 (30840920)
Rad7-Rad16 複合体は全ゲノム修復（GGR）に不可欠。Elc1・Cul3: The Rad7-Rad16 complex is indispensable for global genome repair (GGR). It forms an ECS-type E3 with Elc1 and Cul3 (30840920)
Rad9 の CDK のリン酸化部位と Cdc28 の活性が、Chk1 の活性化: The CDK phosphorylation sites of Rad9 and Cdc28 activity are required for both Chk1 activation and Chk1 binding to Rad9 (23593009)
Rad9 の DNA 末端への結合が減ると Sgs1-Dna2 の活性の抑えが外: When Rad9 binding to DNA ends decreases, the restraint on Sgs1-Dna2 activity is lifted, compensating for resection without Sae2 (26584331)
Rad9 の N 末端は Chk1 のリン酸化と活性化に特に要り、Rad53 の: The Rad9 N-terminus is specifically required for Chk1 phosphorylation and activation, but not for Rad53 activation (14709724). The CDK sites of Rad9 and Cdc28 activity are required for Chk1 activation and Rad9–Chk1 binding (23593009)
Rad9 は BRCT ドメインと Mec1/Tel1 にリン酸化された SCD: Rad9 multimerizes through binding of its BRCT domain to the SCD phosphorylated by Mec1/Tel1, and this multimerization is required for checkpoint maintenance. Activated Rad53 phosphorylates the Rad9 BRCT, weakening BRCT–SCD binding, and when it cannot be phosphorylated, Rad9 assemblies (foci) are prominent. Described as feedback regulating Rad53 activity and Rad9 multimerization (19187758). BioGRID's 12917350 is a paper on Rad53's own phosphorylation sites, and phosphorylation of Rad9 by Rad53 is not in its abstract
